AbandonedChild23.Title: abandoned child
AbandonedChild23.Description: This colonist was born sickly. Thinking that they would only burden the tribe, their parents exposed them to the elements. Somehow, they survived.

AbandonedChild30.Title: abandoned child
AbandonedChild30.Description: This colonist was a quick witted, funny child. One day, they wandered off on their wealthy parents, and was ultimately lost in a supposedly unused ore warehouse. Due to cloning technology, their parents decided that the time looking for them was better spent on just cloning a better son.

AbandonedOrphan61.Title: abandoned orphan
AbandonedOrphan61.Description:
Abandoned at birth, young This colonist started their life in an orphanage.

A rascal and a scoundrel, they became a clever troublemaker.

Abductee43.Title: abductee
Abductee43.Description: This colonist was abducted at a young age and forced to do menial labor on a pirate ship.

Abductee7.Title: abductee
Abductee7.Description:
This colonist was abducted by xenohumans when They were still a baby. They experimented on them to understand their genetic structure.

As they grew up, This colonist grew a little bit too big and strong for their captors and escaped.

AcademyStudent58.Title: academy student
AcademyStudent58.Description:
This colonist went to school like a good space cadet would. They were very tall and was known for their good looks.

Though they worried more about their hairstyle than their grades, they still somehow passed the final exams.

AccursedChild88.Title: accursed child
AccursedChild88.Description:
This colonist was born at the peak of a lunar eclipse. The elders declared them a child of darkness and brought them under their care.

their entire childhood was spent studying the lore and rituals of their people - until the day of calling.

AceFighterPilot54.Title: ace fighter pilot
AceFighterPilot54.Description:
This colonist graduated from the Star Academy with honors and distinguished themself as an ace fighter pilot in three campaigns against more advanced aggressor cultures.

However, after one vicious battle, they found themself stranded and their carrier ship destroyed. With nowhere to go, they entered their escape pod and prayed.
AceFighterPilot54.SkillGainsJoined: Intellectual +2; Mining -3; Shooting +3; Melee +2; Social +3; Medicine +3

AcolyteOfStars6.Title: acolyte of stars
AcolyteOfStars6.Description:
Ever the dreamer, This colonist traveled across the universe to find the thing they felt was calling to him.

they became poorer and poorer, but used every means possible to carry on.

Actor72.Title: actor
Actor72.Description: This colonist traveled with a company of actors, playing to packed theatres and loving audiences everywhere. They were a perfectionist, and made their own props and costumes rather than use the ones They were given.

AddictionCounsel60.Title: counselor
AddictionCounsel60.Description:
After recovering from a joywire addiction, This colonist adopted a non-violent way of life and vowed to help others.

Travelling between communities, they used medicine, arts, and crafts to aid others who struggled with their own addictions.

Adventurer19.Title: adventurer
Adventurer19.Description:
This colonist's thirst for adventure took them to many planets. they visited the brightest glitterworlds and the darkest war-torn toxic planets in their quest to find novelty and excitement.

they worked as little as possible, often skirting ethical boundaries to make a quick buck. Among all jobs, they hated cooking the most.
Adventurer19.SkillGainsJoined: Shooting +3; Melee +3; Social +3; Medicine +3; Crafting +3; Animals +2

AdventuringChild30.Title: adventuring child
AdventuringChild30.Description:
This colonist was raised to become an engineer. For years, they planned to stow away on a cargo ship and start a new, more adventuresome life.

One night, after their parents fell asleep, they managed to sneak on board a cargo ship just before it left port.

AdventurousWeirdo55.Title: adventurous weirdo
AdventurousWeirdo55.Description:
A creative but strange individual, This colonist dedicated their life to their twin passions of medieval world history and high technology.

They were fascinated by the idea of becoming a 'skyknight' with glittering armor and a giant sword.

AdventurousYouth70.Title: adventurous youth
AdventurousYouth70.Description:
This colonist explored all around their family's large estate, uncovering little natural wonders hidden in nearby catacombs, rivers, and caves.

During their teenage years, This colonist made numerous enemies

AerospaceEngineer44.Title: aerospace engineer
AerospaceEngineer44.Description: This colonist was an engineer responsible for the production of aircraft and spaceships. they focused on improving production lines, and was known for their mastery of technical and research issues.

AIProgrammer22.Title: AI programmer
AIProgrammer22.Description:
This colonist enlisted in the military's robotics division, developing smarter combat AI.

The whole time They were there, they never spoke with another human. they spent all their time conversing with the AI They were developing.

AIResearcher94.Title: AI researcher
AIResearcher94.Description: This colonist was a renowned researcher in artificial intelligence, robotics, and interactive holography. their friendships with the artificial minds they created gave them the confidence to interact with real people, and they soon excelled at personal communication.

AlcoholicTrucker93.Title: alcoholic trucker
AlcoholicTrucker93.Description:
This colonist was a space trucker working for Arcknight Industries when they killed their wife and daughter in a crash.

their body was repaired with an experimental nano-genetic therapy. Now their muscles continually regenerate and harden, and every movement tears the tissue anew. they bears the pain in silence.

AmateurAstronomer77.Title: amateur astronomer
AmateurAstronomer77.Description:
This colonist was fascinated with astronomy. they would spend hours gazing at planets and nebulae through their telescope.

they is credited with discovering a small comet that would, years later, strike a nearby moon and disrupt the mining operations there.

AmateurBotanist79.Title: amateur botanist
AmateurBotanist79.Description: Spending many summers crawling through dirt, This colonist found they had quite the green thumb. Instead of learning to cook the food they grew, they just grew more and more.

AmateurEngineer3.Title: amateur engineer
AmateurEngineer3.Description: This colonist grew up in a family with a military and engineering background. they wanted to join the army but their father didn't like the idea, so their interest turned to great flying machines and works of engineering. they secretly hoped that this would one day lead them to a life of galactic exploration.

AnarchistRebel77.Title: anarchist rebel
AnarchistRebel77.Description:
After being abandoned on a special operation, This colonist swore vengeance upon the state. they formed an anarchist group dedicated to bringing down coreworld governments.

After too many close calls, and too few successes, This colonist fled to the outer rim.

AngryStudent88.Title: angry student
AngryStudent88.Description:
This colonist trained towards their dream of working for their hometown's local council.

For reasons they never quite understood, They were bullied relentlessly by their classmates. they chose to repress their rage.

AnimalCaretaker20.Title: animal caretaker
AnimalCaretaker20.Description:
Born on a medieval farm, This colonist was tasked with caring for domestic animals. they grew to love them.

With time, they learned to tame wild animals. they dreamed of one day meeting a thrumbo and taming it.

AnimalFarmer21.Title: animal farmer
AnimalFarmer21.Description: This colonist raised a variety of animals to provide meat, milk, eggs, and leather.

AnimalLabTech39.Title: animal lab tech
AnimalLabTech39.Description:
This colonist worked as a technician in a lab studying animals.

they spent their days taking care of the animals and cleaning up after them. they dreamed of having their own lab one day.

AntisocialChild83.Title: antisocial child
AntisocialChild83.Description:
This colonist lacked typical social skills, and avoided social interaction.

they gained satisfaction only from steady work. they especially disliked speaking with overly creative or outgoing individuals.

ApocalypseChild23.Title: apocalypse child
ApocalypseChild23.Description:
This colonist spent their childhood on a post-apocalyptic world. they fought for survival from a young age, on a planet where trust did not exist.

they told everyone that they had no luck.

ApocalypseSurvivor23.Title: apocalypse survivor
ApocalypseSurvivor23.Description: This colonist was born during a time of unrest on their homeworld, as climate change threatened mass starvation and flooding. As they grew up the situation worsened - billions died and peaceful states descended into anarchy. This colonist and their parents did whatever they had to do to survive.

ApprenticeOracle83.Title: apprentice oracle
ApprenticeOracle83.Description:
This colonist was chosen at an early age by the village elders to keep the sacred rituals of the Oracle.

An irrepressibly curious child, This colonist caused a religious crisis for their tribe when they accidentally flipped a switch to open the "tombs" of the Gods - cryptosleep caskets inhabited by some very confused ancestors.

ApprenticeSmith37.Title: apprentice smith
ApprenticeSmith37.Description:
This colonist grew up helping in their father's smithy.

They were some of the last smiths on the planet that to use traditional smithing methods. They even collect some materials themselves.

Sometimes, after work, This colonist would practice using the swords they forged.

Archaeologist85.Title: archaeologist
Archaeologist85.Description:
They were trapped in an uninspired life. One day, they jumped on a ship to learn archaeology and see the universe.

they learned how to survive. they also learned about people - although they understood the dead better than the living.

Archer25.Title: archer
Archer25.Description: This colonist fought for their tribe. they and specialized in the use of bows, pila, and other ranged weapons.

Architect28.Title: architect
Architect28.Description: This colonist designed the construction of buildings. On their glitterworld home, the technical aspect of architecture was handled by an AI, whilst the labour was done by robots. This freed them up to push the artistic limits of his craft, but also meant they never had to get their hands dirty.

ArchotechSpy75.Title: archotech researcher
ArchotechSpy75.Description:
This colonist researched archotech intelligences.

Studying a mysterious archotechnological object from orbit, they became convinced that it was communicating directly with them. Eventually their colleagues caught them transmitting secret information directed towards the dark sphere, and he was forced to flee.

ArmyCook0.Title: army cook
ArmyCook0.Description: This colonist joined the army as a worker and spent most of their time cooking and repairing. While They were stationed on a dangerous planet, they underwent basic shooting and survival training.
ArmyCook0.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +2; Intellectual -2; Shooting +2; Melee +2; Cooking +3; Crafting +1

ArmyScientist35.Title: army scientist
ArmyScientist35.Description: This colonist did scientific research for a planetary army. they studied war scenarios and designed weapon systems to help win battles with a minimum of fuss.

ArmySergeant16.Title: army sergeant
ArmySergeant16.Description:
This colonist served in their country's military, commanding small units as a non-commissioned officer.

they excelled creating tactically sound plans despite difficult circumstances.

Aromatherapist80.Title: aromatherapist
Aromatherapist80.Description: This colonist practiced aromatherapy, using essences extracted from home-grown plants.

ArtfulDodger78.Title: artful dodger
ArtfulDodger78.Description:
This colonist grew up on one of the urbworlds and had to fend for themself all their life. they never trusted anyone, relying on their persuasiveness and cunning to survive.

they soon became skilled with firearms and knives as well as words.

ArtifactHunter48.Title: artifact hunter
ArtifactHunter48.Description:
This colonist became depressed and lost interest in life. they traveled from planet to planet, searching for psychic artifacts amid mechanoid ruins in the hope that they would cure the pain in their soul.

A steady trigger finger and careful planning kept This colonist alive.

ArtificerRampant95.Title: artificer rampant
ArtificerRampant95.Description:
Fuelled by the thrill of discovery and their own megalomania, This colonist set out to invent new devices and improve existing ones, breaking laws and customs as necessary.

they formed a crew to gather materials for their work - and to deal with outsiders who might interfere.

Artilleryman28.Title: artilleryman
Artilleryman28.Description: This colonist loaded shells and aimed artillery to pound their army's enemies from afar.

ArtisanFarmer23.Title: artisan farmer
ArtisanFarmer23.Description: This colonist grew up on a their family's glitterworld farm. They were one of the last farms on the planet that preferred traditional farming methods to glitterworld technology.

ArtisticWeirdo56.Title: artistic weirdo
ArtisticWeirdo56.Description:
This colonist grew up in a house near a bustling midworld metropolis.

They were talented at art and creative work, but often acted strangely, and thus had few friends.

ArtsPatron54.Title: arts patron
ArtsPatron54.Description:
This colonist managed their family's investments in the arts.

they chose artists to patronize and worked with them to produce the expressions that most glorify their family, the Imperial church, and the Empire itself.

ArtStudent79.Title: art student
ArtStudent79.Description: After years of practice, Freya was able to enrol into an art university and take her skills further. She sought art industry work after graduating with good grades. She made some progress with private commissions, managing to make a decent living from heart.
ArtStudent79.SkillGainsJoined: Construction -2; Plants -1; Cooking -1; Medicine +1; Artistic +8; Crafting +2

AsceticPriest84.Title: ascetic priest
AsceticPriest84.Description:
After taking a vow of silence, This colonist joined a monastery to spend their days in quiet contemplation.

they found happiness growing vegetables in the garden and making cheese in the monastery cellars.

AspergersRebel13.Title: aspergers rebel
AspergersRebel13.Description:
This colonist grew up as a rebel on an formerly-advanced rimworld devastated by war.

their Aspergers syndrome meant they struggled with social situations and was incapable of caring, but they learned hard skills like research and shooting very quickly.

AspiringEngineer58.Title: aspiring engineer
AspiringEngineer58.Description:
This colonist had a fascination with gadgets and gizmos. they took apart and put together almost anything they could find.

they got used to repairing toys brought to them by other children, and even fixed a few devices from their elders.

AspiringPhysicist47.Title: aspiring physicist
AspiringPhysicist47.Description:
The daughter of an engineer and doctor, This colonist's early life was intellectually rich. After visiting a physics lab, they decided they wanted to be a quantum physicist.

Bitten by a camel, kicked off a horse, and chased by dogs, This colonist developed a fear of animals.

AspiringPopIdol28.Title: aspiring pop idol
AspiringPopIdol28.Description:
This colonist was being trained in song and dance to become the next big pop idol. they grew up being taken care of by company handlers.

they never knew manual labor, but learned a lot about music and social etiquette.

Assassin20.Title: assassin
Assassin20.Description: This colonist was a professional assassin. They were cold, calculating, and made a good profit. In this business, an utter lack of empathy was an asset.

Assassin7.Title: assassin
Assassin7.Description:
This colonist was specially trained as an operative to be used for high-risk assassinations. their skill with a rifle was unrivalled.

They were eventually betrayed by their superiors when a target found out about the hit and offered to fund their future projects. This colonist swore to never trust anyone again.

Assembler69.Title: assembler
Assembler69.Description: This colonist worked on factory assembly lines, putting together products with the help of robots.

Athlete47.Title: athlete
Athlete47.Description:
This colonist was professional athlete at early age. Thanks to their skills, They were able to leave their homeworld and enroll in a glitterworld university of science and technology.

Because of their demanding schedule and introverted nature, they became socially inept.

AwkwardNerd48.Title: awkward nerd
AwkwardNerd48.Description: Always fascinated by machines, This colonist spent their time studying robotics and holography. they preferred the company of their scientific creations to that of other people.

AWOLSoldier49.Title: AWOL soldier
AWOLSoldier49.Description: This colonist was an infantryman. When They were informed of their assignment to the Xennoa-Zartza War, they decided they did not want to be a soldier. They were able to escape via military spacejet.

BalletDancer81.Title: ballet dancer
BalletDancer81.Description: This colonist was a dancer in a traditional ballet troupe. they mastered the ancient motions and entertained thousands.

BanditLeader74.Title: bandit leader
BanditLeader74.Description: This colonist rose up the ranks of the crime organization, eventually becoming the leader of one of their most remote cells of bandits. their dog Rest never left their side.

Banished68.Title: banished
Banished68.Description: This colonist's tribe banished them following a bloody dispute. they survived in the wilds alone for a long time.

BanishedSoldier85.Title: banished soldier
BanishedSoldier85.Description:
This colonist became the most physically intimidating of the slaves, spending their little free time obsessively sculpting their body. their efforts eventually paid off when the lord offered them a job as a personal bodyguard.

Later, when they plotted to use their position to kill the lord and free the slaves, They were discovered and barely escaped with their life.

Bartender62.Title: bartender
Bartender62.Description: This colonist worked as a bartender in a seedy establishment. The job was one part drink-mixing, one part diplomacy, and one part head-bashing.

BattlefieldTech52.Title: battlefield tech
BattlefieldTech52.Description:
This colonist had received firearms training, but their work was focused on technical adaptation and manipulation of combat mechanoids on the battlefield.

they developed PTSD after narrowly escaping a primitive firebomb attack in a wheat field. The army medically discharged them from service.

BattleMechanic27.Title: battle mechanic
BattleMechanic27.Description:
This colonist was a tech-obsessed mercenary in an early fusion-era system.

They were unusually obsessed with gathering the right gear, and often customized their own equipment with original modifications.

Beastmaster67.Title: beastmaster
Beastmaster67.Description:
This colonist's family had more children than they had proper titles to inherit. Being of low rank in the birth order, This colonist was given the honorary title of beastmaster.

This colonist managed the family's extensive menagerie. While they never worked hands-on with the beasts, they connected with them. Few others appreciated them the way they did.

BeastSlayer67.Title: beast slayer
BeastSlayer67.Description:
This colonist traveled between planets, following news of animal attacks. they would camp on the planet for weeks, learning about their prey before striking. they most enjoyed hunting thrumbos.

Preferring to work alone, This colonist enjoyed the thrill of the hunt, and the meat from the kill.

BehaviourResearch74.Title: behaviour research
BehaviourResearch74.Description:
Captured as a feral child, This colonist was forced into the ways of modern society. they quickly adapted and became a behavioural researcher, eventually owning a private facility.

they specialized in canines, but learned a great deal about all animals. they never had interest in plants, however.
BehaviourResearch74.SkillGainsJoined: Plants -3; Intellectual +8; Melee +1; Social +2; Cooking -2; Medicine +6

BiosphereManager95.Title: biosphere manager
BiosphereManager95.Description: This colonist lived on a peaceful glitterworld where all menial work was done by robots, while the people mostly devoted themselves to leisure. they managed the plant and animal life of a sprawling park, where citizens came to admire nature's beauty.

BlackjackPlayer76.Title: blackjack player
BlackjackPlayer76.Description:
The only useful skill This colonist learned from their tough military school was card-counting. they amassed many enemies by cheating at casinos, becoming ever more edgy and violent as the threat of retaliation grew.

When They were finally caught, they burned half their skin off. they could never face fire or violence again.

Blacksmith7.Title: blacksmith
Blacksmith7.Description: As a blacksmith on a medieval world, This colonist gained a reputation for the high quality of their work. they wasn't bad at using the swords they forged either.

Blacksmith72.Title: blacksmith
Blacksmith72.Description: As a smith on a medieval world, This colonist gained a reputation for the high quality of their work. they wasn't bad at using the swords they forged either.

BlacksmithShooter21.Title: blacksmith shooter
BlacksmithShooter21.Description:
As a young blacksmith, This colonist's family shop was raided by the police. they shot two officers before they knocked them out and arrested him.

Sentenced to life in prison, This colonist learned about traveling and raiding from other criminals.

BlacksmithsSon73.Title: blacksmith's son
BlacksmithsSon73.Description:
This colonist's father owned the blacksmith shop in an run-down old city district. This colonist would help their father whenever they could.

Later, their father took them as a blacksmith's apprentice and raised them as a man. This colonist also took on shooting as a hobby.

BlessedChild46.Title: blessed child
BlessedChild46.Description:
This colonist was born under auspicious circumstances to a midworld spiritual group and held in reverence throughout their childhood.

they learned to take care of the poor and give succor to the faithful from an early age.

BloodgameSurvivor6.Title: bloodgame survivor
BloodgameSurvivor6.Description:
This colonist was sold to the Corestars Entertainment Company and used as meat in one of the company's system-wide broadcast shows.
 
their manipulative nature made them quite a nightmare, even to the audience. They were kicked out and exiled to a planet full of deadly animals, criminals and armed camera-drones.

BloodyDentist9.Title: bloody dentist
BloodyDentist9.Description:
After studying at a famous college, This colonist's weak personality eventually snapped under the strain of angry administrators and whining patients. they went on a secret murder spree, killing many of those under their care.

After a pursuit, they managed to escape their planet and travel to a new world.

BloodyWanderer28.Title: bloody wanderer
BloodyWanderer28.Description:
This colonist was a wanderer, traveling from town to town, taking odd jobs and stealing to live.

One day, they had a mental break and went on a long rampage, destroying several towns and killing many. they eventually calmed, but their bloodlust never left them.

Bodyguard58.Title: bodyguard
Bodyguard58.Description: This colonist protected whoever paid them. they gained proficiency in many different combat forms, and was known for their ruthlessness against those who crossed them.

BodyguardTrainee54.Title: bodyguard trainee
BodyguardTrainee54.Description:
This colonist was born into a famously skilled family of bodyguards. their mothers Elena and Victoria forced them into many dangerous situations, training them to put their client's well-being over their own.

This colonist was taught about many herbs and natural poisons to help them prevent clients from being poisoned.

BoneCollector14.Title: bone collector
BoneCollector14.Description:
Born to a family of fortune hunters, This colonist always had a passion for ancient history.

Though never a tough or social boy, they loved to dig through history books as well as dirt piles.
BoneCollector14.SkillGainsJoined: Plants +2; Mining +2; Shooting -3; Melee -3; Social -3; Medicine +2; Artistic +2; Crafting +2

Bookworm19.Title: bookworm
Bookworm19.Description: Rather than socialize with the other children, This colonist preferred to get lost in literature. they taught themself to read at an early age with books bought from passing traders.

Bookworm3.Title: bookworm
Bookworm3.Description: This colonist spent their youth in the library, reading every book they could about the technical marvels of space travel, the engineering ingenuity of the space-faring pioneers, and the horrible yet fascinating tales of mechanoid wars. they vowed that one day, they would see these things for themself.

BountyHunter17.Title: bounty hunter
BountyHunter17.Description: This colonist was a self-employed bounty hunter. they spent their days hunting space pirates and collecting cash bounties.

BountyHunter41.Title: bounty hunter
BountyHunter41.Description: This colonist was a bounty hunter on a massive glitterworld. they worked sensitive assignments for extremely wealthy clients, and was known for quiet execution and total discretion.

BountyHunter93.Title: bounty hunter
BountyHunter93.Description: When the civil war ended, This colonist had to find a new way to use their fighting skills. they decided to hunt down war criminals and soon realized that they enjoyed capturing bad guys by any means necessary.

BoyScout42.Title: boy scout
BoyScout42.Description:
This colonist was in a boy scout troop on a midworld.

they learned many survival skills including how to thrive in the outdoors and how to tend to basic wounds.

BoySoldier14.Title: boy soldier
BoySoldier14.Description:
War may never change - but the cast of characters does.

Born on a violent urbworld, This colonist was trained from a young age to fight the wars of others, and became rather good at it.

Brave88.Title: brave
Brave88.Description: This colonist wielded ikwa, axes, clubs, and other close-ranged weapons in battles for their tribe.

Brigand68.Title: brigand
Brigand68.Description: This colonist flew with a band of brigands they called friends. they even had a ship of their own - The Dung Mucker 2000.
Brigand68.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +2; Shooting +2; Melee +3; Cooking +2; Medicine +1; Crafting +1

BrokenSoldier29.Title: broken soldier
BrokenSoldier29.Description:
They were a strong soldier in a long war of succession. In their final battle, their unit was sacrificed to cover a retreat. This colonist watched their comrades die and was the only survivor.

The experience broke them inside, leaving them without the coping strategies to moderate their emotions.

This colonist learned to draw in the hospital.

BrothelGofer84.Title: brothel gofer
BrothelGofer84.Description: Born on a steam-powered midworld wracked by a century of economic crises, This colonist went to work at a young age. Scrounging, shoe-polishing, sewing - they did it all. But They were most known as a brothel gofer, delivering all manner of aphrodisiacs and chemicals to the girls' rooms.

BrutalThief59.Title: brutal thief
BrutalThief59.Description:
Growing up in a gang, This colonist learned the brutality of the streets.

Knowing that showing weakness could be fatal, they closed themself off from others.

BuddingArtist44.Title: budding artist
BuddingArtist44.Description: This colonist had a knack for art. Traders and collectors from many different societies sought to buy their creations.

Builder96.Title: builder
Builder96.Description: This colonist worked on construction sites, building everyday structures according to their boss' instructions.

Bully70.Title: bully
Bully70.Description: This colonist tormented other children for fun. To keep them busy, an elder assigned them to a hunting party at an early age.

BunkerKid41.Title: bunker kid
BunkerKid41.Description:
This colonist grew up in an underground shelter, waiting for radioactive fallout to subside. their rich family had gained access to a luxury bunker city, while billions died on the surface.

Determined to one day seek revenge against the hated enemy, This colonist spent most of their time practicing shooting in their private training facility.

BushSniper94.Title: bush sniper
BushSniper94.Description:
This colonist's peaceful life was cut short when their country was brutally invaded.

This colonist was drafted into service as soon as They were of legal age, and quickly showed an aptitude for rifles. they spent months living in the forests picking off soldiers who dared cross the border.

BusinessGangster58.Title: business gangster
BusinessGangster58.Description: Staying one step ahead of the law, This colonist became a legitimate businessman and silenced anyone who dared say otherwise. As proprietor of brothels, speakeasies and eateries, This colonist's good fortune continued while their competition suffered a series of unfortunate and unexplained accidents.

Butcher40.Title: butcher
Butcher40.Description: This colonist's main job in the hunting party was the butchering of animals. they became a master with the knife, able to extract every bit of value from a carcass in a short time.

Cadet96.Title: cadet
Cadet96.Description:
Born on the planet New China, This colonist's father was a police chief and kept extremely strict watch over their son.

This colonist had to do military-style drill exercises every day and keep their room spotlessly clean, always ready for inspection. they came to abhor violence.

CaravanChild53.Title: caravan child
CaravanChild53.Description:
This colonist was born on a urbworld merchant ship to an entrepreneurial mother and an absent father. Born male, they disliked boy stuff, and got into their mother's things all the time.

Eventually, they traveled with their mother to a glitterworld and spent their savings on a body They were happy with.

Caravaneer53.Title: caravaneer
Caravaneer53.Description:
This colonist was the leader of a caravan. They were responsible for the safety of their caravan and was the head negotiator in countless trade deals.

they and their people prospered, but their wealth made them a target for brigands. They often had to take up arms to fend off bandits and highwaymen.

CaravanTraveler6.Title: caravan traveler
CaravanTraveler6.Description: Born to a family of traveling merchants, This colonist was mentored by their father in the ways of being a trader. They were often tasked with caring for the pack animals. Due to their nomadic lifestyle, they hunted and bartered for their food.

CargoPilot58.Title: cargo pilot
CargoPilot58.Description: This colonist was brought up by cargo hands on a long-haul ore transport ship. they perfected their skills at trading and manipulation of people while running weapons between systems.

Carver1.Title: carver
Carver1.Description: This colonist carved artworks for their tribe from wood, stone, and occasionally, more exotic materials. The work was sometimes sold, and sometimes kept to beautify settlements and provide a focus for rituals.

CasketBuilder52.Title: casket builder
CasketBuilder52.Description:
This colonist was fascinated with cryptosleep, and spent their life learning about the mysterious technology.

Working as an assembler on a midworld, This colonist built an experimental prototype casket from discarded parts. Unfortunately, while They were searching for the final component, their home was leveled by a bomb.

Castaway57.Title: castaway
Castaway57.Description:
This colonist was the only survivor of a ship crash on an unhabited animal world. For many years until their rescue they scrounged an existence out of whatever they could find.

their survival skills became razor-sharp, but spending so long alone severely dampened their conversational abilities.

Castaway81.Title: castaway
Castaway81.Description: This colonist was a passenger on a routine interstellar transit. When their ship was destroyed, they lived as a castaway on an uninhabited planet for several years.

CatHerder4.Title: cat herder
CatHerder4.Description:
This colonist helped out in their father's cat breeding business, socializing, herding, and feeding hundreds of cats.

When they refused to clean up after the cats, They were transferred to the breeding science division.

CaveBuilder81.Title: cave builder
CaveBuilder81.Description: This colonist specialized in cave complex excavation and construction.

CaveChild17.Title: cave child
CaveChild17.Description:
This colonist grew up in a cave on an tundra planet, and was adopted by a traveling group of entertainers known only as the Wizards. Once a starfaring crew, the Wizards told them wondrous stories about the universe.

One day, the Wizards did not return from scavenging. After years of waiting, This colonist set off into space to find them.
CaveChild17.SkillGainsJoined: Plants +2; Mining +2; Shooting -2; Melee -2; Cooking +2; Crafting +2

CaveChild30.Title: cave child
CaveChild30.Description: This colonist grew up in a large and intricate cave complex that extended deep into a mountainside. they helped the adults maintain and improve the deep caves.

CaveExplorer45.Title: cave explorer
CaveExplorer45.Description: This colonist made a living mapping out dark tunnels and near-inaccessible crevices in search of valuable minerals. their work was very dangerous, but the pay was good.

CaveworldIlluminator95.Title: caveworld illuminator
CaveworldIlluminator95.Description: Among tunnel-dwellers, those with vision as strong as This colonist's are revered as sages. they would lead the way, marking spots to dig with bioluminescent fungus and warning others of impending danger.

CaveworldTender26.Title: caveworld tender
CaveworldTender26.Description: This colonist grew up in cave complex deep beneath the surface of an inhospitable world. they worked with the other children tending the tribe's fungus crops.

CaveworldTunneler48.Title: caveworld tunneler
CaveworldTunneler48.Description:
This colonist worked as a digger in the massive underground cave complex.

they knows rock so well that they can almost navigate caves by smell.

CharityWorker36.Title: charity worker
CharityWorker36.Description: Glitterworlds are havens of comfort for those lucky enough to live there, but This colonist could not ignore the nearby trashworlds where the people suffered and starved. they spent their life appealing for donations and supporting those in need.

Chef52.Title: chef
Chef52.Description: This colonist was the star chef at a high-class coreworld restaurant. They were famous among patrons for their creative culinary specialties, and infamous among the kitchen staff for their casual disdain for grunt work.

Chemist73.Title: chemist
Chemist73.Description: This colonist was a research chemist. they worked with chemicals, from pharmaceuticals to explosives, to develop new substances and treatments.

Chemist78.Title: chemist
Chemist78.Description:
This colonist was a renowned chemist on a thriving midworld.

After performing inhumane experiments that turned men into beasts, They were arrested and banished to a far-off rimworld.

ChessMaster67.Title: chess master
ChessMaster67.Description:
This colonist loved to play chess. they even earned the nickname This colonist for some of their craftier moves.

they never got into trouble - mostly because They were good at not getting caught.

ChiefEngineer62.Title: chief engineer
ChiefEngineer62.Description:
As chief engineer on board a large spaceship, This colonist was an expert in all things fiddly and complex.

they relied on other members of the crew for some of the basic necessities of life. they and their ship eventually disappeared into a longsleep voyage of exploration.

Child27.Title: child
Child27.Description: This colonist is a child. The story of their childhood is still being written.

ChildKnave69.Title: child-knave
ChildKnave69.Description:
This colonist was a child-knave of King Loteric. they enjoyed the training with wooden sticks and engaging others in close combat. they adapted quickly to the heat of battle and was good at spreading fire.

they served their lord well, until the king died in an unfortunate accident.

ChildOfDrifters18.Title: child of drifters
ChildOfDrifters18.Description: Ever since They were very small, This colonist never knew a home beyond their parent's ship. Their nomadic meandering provided a constant change of scenery. their life was often perilous but never dull, and they inherited their parents' wanderlust.

ChildOfGlass61.Title: child of glass
ChildOfGlass61.Description:
This colonist was raised underground on a "marble" planet - a wasteland of radioactive asphalt and toxic fallout.

To survive on a planet devoid of life, they had to learn how to farm underground and how to fight without wasting bullets.

ChildProdigy76.Title: child prodigy
ChildProdigy76.Description: After graduating college at age twelve, This colonist devoted their life to becoming immortal. However their research crossed the line when they tried to modify their body using gene therapy and mechanical augmentation. They were arrested and condemned to a prison planet.

ChildResearcher32.Title: child researcher
ChildResearcher32.Description:
A frightfully intelligent child, This colonist was kidnapped by a glitterworld corporation and forced to research technologies for weaponizing anti-matter.

they vowed never to invent anything again.

ChildScientist30.Title: child scientist
ChildScientist30.Description:
After graduating college very young, This colonist devoted their life to becoming immortal. They were arrested for trying to genetically modify themself.

The authorities released them on the condition that they would work in a government lab on spacecraft technology. They were permitted to continue their personal research in their free time.

ChildSlave58.Title: child slave
ChildSlave58.Description: This colonist was born to a poor family on a rimworld. their father sold them into slavery at a young age. They were traded many times. A tycoon bought them and sent them down into mines to look after machines and to work alongside them.

ChildSpy47.Title: child spy
ChildSpy47.Description:
Children are presumed innocent, which makes them excellent spies. This colonist was trained in the art of infiltration when They were just a small child.

their years undercover gave them experience with social manipulation and lying, but they never had a normal education.

ChildSpy84.Title: child spy
ChildSpy84.Description:
Children are often presumed innocent, and so make ideal spies. This colonist was trained in the arts of infiltration and information-gathering when They were very young.

their spent years behind enemy lines, gathering intel in a brutal war. During this time, they had limited opportunity for education.

ChildStar74.Title: child star
ChildStar74.Description: This colonist was well-known throughout their homeworld as a child actor in films and TV shows. their fame put them in contact with many different kinds of people, but also tended to get in the way of their education.

ChildTribal.Title: child
ChildTribal.Description: This colonist is a child. The story of their childhood is still being written.

ChurchPsychic98.Title: church psychic
ChurchPsychic98.Description:
This colonist was a psychic in the imperial church's psychic school.

This colonist trained their mind to sense the collective emotions and impressions of the people. It was a way to touch the spirit of the empire. It was also a way to root out heretical trends in thought.

CircusPerformer37.Title: circus performer
CircusPerformer37.Description:
Growing up in the circus, This colonist learned a lot of interesting things. More interesting than the balls they juggled were the pockets they picked between shows.

A mistake with some firesticks made them develop a deathly fear of fire.

CivilEngineer2.Title: civil engineer
CivilEngineer2.Description: This colonist was a well-known civil engineer. their job involved designing and maintaining rock fortification structures. they did enough statistical analysis to keep their mind sharp.

CivilServant2.Title: civil servant
CivilServant2.Description: This colonist worked as a low-ranking administrator for a moribund government bureaucracy. they is most at home filling out complicated paperwork and playing office politics.

CivilServant25.Title: Civil servant
CivilServant25.Description:
This colonist was bureaucrat in the civil service.

Although their family connections took them far, their vocal opposition to their bosses' plans hindered their advancement. Called a "red prince" by some, This colonist sympathized with the poor, leading ultimately to disgrace in their career.

ClanChief14.Title: clan chief
ClanChief14.Description: This colonist managed a small criminal clan on an outlying trade hub world.

ClassClown96.Title: class clown
ClassClown96.Description:
In the ultra-competitive environs of their glitterworld school, This colonist always offered to play the class clown to diffuse tension.

they developed a sense of social desperation from this, as well as an appreciation for the artistic side of comedy.

CloneFarmed21.Title: clone-farmed
CloneFarmed21.Description: Clone children are seeded into nutrient-rich womb-vats and rapidly grown in a simmed universe. They're harvested later, sometimes for food, sometimes for organs, sometimes for workers - but they're always disposable.

CloneFarmer58.Title: clone farmer
CloneFarmer58.Description: Harvesting the products of clone farms is mostly done by the clones themselves - particularly to those whose sims tended towards the social. This clone was one such, who escaped from the farms and headed out to the stars.

ColiseumCleaner54.Title: coliseum cleaner
ColiseumCleaner54.Description: During the 'Inner Destrian War' fallout, their parents were captured and They were born into a life of slavery. Forced to clean coliseums after bloody battles for money. Watching, waiting, and learning. Coliseums were the only thing they ever knew. One night while cleaning the coliseum, their family was murdered.

ColiseumFighter22.Title: coliseum fighter
ColiseumFighter22.Description: Applying the knowledge that they gained from years around fighters, they became a successful gladiator in the coliseum that they once cleaned.

ColonialGovernor78.Title: colonial governor
ColonialGovernor78.Description:
Disillusioned by rampant government corruption, This colonist ran for governor and won. However, the local gangs and their pet officials soon forced them out of power.

they left the community to return to their life as a marshal.

Colonist22.Title: colonist
Colonist22.Description: As a child, They were launched into space as part of an interstellar colonization program.

Colonist97.Title: colonist
Colonist97.Description: This colonist became an adult in our colony. their story is still being written.

ColonyChild59.Title: colony child
ColonyChild59.Description: This colonist grew up in our colony.

ColonyEngineer7.Title: colony engineer
ColonyEngineer7.Description:
The children took over the facility, and they declared independence from the corporation.

This colonist had used the VR system to become a master engineer, and they worked diligently to prepare the colony for the corporation's inevitable return.

ColonyKid47.Title: colony kid
ColonyKid47.Description:
This colonist was born the child of two doctors in a small colony. Because of their parents, They were always interested in science and medicine.

This colonist never really got along with other children, and as a result became withdrawn and unsociable.

ColonySettler53.Title: colony settler
ColonySettler53.Description:
This colonist was a settler on a new colony world.

Such a life requires a jack-of-all trades at basic hands-on tasks.

ComaChild93.Title: coma child
ComaChild93.Description: A childhood accident put This colonist into a coma. they didn't wake up until They were in their late teens. their body never recovered from the years of inactivity, but people tend to take pity on them when they hear their story.

CombatEngineer30.Title: combat engineer
CombatEngineer30.Description:
This colonist was recruited by the military as an engineer and set to work improving the navy's space shuttles. The harsh training taught them how to build and repair military vehicles and structures.

One mission left This colonist with pyrophobia and a strong desire to avoid plants.
CombatEngineer30.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +6; Intellectual +3; Shooting +4; Social -3; Cooking -2; Medicine +2; Crafting +2

CombatEngineer4.Title: combat engineer
CombatEngineer4.Description: This colonist became a combat engineer. they built bases, fixed guns, and repaired vehicles for the army - when they wasn't shooting at people, that is.

CombatMedic82.Title: combat medic
CombatMedic82.Description:
After their home country entered a large-scale war, This colonist was drafted into the army as a combat medic.

their few years in the trenches trying to keep their fellow soldiers alive gave them an acute sense for first aid. Losing many friend has made them stoic and reserved.

CombatMedtech59.Title: combat medtech
CombatMedtech59.Description:
As a military medtech, This colonist's job was to fix and build anything they could get their hands on, from living people to machines and mechs.

Sent into dangerous areas, they never had a problem saving soldiers' lives and building the technology and machines needed to win.

CombatNegotiator31.Title: combat negotiator
CombatNegotiator31.Description:
After escaping their homeworld, This colonist took their skills to the stars.

they chose to operate as a hired gun, working for various rebel organizations, enslaved groups, and merchant enclaves. their specialty was negotiation in combat situations.

CommonerHeir5.Title: commoner heir
CommonerHeir5.Description:
This colonist was a street urchin on a feudal steamworld.

        After they tried to steal food from the palace, the emperor, desperate to secure an heir, took them in and groomed them to be next in line for the throne.

CommonerLord45.Title: commoner lord
CommonerLord45.Description:
After years of training in martial arts and diplomacy, This colonist was eventually given land and subjects of their own to rule.

Because of This colonist's commoner heritage, the other lords disapproved. They framed them for a heinous crime, and the emperor had no choice but to exile them.

Computer80.Title: computer
Computer80.Description:
As a child, This colonist crafted complex algorithms. They were used as a "human computer" for most of their childhood. This left them socially awkward and rather scrawny.

        Despite the solitary confinement, This colonist developed a great imagination to occupy their idle time.

ComputerEngineer10.Title: computer engineer
ComputerEngineer10.Description:
Bored of their code-monkey office job and missing the glory days of the Academy, This colonist saw a commercial about the frontier where "only the strong survive".

With their wife Morgan, This colonist undertook a journey into the unknown.

ComputerEngineer36.Title: computer engineer
ComputerEngineer36.Description:
Leveraging their childhood experience, This colonist became a computer engineer. they also learned to craft delicate sculptures and random electronics for fun.

This colonist became fond of technology and mostly gave up on talking to people. Using computers as friends has left This colonist unable to care for others.

ComputerGeek62.Title: computer geek
ComputerGeek62.Description:
This colonist spent most of their childhood on their computer, typing away, never knowing when to get up and eat.

they had a very narrow interest: hacking cryptosleep safety protocols.

ConArtist80.Title: con artist
ConArtist80.Description: This colonist never created anything in their life. they did, however, prove to be a natural at getting others to give them what they had created.

ConceptualArtist39.Title: conceptual artist
ConceptualArtist39.Description:
This colonist was well-known in art circles on their home world for their unique and creative conceptual artworks.

Nobody was sure exactly what They were trying to communicate, but their pieces were highly valued by collectors.

ConstructionEngineer32.Title: construction engineer
ConstructionEngineer32.Description:
This colonist was a construction worker. they lead a team which built everything from office blocks to cathedrals.

their busy job and numerous nearby fast-food outlets meant they never cooked for themself.

ConstructionGrunt84.Title: construction grunt
ConstructionGrunt84.Description:
Growing up in their father's lab, This colonist was given the life of an intellectual elite. they got everything they desired, and price was never an object.

However This colonist did not partake in the luxury given to him. Instead, they pursued more physical, and - in their father's eyes - lower-class jobs.

ContractMiner86.Title: contract miner
ContractMiner86.Description: This colonist moved from job to job, extracting minerals and ancient valuables in tunnels and strip-mines. The work was tough and dirty, but they found it rewarding.

ConventChild16.Title: convent child
ConventChild16.Description: The child of an illicit affair, This colonist was brought up by ascetics in a medieval convent. they learned the value of hard work and submission, but was taught that technology is heretical and violence immoral.

CoreDilettante33.Title: core dilettante
CoreDilettante33.Description:
This colonist spent their formative years on a glitterworld in the core region, where they and their friends pursued lives of idle pleasure.

As they grew up, they began to find the life of ease unfulfilling. they decided to look for a more challenging path.

CoreworldJeweler19.Title: coreworld jeweler
CoreworldJeweler19.Description: After This colonist had completed all of their surgeries, they found that they had a lot of time and energy to dedicate to their passion: trinket crafting. they spent years perfecting their art as a jeweler, then left their home world to sell their wares across the galaxy.

CoreworldStudent50.Title: coreworld student
CoreworldStudent50.Description: Born a male named Alex, This colonist didn't fit in well with the other boys. When very young, they preferred creative pursuits, such as crafting jewelry, over sports. they felt they had the wrong body. Luckily, their family and friends supported their sex reassignment; as a teen, they underwent surgery to become a female.

CorpBredStudent54.Title: corp-bred student
CorpBredStudent54.Description:
This colonist was bred to become an executive for the space exploration corporation that owned their home planet. their family had been working for that corporation for four generations.

At age five, they enrolled at the corporate academy where they learned loyalty and ruthlessness. This colonist excelled in finding diplomatic solutions where others would need violence.

CorporateBuilder58.Title: corporate builder
CorporateBuilder58.Description:
Even as they stewed in their own wasted potential, This colonist found they had a knack for moving objects quickly. It was just what the planetary mega-corps wanted in their construction divisions.

Unfortunately, the monotonous work erased their remaining creative impulses.

CorporateDrone10.Title: corporate drone
CorporateDrone10.Description:
This colonist worked in a very large office complex along with thousands of other suited drones.

The work itself consisted of endless organizational drudgery and pointless meetings, punctuated by the occasional performance review.

CorporateFixer36.Title: corporate fixer
CorporateFixer36.Description:
This colonist was a fixer for an energy corporation. they work required knowing when to push, when to pull, when to back down and when to strike. The job fit their natural lack of empathy.

While violence was unusual, This colonist stayed prepared for anything.

CorporateManager76.Title: corporate manager
CorporateManager76.Description:
This colonist worked in a massive open-plan office, ensuring that their assigned team of workers stayed mostly on-task.

The job was intensely political. In order to advance, This colonist learned how to arrange things so they could take credit for work done by almost anyone.

CorporateSlave22.Title: corporate slave
CorporateSlave22.Description:
This colonist grew up in a colony owned by a large glitterworld corporation. All children had virtual reality devices attached by force, and were raised in a brutal digital world.

Constantly forced to fight others for the entertainment of the wealthy, gunplay and tactics became the center of This colonist's universe.

CorpResearcher71.Title: corp researcher
CorpResearcher71.Description:
This colonist was sold to a corporation and put to work as a corporate slave doing scientific research.

Unable to adapt to the social politics of their workplace, they buried themself in their work and failed to progress up the corporate ladder. Every day, they yearned to be left alone.

CorpResearcher93.Title: corp researcher
CorpResearcher93.Description: This colonist was a leading researcher for a massive space exploration corporation.

CorpStudent95.Title: corp student
CorpStudent95.Description:
De Dion was bred to become an executive officer for the large space trading corporation that owned their home planet. their family had been working for that corporation for seven generations.

At age six, they started to study at the corporate academy, where they became a loyal follower and a ruthless executive.

CosmeticReject64.Title: traveling handywoman
CosmeticReject64.Description: The glitterworld audience wasn't yet ready for This colonist's Vidtube series with all of its spanners and hammers and planners - that kind of work's for mechanoids, they said! Undeterred, they set out for the stars, in search of people who would appreciate their skills. The wildlife out there looks scary, though...

CosmeticSurgeon36.Title: cosmetic surgeon
CosmeticSurgeon36.Description:
This colonist had a terrible bedside manner due to their abrasiveness. they often bullied their patients into getting cosmetic surgery. they made a lot of money this way.

While very studious and careful in their work, they never had to lift a finger doing domestic chores.

CostumeCrafter41.Title: costume crafter
CostumeCrafter41.Description:
By day, This colonist was an office worker on a midworld. At night, they designed and built elaborate monster costumes for science fiction conventions.

they learned a great deal about sewing. Unfortunately this came at the cost of being able to cook anything more complex than an instant meal.

Counselor26.Title: counselor
Counselor26.Description: A terrifying trauma when This colonist was a young adult caused them to develop a serious eating disorder. With counseling they learned to have a healthier relationship with food, and decided to put their new skills to use helping others overcome their emotional problems.

CountryChild95.Title: country child
CountryChild95.Description: This colonist was raised up to fear God and love their country. They were a genuine backwoods kid. they always worked hard to earn respect rather than demanding it.

CountryLordling92.Title: country lordling
CountryLordling92.Description:
This colonist grew up in a noble family's manor in the outer country. their early years were full of lessons in horseback riding, politics, and religion.

This colonist and their friends found many ways to break the rules and have fun in the fields and forests.

CowFarmer39.Title: cow farmer
CowFarmer39.Description:
This colonist grew up on a rimworld, under the tyranny of their father, who forced them to work every day on the farm. they dreamed of escaping their father and exploring the universe.

One day, when the trade ship was overhead, they stowed away among the goods in the launch pods, and escaped into space.

CraftShaper37.Title: craft shaper
CraftShaper37.Description:
This colonist locked themself in their studio for years, ordering delivery food to save time on cooking.

Eventually, their creations brought them the highest honor on Semantic World: Permission to materialize any design in minutes using the most advanced technologies.

CrashBaby32.Title: crash baby
CrashBaby32.Description: As a baby, This colonist was the only survivor of a deadly spacecraft crash. A passing tribe discovered them in the wreckage and adopted them.

CrimeBossChild39.Title: crime boss' child
CrimeBossChild39.Description:
This colonist was adopted child of a notorious crime boss. They were taught all facets of the family business, from smuggling to inventive ways of killing.

When the family was attacked, their father ordered them to hide in a secret cryptosleep vault.

CrimeLord10.Title: crime lord
CrimeLord10.Description:
Through brutality and cruelty, This colonist rose to become a crime lord.

they relied less on their fists and more on their guns. their reputation spread quickly due to their cold-bloodedness and ruthless methods.

CriminalKingpin36.Title: criminal kingpin
CriminalKingpin36.Description:
This colonist discovered their gift - people did what they said, when they said it. Taking advantage of this, they set off for the rimworlds to make a name for themself in the criminal underworld.

Having people do things for them taught them to avoid manual labor at all costs.

CriminalSurgeon99.Title: criminal surgeon
CriminalSurgeon99.Description: Being near many injured fellow criminals, This colonist took it upon themself to work on them. Although many people died, they did get better at using knives.

CropFarmer17.Title: crop farmer
CropFarmer17.Description: This colonist ran a crop farm. they analyzed soil, agricultural equipment, weather patterns, and price trends to optimize the planting and harvesting of massive crop fields.

CultChild3.Title: cult child
CultChild3.Description:
This colonist was born into a powerful cult which shunned advanced technology and believed that all illness could be cured by cleansing the soul through sacred art.

After their first glimpse of the outside world, they decided to run away.

CuriousChild33.Title: curious child
CuriousChild33.Description:
This colonist was more interested in the systems and patterns of the world rather than its inhabitants. their social skills suffered.

This colonist came to understand that all things are part of the whole, and to destroy part would be to destroy all.

CynapseCustomAdulthood.Title: hermit
CynapseCustomAdulthood.Description: This colonist spent almost all of their time indoors, away from other humans. To survive, they trained and sold messenger rats.

CynapseCustomChildhood.Title: tinkerer
CynapseCustomChildhood.Description: This colonist spent most of their time disassembling and reassembling electronic devices in order to figure out how they function. This colonist became so preoccupied with their tinkering that they forgot to develop social relationships with other humans.

DataDecoder39.Title: data decoder
DataDecoder39.Description:
Born on a glitterworld, This colonist was very interested in the process of documenting information, and quickly became senior glitterpedia recorder.

They were effective at self-study, but they lacked social experience.

DedicatedStudent12.Title: dedicated student
DedicatedStudent12.Description:
The child of a wealthy manufacturer, This colonist was pampered from an early age. they developed an affinity for reading and art, and a distaste for menial chores.

A revolution brought their father's businesses under state control. Penniless, This colonist worked hard to complete their education.

DeepSpaceMiner3.Title: deep space miner
DeepSpaceMiner3.Description: This colonist did the sweaty, grimy work of pulling metal out of asteroids on a deep space rig. they used their hands-on industrial skills daily - and wasn't bad in a bar fight either.

DeepSpaceSurveyor1.Title: deep space surveyor
DeepSpaceSurveyor1.Description:
This colonist was a deep space surveyor. they studied which worlds were the most suitable for colonization.

their expeditions were met by hostile natives, green-painted space-women, and wannabe Greek gods. Surviving many firefights, they learned to build rudimentary lathes and rock cannons to fend off enemies.

Defector78.Title: defector
Defector78.Description:
Early in their adulthood, This colonist decided to leave the oppressive dictatorship where they lived. their defection was not well-received, and agents were sent out after them.

they spent years on the run, treating their own wounds so no doctor could betray them. The ordeal made them bitter and untrusting.

Defector95.Title: defector
Defector95.Description:
This colonist decided to leave the oppressive dictatorship where they lived. their defection was not well-received, and agents were sent after them.

they spent years on the run. Since they could trust no doctor, they treated their own wounds. The ordeal made them bitter and untrusting.
Defector95.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +3; Shooting +4; Melee +2; Social -2; Medicine +4; Crafting +3

DefenseLawyer71.Title: defense lawyer
DefenseLawyer71.Description:
This colonist found that they could make more money with a quick word than a blaster. Seeking a job where their silver tongue could be useful, they turned to the law.

they often defended the illegal speeder racers they grew up with.

Delinquent13.Title: delinquent
Delinquent13.Description: This colonist spent most of their childhood behind bars. Following an unsuccessful escape attempt, They were pressed into the military.

Demolitionist39.Title: demolitionist
Demolitionist39.Description: This colonist manufactured and planted explosives used to breach enemy defenses. Dealing with explosives every day taught them to keep a level head and steady hand.

Deserter65.Title: deserter
Deserter65.Description: After countless battles for a cause they did not believe in, This colonist threw down their arms and deserted. This colonist lived in isolation, hunted by those they had deserted.

DesertRat47.Title: desert rat
DesertRat47.Description:
This colonist was born to a tribe of desert ascetics who wandered the endless wastes.

They sought a mythical substance they believed could liberate them from ignorance through psychedelic revelation - and usher in a new period of interstellar peace.

DestroyerGeneral26.Title: destroyer-general
DestroyerGeneral26.Description:
This colonist held the rank of Destroyer-General in a powerful midworld military.

They were known for their mastery of weapons, and was also a good ship pilot.

Digger31.Title: digger
Digger31.Description: This colonist labored in mines and caves, digging out spaces for storing items and hiding from threats. their work provided hiding spots for their friends on many occasions.

Digger66.Title: digger
Digger66.Description: This colonist carved living spaces and mined minerals from the sides of hills and mountains. they learned to feel at home picking through rock and shoring up cave walls.

DiplomatsChild97.Title: diplomat's child
DiplomatsChild97.Description:
This colonist was born in diplomatic family.

Travelling often, They were home-schooled and saw the world mostly through a computer.

DisasterSurvivor29.Title: disaster survivor
DisasterSurvivor29.Description: This colonist's planet collided with a small moon. Everything they knew as home was destroyed, and their entire family died. They were left in the ruins to fend for themself.

DisasterSurvivor65.Title: disaster survivor
DisasterSurvivor65.Description:
This colonist was uprooted when marauders attacked their family farm, destroying machinery and killing farmhands and beasts alike.

After the death of all they knew, They were left in the ruins to fend for themself.

DiscardedYouth93.Title: discarded youth
DiscardedYouth93.Description:
This colonist grew up isolated on a trash planet. A dumping ground for surrounding glitterworlds, it was a harsh home. As a baby, they sucked on the tap of a discarded nutrient paste dispenser for comfort.

In these desperate circumstances, against all odds, they survived - and thrived.

DischargedSoldier53.Title: discharged soldier
DischargedSoldier53.Description:
This colonist prostituted themself to fund their drug habits. As an escape, they joined the military and learned to fight.

Too smart for the army, they questioned and often disagreed with their superiors' decisions. This eventually led to their dishonorable discharge and left them with a chip on their shoulder.

DisciplinedFarmer28.Title: disciplined farmer
DisciplinedFarmer28.Description: This colonist was the younger of two sons on the family farm, a frontier plot that struggled to turn a profit. This colonist's father was a strict disciplinarian, constantly at their sons to work harder and keep quiet. This colonist burnt their hand making breakfast once and swore to cook only when their life was in danger.

DisgracedOfficer19.Title: disgraced officer
DisgracedOfficer19.Description:
This colonist was an officer in an imperial battalion. they developed the social and combat skills to do their job well and was respected by the men.

When their unit came under direct fire for the first time, This colonist fled to a bunker and hid. They were demoted and never escaped the disgrace.

DisplacedNoble67.Title: displaced noble
DisplacedNoble67.Description: Born on an urbworld to the ruler of three megacities, This colonist's prospects looked good - until a violent insurrection overthrew their family. Exile introduced This colonist to hard work and combat, but some high-born squeamishness remains.

DoomsdayPariah18.Title: doomsday pariah
DoomsdayPariah18.Description: This colonist managed to open a vault of otherworldly technology while scavenging a dig site. they unwittingly triggered a doomsday device that cleansed the planet of all life. More interested in the tech than human life, they boarded the vault's spacecraft and departed to find more relics to abuse.

DreadedBaby56.Title: dreaded baby
DreadedBaby56.Description: This colonist was found as a baby in a crashed spacecraft. According to the ship's records, they invented the nuclear device that powered their ship. Apparently, they also invented the sky and the hamburger, and is said to have fathered a race of tasty golden kittens.

DreadedDude58.Title: dreaded dude
DreadedDude58.Description:
Some followers say that This colonist and their crew of misfits found the fountain of youth, many, many centuries ago, and that they caused the extinction of the dinosaurs on many planets.

There's even a religion about them, somewhere, involving noodles and meatballs.

Dreamer79.Title: dreamer
Dreamer79.Description:
This colonist was an expressive child. they sang often, and made friends very easily, be they young or old, male or female.

they hated fighting, but when made angry, they could be dangerous. their temper was quick.

Drifter67.Title: drifter
Drifter67.Description:
This colonist never figured out what to do with their life. they traveled often, taking up casual work wherever they found it.

they also occasionally worked on a novel that they knew would be a bestseller - just as soon as they could find a publisher who was interested.

DromedaryKnight37.Title: dromedary knight
DromedaryKnight37.Description:
Having caught the eye of their people's Sand King, This colonist was trained in the Sandy Boomrat fighting technique.

Always with a camel to carry their things, they served their sand people faithfully.

Drudge9.Title: drudge
Drudge9.Description:
This colonist was never sure what they wanted to do with their life. they spent most of their time doing low-wage jobs and wondering what their future would be like.

they entertained themself with space sims and survival games, dreaming of one day being somewhere more interesting.

DrugLieutenant98.Title: drug lieutenant
DrugLieutenant98.Description:
This colonist worked the drug trade under kingpin Grady Loughman. they had their men sell drugs when it was profitable, and fight the other cartels when the government came around.

their social skills kept them on top of the political game, and they always had servants to cook and clean.

DrugMule80.Title: drug mule
DrugMule80.Description:
Raised in an orphanage, This colonist turned towards the gang life at age ten.

They were exploited by the local gang as a drug mule to traffic "substance F" across rival gang territory. they took a bullet or two.

DustyFarmHand75.Title: dusty farm hand
DustyFarmHand75.Description:
From the time This colonist could walk, they helped take care of the animals and crops that their people tended in their arid homeland.

The work toughened them, but left little time for intellectual activities.

Empath47.Title: empath
Empath47.Description:
This colonist was an incredibly empathetic child, so much that They were totally overwhelmed by simple social interactions. Once, they stepped on a bug and felt so guilty they cried for an hour.

This colonist did try to use a gun one time, but it went very poorly, as the loud noise made them flinch uncontrollably.

EnergeticPopIdol61.Title: energetic pop idol
EnergeticPopIdol61.Description:
This colonist grew up on a glitterworld, training in rapier arts and singing. they spent several years as an energetic teen pop idol.

However, they decided that the music and modeling industries were not paying them enough attention, so they left.

EnergyResearcher89.Title: energy researcher
EnergyResearcher89.Description: This colonist was working on an idea for rapid communication over long distances. they made an error which destroyed their lab and several nearby buildings. they fled the planet to escape the authorities.

Engineer40.Title: engineer
Engineer40.Description: This colonist found a job as a tinkering engineer on the trading hub planet Irithir. Tough local traders forced them to learn negotiation skills, and they made good profits selling refurbished weapons and tools.

EngineeredPilot75.Title: engineered pilot
EngineeredPilot75.Description:
After their province was besieged by one of its neighbors, This colonist volunteered for a generic modification program that created pilots for the very fighter craft that they had helped develop. The modifications allowed them to pilot the ship, but also made them less able to focus on the people around him.

By this time, people were calling them "Squirrel."

EnvoyOfTheStars19.Title: envoy of the stars
EnvoyOfTheStars19.Description:
This colonist entered the diplomatic corps. Honor and tradition were the values they took with them on every mission.

their prestigious position distanced them from backbreaking manual labor, allowing them to focus on their wordsmithing abilities. they left the blacksmithing to others.

EscapedConvict90.Title: escaped convict
EscapedConvict90.Description: This colonist denies involvement in the crimes that brought about their incarceration in a brutal penal colony. they escaped by tunneling beneath the perimeter using modified cutlery.

Evangelist39.Title: evangelist
Evangelist39.Description: As a youth, This colonist experienced a religious awakening. they decided to spend the rest of their life spreading the word of their deity, the beauty of its culture, and its unusual medical tradition.

Excavator55.Title: excavator
Excavator55.Description: This colonist worked at dig sites, extracting valuable items and materials from ancient compacted ruins. they learned how to spot valuables in the ground and use a variety of excavating tools.

ExecutiveOfficer5.Title: executive officer
ExecutiveOfficer5.Description:
This colonist was an executive officer for a large space trading corporation. After a failed attempt at manipulating their way up the corporate ladder, They were framed for the rape and murder of another executive and their family.

They were found guilty. However, because of their family's influence, They were exiled instead of put to death.

ExiledPrince58.Title: exiled prince
ExiledPrince58.Description:
A member of a royal family, This colonist was exiled for shaming their family.

Living in a foreign land, mostly alone, they spent most of their time making huts and houses to live in. they found little time in an average day for enjoyment, and lost all their friends and family.

ExiledResearcher44.Title: exiled researcher
ExiledResearcher44.Description: This colonist's love of robotics was not appreciated in their technophobic empire. The High Cardinal of the system excommunicated her, and They were never allowed to return.

ExoticChef96.Title: exotic chef
ExoticChef96.Description:
This colonist has always gone overboard when it comes to food. they is always seeking new and exotic ingredients.

their quest for ingredients has brought them into some close calls with local flora and fauna.

ExpertHandyman8.Title: expert handyman
ExpertHandyman8.Description: This colonist worked as a traveling engineer. they fixed things ranging from a simple communications array to the intricate software harness enveloping their ship's AI persona. Nothing is beyond repair for them.

Explorer49.Title: explorer
Explorer49.Description: This colonist traveled from planet to planet, gathering samples, stories, and research. they hoped one day to compile a record of every animal, plant, mineral, and machine and device in known space: The Complete Traveler's Guide to the RimWorlds.

ExplorerWriter10.Title: explorer-writer
ExplorerWriter10.Description:
This colonist traveled from planet to planet, gathering samples, stories, and research.

their goal was to bring together enough knowledge to make a survival guide for future generations.
ExplorerWriter10.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +3; Plants +3; Intellectual +4; Cooking +2; Medicine +3; Crafting +2

ExplosivesExpert26.Title: explosives expert
ExplosivesExpert26.Description: This colonist was an explosive engineer employed in mines. they took their job very seriously and was well-versed in the technicalities - so much so that they refused to demean themself by helping with the clean-up once their carefully-calculated explosion was complete.

FactionLeader74.Title: faction leader
FactionLeader74.Description:
Early in their adulthood, This colonist found themself surrounded by a gaggle of low-lifes.

For fun, they gathered them and lead them to a certain death. they knew then that they had the talent to realize their ambitions of leadership.

FactoryDrone58.Title: factory drone
FactoryDrone58.Description:
This colonist grew up in a large factory city on an industrial world.

Since poverty was rampant and food scarce, they worked for whatever wages they could get. This wasn't an easy life, but This colonist never shied away from a hard day's work.

FactoryWorker58.Title: factory worker
FactoryWorker58.Description: This colonist did menial, unskilled work in an industrial factory. their job also included caring for the mules and horses which transported the goods.

FallenOfficial12.Title: fallen official
FallenOfficial12.Description: This colonist was an official for an autocratic government. When their superiors demanded they participate in atrocities, This colonist resigned and escaped from their homeworld with nothing but the clothes on their back.

FallenProdigy40.Title: fallen prodigy
FallenProdigy40.Description:
This colonist was born on a glitterworld falling into chaos. their father was killed in action.

they struggled for a scholarship at Utmaior Academy and had to prove their right to be there. A child genius, They were bullied as a charity case and couldn't make friends with the other kids.

FarmBoy64.Title: farm boy
FarmBoy64.Description:
This colonist worked on their family's farm, looking after the animals and treating them when they were injured. Preferring hands-on tasks and the outdoors, they avoided softer jobs that might have kept them cooped up inside.

they enjoyed this lonely work, and tended to stay out of people's way and do their own thing.

FarmerBoy88.Title: farmer boy
FarmerBoy88.Description:
This colonist's parents died in a fire when They were seven. they grew up on their uncle's farm, plowing fields and doing manual labor.

they could not bear answering questions about their parents, so they replaced social contact with hard work.

FarmersDaughter81.Title: farmer's daughter
FarmersDaughter81.Description:
This colonist grew up on their parents' vineyard. they spent their youth exploring the land and making friends with various bugs and insects.

Having heard stories about all the fascinating things out there in the universe, they always dreamed of venturing out to see it for themself.

FarmersSon20.Title: farmer's son
FarmersSon20.Description:
This colonist spent much of their childhood learning biome farming. In their biome they kept animals to investigate which would cope best in the alien environment.

Due to this, the travel restrictions and oxygen rationing system, they rarely got to meet anyone from outside their family.

FarmHand2.Title: farm hand
FarmHand2.Description:
This colonist was born on a farm on a rimworld.

Everything was taken care of by the few members of the farm, including This colonist. This helped them build independence, spirit, and a well-rounded character.

FarmKid60.Title: farm kid
FarmKid60.Description: This colonist grew up on their family's beef farm. they enjoyed working the fields and taking care of the animals.

FarmMechanic1.Title: farm mechanic
FarmMechanic1.Description: Growing up on a farming planet, This colonist spent their time learning about the automated machinery that grew and harvested the multitude of crops.

FearfulChef49.Title: fearful chef
FearfulChef49.Description:
This colonist was a excellent chef who worked in a high-end restaurant.

One day, they left the stove on, and accidentally burned down the whole building. This event shook them so much that they swore to never touch a stove again.

FelineScientist76.Title: feline scientist
FelineScientist76.Description: This colonist became a renowned scientist in the field of felines. Wanting the best for their animals and specializing in selective breeding, they set out on a journey to find the perfect breeding grounds for their cats.

FeralChild85.Title: feral child
FeralChild85.Description:
This colonist and their family lived a hard but prosperous life along with their fellow colonists on an outlying rimworld.

One day, a group of mechanoids attacked, killing everyone aside from This colonist. they then lived alone in the desert until a group of raiders found him.

FeralChild96.Title: feral child
FeralChild96.Description:
Abandoned on an animal planet as a small child with nought but a blanket with a name embroidered on it, This colonist made themself one with the wilderness.

When They were 13, they encountered a team of mineral surveyors, who "offered" them passage off of the planet.

FerventResearcher72.Title: fervent researcher
FerventResearcher72.Description:
