As a young adult, This colonist was sure that their planet and its people were nearing their time of transcendence.

A firm belief that their research would be the catalyst drove them to increasingly alarming acts as bureaucrats and bioethics committees worked to stall their progress.

FeudalFarmBoy0.Title: feudal farm boy
FeudalFarmBoy0.Description:
This colonist was the son of a medieval farmer, and was expected to follow in their footsteps. They were brought up as a kind, well trained farm boy.

they lived in an unusual feudal kingdom which co-existed with a midworld society which was itself well-known for genetic manipulation.

FeudalLordling56.Title: feudal lordling
FeudalLordling56.Description:
This colonist grew up on a feudal world that was part of a multi-planet empire. As the son of a high lord, they enjoyed many privileges.

they learned to maneuver in both the political landscape and in close quarters combat.

FeyCustomAdulthood.Title: game master
FeyCustomAdulthood.Description: This colonist spent all their time running tabletop role-playing games as a way to connect socially with others. The game changed every year, and other players always loved their worldbuilding and stories.

FeyCustomChildhood.Title: wargame fanatic
FeyCustomChildhood.Description: Growing up sheltered in an urbworld archology, This colonist distracted themself by playing wargames and painting miniatures. While They were never very good at the game itself, it helped to connect them with others.

FighterController67.Title: fighter controller
FighterController67.Description: During the Zartha crisis, This colonist fought across many worlds, providing the vital link between the ground and the air as a fighter controller. During the campaign, they saw friends injured and killed. This mental trauma haunts their dreams to this day, but their aim remains sharp.

Firebomber51.Title: firebomber
Firebomber51.Description:
This colonist piloted a small fighter-bomber design specialized in spreading incendiary gel on flammable targets.

Conditioned to love the sight of a target lighting up, they grew to love fire in all its forms - war, cooking, and even for cauterizing wounds in the hospital.

FireKeeper44.Title: fire keeper
FireKeeper44.Description: This colonist was responsible for keeping the tribe's fire going. they took this responsibility very seriously.

FireScarredChild1.Title: fire-scarred child
FireScarredChild1.Description: This colonist was an active child who lived an uneventful childhood until they fell into a fire and suffered horrific burns to their hands and arms. Although the scars have faded, they can't bear to be in close proximity to fire.

Flaneur30.Title: flaneur
Flaneur30.Description:
This colonist strolled and sipped their way through the streets and cafes of their world, pursuing freedom at every turn, never becoming attached.

Through all this time, they remained distrustful of others. And never took an order from anyone.

ForestChild83.Title: forest child
ForestChild83.Description:
When They were a baby, This colonist's mother went insane and left them in the woods.

Raised by wild people, This colonist was known for both loving and killing animals.

Forester96.Title: forester
Forester96.Description: This colonist grew and harvested forests. they understood both the practical challenges of soil types, wind, and rain, as well as the long-term planning of forest growth.

ForestProwler15.Title: forest prowler
ForestProwler15.Description: This colonist led a band of wild men in the forest. They foraged for food, hunted, and sometimes murdered more civilized people to steal their shiny objects.

FoundryApprentice76.Title: foundry apprentice
FoundryApprentice76.Description: This colonist grew up as an apprentice in the foundries of an industrial world. This experience gave them metalworking skills and strong muscles, but stunted their artistic development.

Framer37.Title: framer
Framer37.Description: This colonist was responsible for erecting structures for their fellow tribespeople to live in. This included both temporary structures for nomadic travel, and permanent settlements. Gathering building materials from local plant life was part of the job.

Freethinker38.Title: freethinker
Freethinker38.Description:
This colonist grew up on a toxic world with tyrannical leaders. While the rest of the population was high on the planet's narcotic exports, they joined a rebel militia.

After a risky operation against the regime failed, they fled the planet, staying alive by threatening mutual annihilation with a planetcracker antimatter bomb.

FrightenedChild43.Title: frightened child
FrightenedChild43.Description:
This colonist grew up with a laundry list of phobias and neuroses. they feared, among other things, doctors and foodborne pathogens.

As a result, they learned to cook and care for themself, but many of their fears dog them in adulthood.

FrontierMarshal27.Title: frontier marshal
FrontierMarshal27.Description:
This colonist was the marshal of their colony. they tried to honorably uphold the law, but the corrupt local mayor killed their family and left them for dead.

After regaining their health, This colonist arrested the mayor. they left their homeworld and started a new life working to make a difference in the universe.

FrontierMarshal54.Title: frontier marshal
FrontierMarshal54.Description:
This colonist inherited a sense of duty from their father, and began a law enforcement career on their frontier homeworld.

they tried to uphold the law with honor, but the corruption and greed of local government officials often discouraged him.

Fugitive4.Title: fugitive
Fugitive4.Description:
This colonist rebelled against the corporation they worked for. they failed, and was forced them to go on the run.

They were always on the move, always leaving everything behind. they tried to gain supporters for their cause, but failed due to their poor social skills.

FurnitureBuilder83.Title: furniture builder
FurnitureBuilder83.Description: This colonist grew up near forests. they spent their time building beautiful furniture for wealthy glitterworld clients.

GalacticPage37.Title: galactic page
GalacticPage37.Description:
This colonist served the high admiral of a space fleet. they learned the ways of court, including etiquette and speechcraft.

In their feudal society, it was considered a great honor to serve a man of such prestige.

GameDeveloper95.Title: game developer
GameDeveloper95.Description:
This colonist was an independent game developer.

After an early success, their career quickly degenerated into a circus of misguided ideas, deals gone wrong, and desperate, failed PR stunts.

GameFanatic86.Title: game fanatic
GameFanatic86.Description:
This colonist was a fanatical gamer who learned to survive in virtual reality games.

Once, while attempting to prove their skills in the real world, They were abducted by a criminal scientist and experimented on. they escaped, but the experience stayed with him.

GameTester77.Title: game tester
GameTester77.Description:
Making a new life on a barely-livable planet after nuclear war, This colonist was able to fulfill their desires with money borrowed from their father.

they loved playing a particular colony simulator. their favorite thing to do in the game was to build elaborate hospitals. Spending most of their time playing, they forgot horrors of war and their need for revenge.

GangBoss49.Title: gang boss
GangBoss49.Description:
To survive, This colonist's gang often had to rob trade ships for food and supplies. Sometimes they had to kill the guards. Sometimes they had to kill the police who arrived to stop him.

After years of this, they became one of the most-wanted criminals in the local empire.

GangMember16.Title: gang member
GangMember16.Description:
This colonist grew up without parents. their whole life was spent alone, fighting for survival on the streets.

No matter how hard it became to survive, they never gave up.

GangMember83.Title: gang member
GangMember83.Description:
This colonist grew up homeless on an urbworld. They were forced to fight and struggle for everything, making them hard and ruthless long before adulthood.

This colonist would have stayed in those streets, had they not been injured in a shootout and had their body confiscated for use by one of the worldwide city's ruling corporations.

GangSoldier39.Title: gang soldier
GangSoldier39.Description:
Living for many years between three raider settlements, This colonist persevered through many challenges: a spacecraft implosion, cryptostasis, crashlanding on a miserable dustball of a planet, and nursing an old man back to health, and many of battles.

they eventually took control of a violent gang.

Gardener99.Title: gardener
Gardener99.Description: This colonist worked at the mansion of a powerful family, tending the lavish gardens as part of a team of servants.

Gatherer70.Title: gatherer
Gatherer70.Description: Using their knowledge of plants, roots, and berries, This colonist could find food in even the most barren landscapes. they stayed away from animals.

GeneticEngineer89.Title: genetic engineer
GeneticEngineer89.Description:
This colonist carried out their first genetic experiments on farm animals. they soon grew to become quite skilled in all forms of genetic engineering.

A horrifying lab accident left them with a mortal fear of rodents.

GeneticScientist66.Title: genetic scientist
GeneticScientist66.Description: After the war they joined a genetic engineering firm. they worked on enhancements for humans and livestock. their experience in inflicting and healing wounds was very beneficial to their work, but they developed a black sense of humor. This made social gatherings awkward.

Geologist66.Title: geologist
Geologist66.Description:
This colonist worked with miners and cave-diggers, identifying rock types and natural formations.

During their years underground they also gained experience repairing drilling machines and other technical equipment.

Gigolo30.Title: gigolo
Gigolo30.Description: This colonist was used for their body by hundreds of customers in brothels on several planets. they gained some mental marks and a special kind of street smarts.

Gigolo68.Title: gigolo
Gigolo68.Description:
This colonist sold themself into slavery for money to purchase boomrat pizza. They were then traded to the Zeglar colonies, where they worked as a male prostitute.

In a fluke event, they managed to join other escaping slaves as they hijacked a ship. After fighting with the captain of the slave crew over the last piece of boomrat pizza, This colonist was sent off the ship in an escape pod.

GlitterworldEmpath26.Title: glitterworld empath
GlitterworldEmpath26.Description: This colonist found it easy to relate to others and mediate conflict. They were selected to train as an empath. The training intensified their natural abilities, but they became unable to cause others pain.

GlitterworldKid85.Title: glitterworld kid
GlitterworldKid85.Description: The daughter of a glitterworld influencer and his genetically-engineered 'perfect mate', This colonist grew up learning to rub shoulders with the cream of the crop - though they always preferred their personal space, reading books and tinkering with tech.

GlitterworldNerd20.Title: glitterworld nerd
GlitterworldNerd20.Description:
This colonist loved technology from the day They were born. they had a mechanoid companion which they tried to modify.

their obsession with technology meant that they never appreciated arts or culture.

GlitterworldOfficer60.Title: glitterworld officer
GlitterworldOfficer60.Description:
Though glitterworlds are peaceful places, they often remain prepared for war. This colonist's unit rarely saw any real action.

Though they pursued their artistic hobbies, their subordinates preferred to entertain themselves by brawling, so This colonist got good at breaking up fights.

GlitterworldRoyal24.Title: glitterworld royal
GlitterworldRoyal24.Description:
This colonist grew up in a glitterworld royal household. They were groomed from a young age to marry into another planet's royal family.

Unfortunately, their crooked teeth made them undesirable to suitors, so they became bitter and resentful.

GlitterworldSurgeon15.Title: glitterworld surgeon
GlitterworldSurgeon15.Description:
This colonist worked as a surgeon on a world mostly free of disease and human suffering, so their job focused on elaborate and creative cosmetic surgeries. 

they understands human biology, deeply, but has never had to remove a tumour — or a bullet.

Gnomebiologist96.Title: gnomebiologist
Gnomebiologist96.Description:
This colonist was a xenobiology professor in a glitterworld university. they went to conferences and managed an art gallery.

However, they never stopped sculpting yard gnomes, and considers this to be their true profession.

GNomeSculptor34.Title: g-nome sculptor
GNomeSculptor34.Description:
This colonist was engineered in a lab as part of the G-nome Project. They were implanted at birth with encyclopedic knowledge of all aspects of xenobiology.

The G-nome scientists nicknamed them This colonist and occupied them with sculpting. they developed a love of sculpting gnomes and gnome accessories.

GovernmentAgent61.Title: government agent
GovernmentAgent61.Description:
This colonist worked for the government against rebel groups and excelled in this capacity. During their training They were taught firearms, melee combat and medical skills.

Having grown up in a war-ravaged city, dirt, blood and dead bodies don't bother them and they sees no reason to clean them up.

GraphicDesigner33.Title: graphic designer
GraphicDesigner33.Description: This colonist' interest in artistic expression led them to become a designer. their eye for detail made them a reasonably well-known artist on their planet, though their meticulousness often led them to spend too much time perfecting a single project.

Guardian55.Title: guardian
Guardian55.Description:
After they learned what truly matters in life, This colonist changed for the better. they learned to work hard and protect the things that matter - not money or material things, but friends and loved ones.

they became a professional guardian.

GunDealer14.Title: gun dealer
GunDealer14.Description:
This colonist traded high-tech firearms between warring factions.

Over time, they became very skilled at conducting product demonstrations and negotiating profitable deals.

Gunfighter51.Title: gunfighter
Gunfighter51.Description:
This colonist was a deadly shot. Peace wasn't for him. they found their family among the brothers and sisters that they spent years fighting alongside.

After most of those close to them died, they once again set off to lend their gun to those who needed it - or those who could pay.

GunKid30.Title: gun kid
GunKid30.Description:
Growing up in a urbworld, This colonist never had it easy. Every day was a struggle and pollution, hunger, and gangs of older kids.

In the little space they had to themself, they studied their passion - guns, combat tactics, and war history.

Gymnast48.Title: gymnast
Gymnast48.Description:
This colonist was a professional gymnast at an early age. Thanks to their skills, They were able to enroll in a glitterworld university.

Because of the lack of career opportunities in gymnastics, they left the university unemployed and carrying an enormous debt.

HackerKid98.Title: hacker kid
HackerKid98.Description:
Born on a high-tech world, This colonist learned to hack computers at a young age. 

Spending many hours tinkering alone made them very good with machines, but very bad with humans.

HackerProdigy84.Title: hacker prodigy
HackerProdigy84.Description: This colonist was raised as the only child of wealthy surgeons. After being pressured into accepting a medical apprenticeship, they snapped. they seized their inheritance and went underground to learn how to exploit computer networks. they quickly became one of the most feared hackers on their home planet.

HeadButler50.Title: head butler
HeadButler50.Description:
This colonist was the head servant in a royal house.

they managed the other servants to ensure the lord's will was done, even before the lord knew what it was.

HeadjackAddict4.Title: headjack addict
HeadjackAddict4.Description: Plugged in to the computer via head-jack for days at a time, This colonist found they preferred the company of computers to that of people or pets.

Healer35.Title: healer
Healer35.Description:
This colonist took the time to admire the beauty of the world.

their passive-aggressiveness surfaced once in a while, but they tried to adapt to their changing life.

Healer46.Title: healer
Healer46.Description: After their tribe's elder healer was killed in a raid, This colonist took on the role. they spent their days scrounging up herbs and mineral compounds from the nearby area to use in surprisingly effective remedies.

HearthTender66.Title: hearth tender
HearthTender66.Description: While the others were out hunting and foraging, This colonist would stay at home to cook and take care of the young and sick.

HedgeFundManager54.Title: hedge fund manager
HedgeFundManager54.Description:
A top hedge fund manager on a teeming urbworld, This colonist's portfolio grew rapidly as they charmed clients with a sweet voice and devious intent. When the deal turned out too good to be true, They were forced to flee the planet with a bounty on their head.

As they traveled the stars they found a passion in the arts, making masterpieces fit for high society customers.

HelpDeskWorker31.Title: help desk worker
HelpDeskWorker31.Description:
Due to their affinity for technology and desire to help others, This colonist jumped at the chance to take a job at a help desk.

Unfortunately, the job's soul-crushing after-effects lasted longer than their enthusiasm.

Herbalist54.Title: herbalist
Herbalist54.Description: This colonist lived in the forest near a village. Though many of the villagers feared them, sick villagers would come to them to purchase salves and poultices made from the herbs they grew in their garden. They were happy to help them — for a price.

Herder19.Title: herder
Herder19.Description: This colonist tended the muffalo herds, keeping them safe from predators and treating sick animals. It was quiet work, but they enjoyed being away from people.

Herder33.Title: herder
Herder33.Description: This colonist herded a variety of animals to help feed and clothe their tribe while on the move. This colonist learned how to calm and direct the beasts, and how to hunt their own meals on the trail.

Hermit82.Title: hermit
Hermit82.Description: Worn out by the pressures of social interaction, This colonist left their crowded city to live a simple life in the wilderness. There, they spent their days alone, tending their garden and crafting the simple tools they needed to survive.

Herpetologist3.Title: herpetologist
Herpetologist3.Description:
After a terrible mining accident, This colonist set off into space in search of exotic new animal species.

they hoped to leave their past behind and find long-lived companions. they knew the pain of loss too well.

HexCellArtist91.Title: hex-cell artist
HexCellArtist91.Description:
This colonist crafted sculptures from spent hex-cells and traded them to a local museum for food.

After their popularity grew, They were approached by a pirate and abducted. The pirate kept them prisoner and forced them to create sculptures for sale.

Hideaway7.Title: hideaway
Hideaway7.Description: This colonist's overprotective parents encouraged them to stay at home nearly every day. Though they had a lot of time to read and pursue crafting hobbies, they never developed normal social skills.

HighBaroness37.Title: high baroness
HighBaroness37.Description:
This colonist was born as low-ranking royalty in a large imperial family.

They were placed In charge of running their home planet from an early age, and learned important political and cultural skills in that role.

HillbillyProdigy60.Title: hillbilly prodigy
HillbillyProdigy60.Description: Born on a cold rimworld inhabited mainly by furred xenohumans, This colonist grew up to the sound of bar fights and shootouts. Though their childhood was spent playing the banjo and working as a mechanic, their abnormal intelligence made them want something more; they entered medical school at a young age.

HiredAssassin37.Title: hired assassin
HiredAssassin37.Description: This colonist was a master thief, working mostly for organized crime. Over time, they made a name for themself and shifted their business into the paid "removal" of human threats.

HiredGun70.Title: hired gun
HiredGun70.Description:
This colonist always wanted to prove they could make a living without their parents' help. they did shady jobs that often involved pointing guns at innocent people.

they eventually made enough money to board a cheap freighter. they discovered why it was so cheap when it crashed.

HiredMuscle5.Title: hired muscle
HiredMuscle5.Description:
Knowing what life on the streets was truly like, This colonist slipped into police work. However, a particularly disturbing case ended with them beating the perpetrator to death.

Dishonorably discharged from their duties, they used their contacts and skills to find work as a thug for hire.

HistoryStudent12.Title: history student
HistoryStudent12.Description: As a child, This colonist learned many artistic forms including music and novel writing. As they grew older, they began to study legends from their home world - legends of the lizard-like beings at the center of their culture's folklore.

Housemate8.Title: housemate
Housemate8.Description: As an adult, This colonist kept house and cared for their children while their spouse worked.

HouseServant63.Title: house servant
HouseServant63.Description:
This colonist was a domestic servant to wealthy homeowners.

they got to know the kitchens and basements of their master's mansion well, but never did any work outside.

HouseServant86.Title: house servant
HouseServant86.Description:
This colonist was a low-level servant in a royal house.

they cleaned rooms and moved items as directed by the senior staff, while attempting to remain invisible to the lords and ladies of the house.

HumanComputer83.Title: human computer
HumanComputer83.Description: This colonist turned out to have an excellent memory and a gift for performing complex calculations in their head. An industrial-world dictator decided to employ This colonist to keep track of their state's finances and expenditure.

HumanTrafficker35.Title: human trafficker
HumanTrafficker35.Description:
This colonist stole children from their homes to sell them to interested buyers.

Over time, they lost what little moral sense they had left.

Hunter73.Title: hunter
Hunter73.Description:
This colonist was a master hunter.

they learned to track and trap any animal in the most dangerous of places, and had deep knowledge of many ingenious methods for taking down specific large animals.

Hunter74.Title: hunter
Hunter74.Description:
This colonist tracked, trapped and killed animals for their meat and leather.

This colonist used both ranged and melee weapons. Sometimes, they hunted alongside animals.

Hunter89.Title: hunter
Hunter89.Description: This colonist hunted wild animals to help feed their community. When times became tough, others looked to them as the one to help people through a tough season.

HunterOfTheKing53.Title: hunter of the king
HunterOfTheKing53.Description:
This colonist was forced to protect their colony in the name of the king after a mysterious outbreak of murderous genetically-modified wildlife.

Despite their best efforts, their kingdom was destroyed. This colonist developed PTSD, a hatred of animals and a bad case of technophobia. They were named for the place they found him.

HunterScavenger64.Title: hunter scavenger
HunterScavenger64.Description: Born to a family of raiders in the mudlands of Vinna, This colonist survived by scavenging food and resources from nearby settlements with their gang. They were the most ferocious of the bunch.

HypnocultLeader61.Title: hypnocult leader
HypnocultLeader61.Description:
Desiring to understand people, This colonist learned hypnotism and discovered their talent for the art.

they gathered followers and formed a cult around their vibrant personality. The authorities discovered their illegal operations, and This colonist fled before they could be arrested.

IcePlanetChild95.Title: ice planet child
IcePlanetChild95.Description:
Growing up on the frozen wastes of an ocean moon, This colonist only had animals and a few hard-bitten sailors as companions.

The lack of social interaction made them develop a interest in engineering - but they never developed any great fondness for humans.

IceworldSurvivor75.Title: iceworld survivor
IceworldSurvivor75.Description:
This colonist was born on an iceworld. Survival depended on staying together and building with nothing.

they got used to the cold. they never got used to dealing with those strange green things called plants.

IdealisticCadet64.Title: idealistic cadet
IdealisticCadet64.Description:
Raised in the military traditions of their forefathers, This colonist was taught from a young age that they would be a great leader and the hero of their family.

they excelled at their studies and graduated from the academy with honors.

IllegalShipwright76.Title: illegal shipwright
IllegalShipwright76.Description: There is a law that says that you're not allowed to put terawatt-range grasers on a cargo scow. Especially if you hide them under what looks like a communications dish for better ambush potential. This colonist discovered that there is great profit to be made, however, from those who are uninterested in these laws.

ImperialGeneral27.Title: imperial general
ImperialGeneral27.Description:
This colonist's thirst for power defined them. they quickly rose through the military ranks and soon attained the rank of general.

They were given the most challenging task - conquering distant and unexplored rimworlds. Victory here could even position them as a successor to the emperor.
ImperialGeneral27.SkillGainsJoined: Construction -2; Intellectual +4; Mining -3; Shooting +4; Melee +4; Social +5; Medicine +2

ImperialInquisitor53.Title: imperial inquisitor
ImperialInquisitor53.Description:
This colonist was an inquisitor in the imperial church's anti-heresy school.

This colonist hunted unorthodox thoughts wherever they could be found - art, music, code, even private conversations. Upon finding deviance, they exposed it to bring on the punishment of the collective. And they could always find the deviance if they looked hard enough.

ImperialPriest24.Title: imperial priest
ImperialPriest24.Description:
This colonist was a priest in the imperial church.

they spent half their time studying books to understand the relationship between God's aspects and the facets of their society. The other half was spent preaching the evils of sloth and drink.

ImperialStudent49.Title: imperial student
ImperialStudent49.Description: This colonist studied on an imperial midworld where guns were banned and self-defense study was encouraged. The relative safety allowed them to focus on their botanical research.

IndustrialOrphan13.Title: industrial orphan
IndustrialOrphan13.Description:
This colonist never knew their parents. their earliest memories were of drudgery in the mines and workhouses of their industrial world.

Because of this, they never received a proper education.

IndworldUrchin73.Title: indworld urchin
IndworldUrchin73.Description: This colonist grew up on the streets of a world in the early stages of its industrial revolution. they passed their days stealing, begging and tinkering with discarded machine scraps, always on the lookout for a way to escape poverty.

Infantry99.Title: infantry
Infantry99.Description:
This colonist was raised on a world wracked by war.

At an early age, They were shown how to use guns and cruelty to project their will. they later distinguished themself by committing atrocities with more enthusiasm than anyone else.

InfantryEngineer46.Title: infantry engineer
InfantryEngineer46.Description: Despite being in an infantry battalion, This colonist rarely fired a gun. their specialty was the rapid construction of defenses, traps, defensive installations, and sapping tunnels.

InfantryMedic6.Title: infantry medic
InfantryMedic6.Description: This colonist treated the combat wounds of their fallen comrades.

InfantryOfficer49.Title: infantry officer
InfantryOfficer49.Description: This colonist was an officer in an imperial battalion. they developed the social and combat skills to do their job well and was respected by the men.

InformationBroker77.Title: information broker
InformationBroker77.Description:
This colonist caught a ship to the next star system and began a life of travel and learning, quickly collecting a massive bank of knowledge from people of all shapes and sizes.

they learned to sell this knowledge for great profit, and became a powerful broker of information.

IntelligenceAgent10.Title: intelligence agent
IntelligenceAgent10.Description:
Because of their hacking skills, This colonist was recruited by their home planet's governing body to serve as an intelligence agent. The government trained them in combat, but they prefers psychological warfare.

Government rules proved too strict for them, so they went rogue. their current activities are unknown.

IntelligenceAgent21.Title: intelligence agent
IntelligenceAgent21.Description: This colonist was a high-ranking counterintelligence agent tasked with thwarting enemy spies.

IntimateAssassin35.Title: intimate assassin
IntimateAssassin35.Description:
This colonist was a professional assassin. They were sadistic, calculating, and appeared utterly harmless.

they preferred using intimate means to dispatch their targets. This fulfilled both their contracts and their own personal desire for control.

Inventor6.Title: inventor
Inventor6.Description: On their homeworld, This colonist worked as a moderately successful inventor. they developed several minor technologies.

InvoluntaryHermit38.Title: involuntary hermit
InvoluntaryHermit38.Description:
This colonist's escape pod was jettisoned onto an unexplored region of a frontier world. they eked out a lonely existence with only a herd of muffalo for company.

Later, They were spotted clad in pygmy wombat furs, discussing the importance of hoof hygiene with a group of elderly muffalo.

Jailbird40.Title: jailbird
Jailbird40.Description: This colonist spent most of their life in prisons, where They were put to work in the kitchens. they had a habit of getting into fights, and developed an aggressive way of speaking.

JoeCustomAdulthood.Title: game developer
JoeCustomAdulthood.Description: This colonist was a hobbyist game developer who lived in an endless cycle of unfinished projects and lofty ideas.

JoeCustomChildhood.Title: drummer
JoeCustomChildhood.Description: This colonist was born into a family of musicians. When hard times came, They were forced to play the drum in a traveling band.

JoywireAddict76.Title: joywire addict
JoywireAddict76.Description:
This colonist's wealthy parents provided everything they ever wanted. After discovering joywires, they became obsessed. Once their parents realized what happened, they cut them off.

Uncaring and often violent, they sought their next joywire fix by any means possible.

JoywireArtist8.Title: joywire artist
JoywireArtist8.Description:
This colonist worked in an urbworld lab developing cutting-edge joywire software to maximize user pleasure.

When the local government imposed harsh restrictions on joywire manufacturing, they began selling their products on the black market.

JungleKid35.Title: jungle kid
JungleKid35.Description:
This colonist was abandoned as a newborn, and grew up among the animals of their homeworld's dense jungles.

When They were a teenager, a traveling doctor found them injured near a road, hissing and meowing. they rescued them and took them on as an apprentice.

JunkyardMechanic51.Title: junkyard mechanic
JunkyardMechanic51.Description:
Left for dead at a young age, This colonist was rescued by an old man who ran an urbworld junkyard. The old man forced This colonist to do dangerous, demanding work.

This colonist became very familiar with machines, but they grew up with almost no other experiences.

KidScientist53.Title: kid scientist
KidScientist53.Description: Born into an influential family, This colonist received the best education money could buy. their intellect soon proved to be superior to many. However, their lack of empathy quickly put them at odds with their teachers and their parents.

Killer41.Title: killer
Killer41.Description:
This colonist was a bloodlusting child. Villagers thought them the product of a snake demon and human coupling.

After watching how their human father betrayed and murdered their mother, they longed to see how many more humans they could get to fall into their hands.

KingOfPirates25.Title: king of pirates
KingOfPirates25.Description: As a self-proclaimed king of pirates, This colonist was ruthless. Manipulative in nature, They were not afraid to sacrifice the people around them in service of their own goals. They were a good shot, but even more skilled with a sword, and they loved the adrenaline rush of close combat.

LabGrownChild22.Title: lab-grown child
LabGrownChild22.Description:
This colonist was born in a laboratory as part of a altruistic but failed attempt to create a new class of human.

their childhood was filled with books and one-on-one tutoring. They were awkward, shy, and naive to the true nature of humanity.

LaborCampOrphan91.Title: labor camp orphan
LaborCampOrphan91.Description: This colonist lost their parents in an industrial accident and grew up in an orphans' labor camp. The camp overseers worked their charges mercilessly - but at least They were clothed and fed.

Landworker98.Title: landworker
Landworker98.Description:
This colonist held the position of landworker in their royal house. they managed the family's lands and all the resources on them - both agricultural and mineral.

Though they would never work the machines themself, managing these enterprises required learning the methods of farming and mining in detail.

LanguageAnalyst27.Title: language analyst
LanguageAnalyst27.Description:
After war broke out on their homeworld, This colonist was conscripted as a linguist. they spent their days in a space station, decoding enemy communications and tending the hydroponic crops.

After a meteorite damaged the station, They were forced to enter cryptosleep and hope for rescue.

LazyProgrammer3.Title: lazy programmer
LazyProgrammer3.Description:
This colonist independently developed software that had a competitive edge against local urbworld corporations.

their legally questionable methods lead to a growing number in unsolved claims of intellectual property theft.

LiamCustomAdulthood.Title: simulation developer
LiamCustomAdulthood.Description: This colonist worked on a peaceful glitterworld developing hyper-realistic war crime simulation software.

LiamCustomChildhood.Title: sim addict
LiamCustomChildhood.Description: Born and raised on a glitterworld, This colonist was obsessed with simulation software. they spent far too much time plugged in.

LineInfanteer20.Title: line infanteer
LineInfanteer20.Description:
This colonist was an ordinary infanteer in an imperial battalion.

Conscripted at a young age to add bodies the army, This colonist learned the methods of fighting well enough to satisfy their officers. However, they never quite understood what was going on around them enough to really believe in it.

LivestockFarmer8.Title: livestock farmer
LivestockFarmer8.Description: This colonist ran a livestock farm. they analyzed animal genetics, feed types, birth and slaughter methods, and price trends to optimize the raising of huge animal herds.

Logger16.Title: logger
Logger16.Description: This colonist chopped trees and hauled their lumber back to the tribe. they wielded their axe with the finesse of an artist and the force of a charging muffalo.

Logger95.Title: logger
Logger95.Description: This colonist took down trees and collected wood in hilly passes and ravines. they learned both how to fell the trees safely, and how to manage the forest to keep it healthy.

LogicalChild2.Title: logical child
LogicalChild2.Description:
they preferred logical activities like computers and was completely useless at art.

Being awkward in social situations, their friends were few but close.

Loner61.Title: loner
Loner61.Description:
This colonist never much liked the tribal council or the yearly festivals. they preferred the open plain and the whistle of wind through the rocks.

they visited their tribe from time to time, but mostly took care of themself using their own survival skills.

LoneTraveler95.Title: lone traveler
LoneTraveler95.Description:
After escaping their homeworld on a jury-rigged ship, This colonist traveled to new worlds to experience their beauty.

they joined resistance groups and applied the skills they cultivated on their homeworld. they often warned of the nuclear horror they saw as a child.

LoreKeeper51.Title: lore keeper
LoreKeeper51.Description: This colonist was one of a long line of lore keepers in their tribe. Every night around the fire, they would pass on ancient knowledge and helpful wisdom through stories.

LostMarine81.Title: lost marine
LostMarine81.Description:
Shortly after being promoted to a respected position in their planet's military, This colonist disappeared without a trace.

Later, they reappeared at the head of their own military force. No one knows why they became who They were.

LostSoldier13.Title: lost soldier
LostSoldier13.Description:
This colonist's childhood soldier conditioning failed, and the experiment was shut down. They were abandoned, purposeless, friendless.

This colonist eventually found solace in physically demanding work. they especially liked building houses and crafting heavy armor.

LowWageWorker7.Title: low-wage worker
LowWageWorker7.Description: This colonist worked a variety of casual jobs to support their family, gaining a set of basic hands-on skills.

LoyalJanissary59.Title: loyal janissary
LoyalJanissary59.Description: This colonist was a janissary in a great lord's army. Even more than the other troops, they felt a sense of duty, and they drew their life's meaning from the effort they put to fulfilling their duty.

MachineCollector55.Title: machine collector
MachineCollector55.Description:
This colonist was obsessed with old machines and arcane pieces of technology. they obtained them wherever they could, and loved taking them apart to see how they worked.

they had a habit of talking about their collection long after people around them had stopped listening.

MachineFixer31.Title: machine fixer
MachineFixer31.Description:
This colonist was adept at dealing with mechanical problems, as long as the problem didn't involve the kitchen.

After a life spent around dangerous machinery and flammable chemicals, they learned how to patch themself up pretty well. Despite the pain, they never learned to dislike fire.

Machinist56.Title: machinist
Machinist56.Description: This colonist had a knack for machinery. they supplemented their family's income by repairing and modifying black market weapons.

MadAccountant61.Title: mad accountant
MadAccountant61.Description:
As an accountant, This colonist often socialized with colleagues, and made many friends in upper management.

One day, This colonist discovered a corruption racket run by some of their bosses. After reporting this, They were fired. Wishing to hunt down those responsible, they went on a mass murder spree.

MadScientist2.Title: mad scientist
MadScientist2.Description:
This colonist's lust for knowledge was only matched by their disdain for anyone who would stand in the way of their research.

Traveling from world to world, they sought answers to questions few dared to ask.

MadScientist22.Title: mad scientist
MadScientist22.Description:
Stripped of their life's work and exiled after their unethical experiments on the survivors of the Callos IX incident were published, This colonist learned the skills necessary to survive in the outer rim.

Continuing their research with nothing left to lose, they made minions to carry out the tasks that bored him.

MadScientist31.Title: mad scientist
MadScientist31.Description:
After finishing their education, This colonist was hired by the planet's leading genetic researcher. Later, They were caught running illegal, inhumane experiments.

Despite their family's influence, They were convicted and sentenced to hard labor on a penal colony.

MadScientist47.Title: mad scientist
MadScientist47.Description:
This colonist grew up miserable on the plains of a rimworld. they found the strength to fight under the teachings of an old, broken scientist.

they quickly learned to play with people's fears, and was nicknamed 'mad scientist'.

MafiaBoss17.Title: mafia boss
MafiaBoss17.Description:
This colonist was a high-ranking member of an urbworld crime syndicate.

they bribed officials, maintained the loyalty of their subordinates, and extracted overdue payments - by any means necessary.

Mailman2.Title: mailman
Mailman2.Description:
This colonist carried mail on their assigned routes. Sometimes They were even sent to deliver special packages to stylish corporate offices or mansions.

This colonist got pretty good at avoiding and fighting off angry dogs.

Malingerer28.Title: malingerer
Malingerer28.Description: This colonist often feigned sickness in order to avoid their responsibilities. While resting in the sick hut, they told stories to the children.

MarbleDoctor99.Title: marble doctor
MarbleDoctor99.Description:
On a bomb-blasted world, first aid is often the only aid.

This colonist used their medical skills to help the injured and the sick. they believed that while guns and machines may be powerful, a doctor is even more so.

MarineCadet73.Title: marine cadet
MarineCadet73.Description:
This colonist was in a planetary marine cadet program.

They were kicked out for shooting an officer. It was never established whether this was an accident.

MasterChef48.Title: master chef
MasterChef48.Description:
On a glitterworld, This colonist found a job washing dishes at a famous restaurant and worked their way up the ranks.

A few years later, their career came to an end when someone poisoned the meal They were preparing for the mayor. Jobless, they left to explore the stars once again.

MasterTrader65.Title: master trader
MasterTrader65.Description: This colonist was a master at trading. they earned their nickname by helping a village through a trying time.

MateCustomAdulthood.Title: busker
MateCustomAdulthood.Description:
After being laid off by an interplanetary megacorp, This colonist spent several years disillusioned and fighting alcohol addiction.

they ended up busking aboard a space freighter, playing a beaten-up guitar and entertaining the crew with blues and folk songs from the distant past.

MateCustomChildhood.Title: curious kid
MateCustomChildhood.Description: This colonist spent most of their childhood dreaming of becoming a famous artist who could impress people with their creations.

Mathematician6.Title: mathematician
Mathematician6.Description:
This colonist did mathematical research at a university.

they spent much of their spare time immersed in shooting simulations, though They were frequently ridiculed by other players for their terrible aim.

MechanicsEngineer64.Title: mechanics engineer
MechanicsEngineer64.Description:
This colonist loved solving problems and, with their steady hands and a reputation for quality work, earned a job as a mechanical engineer. they built and redesigned devices of all shapes and sizes.

Eventually, They were able to pick and choose their corporate clients. they made several wealthy friends, as well as a few powerful enemies.

MechanoidHacker93.Title: mechanoid hacker
MechanoidHacker93.Description:
The only son of a well respected mechanoid inventor, This colonist had access to the materials to subvert and modify their father's creations.

they used drugs to increase their productivity. Unfortunately, the side-effects included persistent delusions of being mechanized, which limited their social life.

MechanoidNerd10.Title: mechanoid nerd
MechanoidNerd10.Description:
This colonist grew up in an urbworld as the only child of a pair of mechanoid designers.
They encouraged their interest in the machines. Eventually, they became obsessed with building their own.

Unfortunately this also lead to them being a loner as they preferred technical books to friends.

MechWarVeteran77.Title: mech war veteran
MechWarVeteran77.Description: This colonist fought against swarms of rogue mechanoids since They were old enough to enlist. they has bled on half a dozen worlds and has lost more than they cares to recall. These experiences left them hardened, both mentally and physically.

MedicalAssistant12.Title: medical assistant
MedicalAssistant12.Description: This colonist was born during a catastrophic war in which both sides used incendiary weapons. they grew up helping their parents in an infirmary, treating the cascade of horrific burns from the battlefields. They were left with a lifelong fear of fire.

MedicalHelper27.Title: medical helper
MedicalHelper27.Description:
This colonist traveled between rimworlds with their family. This colonist's mother, a renowned doctor, often delivered lectures from the hull of their retrofitted cargo/medical ship.

Sometimes, the family took on difficult long-term medical work with especially needy patients, and This colonist helped where they could.

MedicalScientist16.Title: medical scientist
MedicalScientist16.Description: This colonist enlisted as a doctor on a passing science vessel. Roaming the stars with a large crew of xenohumans and transbirds, they did genetic research on encountered species. they developed a deep friendship with one transbird but was forced to leave the ship when the captain dismissed all non-avians.

MedicalStudent38.Title: medical student
MedicalStudent38.Description: Born into a long line of doctors, This colonist was tutored in all fields of medicine, from herbal ointments to the modern synthetic drugs. they also picked up a healthy disdain for lower class work.

MedicalStudent96.Title: medical student
MedicalStudent96.Description:
This colonist grew up on a glitterworld in a family of doctors and chose to maintain the tradition.

they had few friends, but got along with their siblings very well.

MedicSoldier54.Title: medic soldier
MedicSoldier54.Description:
This colonist enrolled in their planetary army as a frontline medic. they soon knew the horrors of war and was deeply marked by them.

they left the military and their homeworld and began researching medicine and helping those they came across.

MedievalDoctor40.Title: medieval doctor
MedievalDoctor40.Description:
This colonist worked as a doctor on a medieval planet. they firmly believes that most ailments can be cured with a little bloodletting.

They were also a master anaesthetist, developing a specialty technique that involved a heavy blow to the head.

MedievalFarmOaf58.Title: medieval farm oaf
MedievalFarmOaf58.Description:
Tilling, hoeing, guiding ox carts, pushing wheelbarrows. Digging ditches, planting seeds, predicting the harvest.

Medieval-level farmers aren't educated in the usual sense, but they know a lot about growing plants without technology. That said, such a life can leave one  incapable of participating in technology-driven activities.

MedievalKnight26.Title: medieval knight
MedievalKnight26.Description: This colonist fought for king and country on the battlefield, where they further honed their skill as a swordsman. their greatest glory was leading a charge into an enemy courtroom and capturing the king at sword point.

MedievalLord57.Title: medieval lord
MedievalLord57.Description:
This colonist was a lord on a pre-industrial planet. they went to parties, managed the underlings, and even learned some swordplay.

their soft hands did not hold a tool once during that entire time. Now, they considers manual labor to be beneath them.

MedievalLordling19.Title: medieval lordling
MedievalLordling19.Description:
This colonist was a minor noble in an old kingdom on a medieval world. they grew up in a manor made of handcut stone, served by servants of the lower classes.

Such a life teaches no technical skills and instils a lifelong aversion to manual labor - but This colonist learned early the ways of social manipulation.

MedievalMinstrel95.Title: medieval minstrel
MedievalMinstrel95.Description:
This colonist was a traveling entertainer on a medieval world and they could always be found telling stories or singing songs.

The roads were dangerous, so they is capable of protecting themself. However, they would always move on when there was hard labour to be done.

MedievalNomad12.Title: medieval nomad
MedievalNomad12.Description:
Born to a nomadic family in a feudal society, This colonist was instructed in the arts of speechcraft, sleight of hand, horse riding.

        They were always running around the camp doing odd jobs to help their extended family.

MedievalPlower14.Title: medieval plower
MedievalPlower14.Description: This colonist lived on a planet where kings and queens ruled with little regard for the peasants beneath them. their family owned a large farm, but the king took most of the food it produced. This left This colonist's family poor, and unable to pay for their education. Instead, They were required to work the fields with their parents, and never had time to practice creativity.

MedievalSailor97.Title: medieval sailor
MedievalSailor97.Description: This colonist explored the oceans on a wooden ship, seeking out plant and animal specimens from exotic places, and occasionally fending off pirates. they loved the sea so much they refused to do all but the barest minimum of work on land, except to sell the treasures they had collected.

MedievalSlave49.Title: medieval slave
MedievalSlave49.Description:
This colonist grew up pulling carts and digging holes on a medieval world. Simple manual labor is their oldest companion - along with the master's lash.

they didn't learn to read until age nine.

MedievalSlave50.Title: medieval slave
MedievalSlave50.Description: Born into slavery, This colonist never knew their parents. they eventually escaped from their masters and boarded a military cargo ship, where They were pressed into military service.

MedievalSquire5.Title: medieval squire
MedievalSquire5.Description: This colonist grew up on a medieval planet as a knight in training. they trained directly under the king's war adviser for most of their youth, and learned to fight with a sword and shield.

MedievalThief74.Title: medieval thief
MedievalThief74.Description:
This colonist grew up poor and hungry on a medieval planet, learning to fend for themself.

At first, they only took what they needed. Then they learned to take what they wanted.

MenagerieKeeper1.Title: menagerie keeper
MenagerieKeeper1.Description:
This colonist managed the royal menagerie of a powerful family at their estate.

This colonist's job saw they feeding elephants, tranquilizing lions, and training birds to display their plumage to titled visitors.

MentalPatient69.Title: mental patient
MentalPatient69.Description:
This colonist was placed in a psychiatric hospital. There, they spent their time engaged in the calming activities of the asylum.

They were eventually released, but they retained their emotional distance, their curiosity about human anatomy, and their namesake manic giggling.

Mercenary20.Title: mercenary
Mercenary20.Description:
After escaping their home planet, This colonist fell in with a band of mercenaries. they fought alongside their brothers and sisters in arms for many years.

One day, they were caught in a fight they couldn't win. Refusing to retreat, This colonist was shot down by their enemies. They were alarmed to awake in a heap of corpses, mysteriously unharmed.

Mercenary4.Title: mercenary
Mercenary4.Description: After escaping a crew of rimworld slavers, This colonist developed a lack of respect for life. they proceeded to sign on to a mercenary group where they developed skills using guns and survival techniques. This colonist did dirty work where they found it, and traveled to many worlds.

Mercenary55.Title: mercenary
Mercenary55.Description: This colonist spent their teenage years as a mercenary, being hired to kill and maim others. They were tall, menacing, and frightening. they could instill fear into the hearts of any man who crossed them, and kill anyone they wanted.

MercenaryCaptain98.Title: mercenary captain
MercenaryCaptain98.Description:
This colonist was in the crew of a mercenary ship. Disciplined and confident, they quickly rose through the ranks and gained friends.

In their time as a mercenary captain, They were known for being gregarious and calm - possibly thanks to the joywires.

MercenaryChef44.Title: mercenary chef
MercenaryChef44.Description:
Following in their family's footsteps, This colonist was a soldier for hire.

They were a naturally gifted sharpshooter. However, their real passion is in perfecting a new recipe or dissecting a new gadget.

MercenaryLeader28.Title: mercenary leader
MercenaryLeader28.Description:
Alone, This colonist set out to rebuild their father's life's work. they challenged the leader of a small band of mercenaries and took control, then led the band as they hijacked trade ships and stole valuable cargo.

their men mutinied. They were abandoned, arrested, and sentenced to death.

MercenaryLord13.Title: mercenary lord
MercenaryLord13.Description:
This colonist formed a mercenary company out of freelancers who wanted to make good money while also making slightly better-than-average moral choices. they called it the Ashmarines.

To avoid the coreworlds' military forces, they moved their company to the rimworlds. There, they established bases and communities. In ruling, they maintained a form of order among the raiders and madmen of deep space.

MercenaryPilot63.Title: mercenary pilot
MercenaryPilot63.Description:
This colonist convinced their squadron to abscond with their ships and make a course for the rimworlds. There they could fight for the causes they believed in.

their men were loyal and fought hard, but their ideals soon faded away and their cause became that of the highest bidder.

MercenaryRecruit18.Title: mercenary recruit
MercenaryRecruit18.Description: Born to a long line of off-world mercenaries, This colonist grew up in a busy trading hub. At a young age, They were recruited into one of the mercenary crews.

MercenaryRecruit36.Title: mercenary recruit
MercenaryRecruit36.Description:
Descended from a long line of mercenaries, This colonist grew up in a busy trading hub.

their interest in the foreign goods at the market often distracted them from their chores and training.

MessageCarrier77.Title: message carrier
MessageCarrier77.Description: On a medieval world, the fastest way to send a message is to give it to somebody on a horse and hope they survive the journey. This colonist was that somebody.

Microbiologist12.Title: microbiologist
Microbiologist12.Description:
A plague struck This colonist's native urbworld. This colonist and other researchers revealed that the illness was a bioweapon, but the people turned on them, blaming them for the sickness.

This colonist barely escaped their homeworld as it fell into chaos.

MidworldCadet83.Title: midworld cadet
MidworldCadet83.Description:
Growing up on a high-tech midworld with a flourishing space transit industry, This colonist wished to leave for the stars and live among the growing spacer class.

they excelled in their studies, and gained entry to their homeworld's most prestigious naval academy.

MidworldGeek18.Title: midworld geek
MidworldGeek18.Description: This colonist grew up in a quiet suburban neighborhood. They were never a master of social interaction, but their interest in computers blossomed into a true talent at an early age.

MidworldLoner80.Title: midworld loner
MidworldLoner80.Description:
This colonist was born on a peaceful, unimportant midworld.

While they had a few friends, they preferred to spend their time in solitude, tinkering on their autocycle while listening to netcasts, or plinking at plastic soldiers with a new rifle they had just put together.

MidworldSailor91.Title: midworld sailor
MidworldSailor91.Description:
This colonist joined their country's Royal Navy. After years as a non-commissioned officer, they eventually cracked and used the skills they had acquired to start a mutiny on their ship.

In the end, This colonist was the leader of a large group of trained and dangerous pirates. they henceforth always had chefs to cook for him.

MidworldSketcher71.Title: midworld sketcher
MidworldSketcher71.Description:
This colonist was born into a loving but poor family.

they discovered they had an artistic talent which they inherited from their father. their mother taught them the benefits of hard work and determination. As they grew older, This colonist developed a fascination with technology and military history.

MilitantChild49.Title: militant child
MilitantChild49.Description:
This colonist's military family forced them to train in hand-to-hand combat and fighting tactics.

In their own time, they built small inventions. This sharpened their mind.

MilitaryCadet16.Title: military cadet
MilitaryCadet16.Description:
Orphaned as a child, This colonist was sent to a secret military school on a harsh deadworld.

Taking quickly to firearms and survival training, they graduated with honor, transitioning into a leadership position in covert operations.
MilitaryCadet16.SkillGainsJoined: Plants -2; Mining +2; Shooting +3; Melee +2; Medicine +2; Animals -3

MilitaryCadet46.Title: military cadet
MilitaryCadet46.Description:
This colonist was levied from their family at a young age to become a soldier. they lived in barracks with other military kids, learning about duty, weapons, pain, and victory.

The trainers sometimes let the kids escape the base to enjoy the wider world. They wanted soldiers who can think independently.

MilitaryChaplain10.Title: military chaplain
MilitaryChaplain10.Description:
This colonist stayed with the troops in training and in combat, administering to the dying and reinforcing the faith of the living.

Like all imperial chaplains, they vowed never to fight themself. However, they acted as a medic and treated the wounded.

MilitaryChild82.Title: military child
MilitaryChild82.Description:
This colonist grew up in a family with a rich military background. their teenage years were spent traveling system to system wherever their parents were deployed.

Following the tradition of their family, they enlisted at the earliest possible age.

MilitaryCommissar71.Title: military commissar
MilitaryCommissar71.Description: This colonist was an internal spymaster in an imperial army battalion. they made sure that the men were loyal, and did not fall back unless ordered. This made them unpopular, but they gained great skill at detecting the slightest dishonesty.

MilitaryCook18.Title: military cook
MilitaryCook18.Description:
They say an army marches on its stomach. This colonist's job was to prepared chow to keep their unit marching, no matter the conditions.

The job required them to pay attention to both the nutritional and psychological needs of the troops.

MilitaryEngineer45.Title: military engineer
MilitaryEngineer45.Description:
This colonist worked as an engineer for a colonial military. they got to play with weapons, murder-drones, and other 'fun' stuff.

they specialized in repairing and modifying mechanoids' tools. Sometimes they tested them themself.

MilitaryGunsmith27.Title: military gunsmith
MilitaryGunsmith27.Description:
When their world was thrown into conflict, This colonist was conscripted along with many of their peers into the war machine that tore across the planet.

With their particular expertise, They were lucky enough to find a position serving as small arms mechanic rather than on the front line.
MilitaryGunsmith27.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +2; Shooting +5; Melee +4; Cooking +1; Medicine +2; Crafting +5

MilitaryInventor35.Title: military inventor
MilitaryInventor35.Description:
Jackson, in a final act of rebellion, left their father's lab and joined the local Imperial military.

they used their laboratory skills to design machines of war. At this They were one of the best on their planet.

MilitaryOfficer17.Title: military officer
MilitaryOfficer17.Description:
Obsessed with interstellar travel, This colonist left their desolate life behind to join a military academy in hopes of becoming a pilot.

They were trained in advanced combat and survival skills. While they excelled in their studies, This colonist was a loner and never cared about their crewmates.

MilitaryRecruit49.Title: military recruit
MilitaryRecruit49.Description:
This colonist was born on a midworld run by an intensely militaristic dictatorship.

From a young age, They were trained to be a good soldier. They taught them how to use a gun and how to fight with melee weapons.

MilitaryTrainee20.Title: military trainee
MilitaryTrainee20.Description: This colonist was raised on a military base in the Xennoa system. They were exposed to many different strenuous activities and grew strong at an early age. they also learned negotiation, medical, and military tactics.

MilitiaSoldier79.Title: militia soldier
MilitiaSoldier79.Description:
This colonist joined the militia forces and fought for rights and peace.

After their homeworld was unexpectedly destroyed in the wars, they traveled great distances, seeking a refuge where they could build a new, free way of life.
MilitiaSoldier79.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +3; Melee +3; Social +4; Medicine -3; Artistic +4; Crafting +3

MindwipedAssassin50.Title: mindwiped assassin
MindwipedAssassin50.Description:
The corporation took and remade This colonist. They trained them into an tool of destruction and subversion. they took to their new life, finding satisfaction in the jobs they sent them on.

When they learned that they planned on disposing of them, This colonist turned on their masters, killing several and fleeing the planet.

Minister88.Title: minister
Minister88.Description: This colonist managed to secure an important position in the government of a minor glitterworld. they got used to the opulence, while attempting to keep their citizens content. they had ample time for pleasure and indulgence – though they never forgot how to do hard work.

Missionary99.Title: missionary
Missionary99.Description: This colonist decided to devote their life to religious service. they made a vow of peace and spent several years preaching and serving food in soup kitchens for the homeless.

MobHenchman53.Title: mob henchman
MobHenchman53.Description: After being "saved" from their home world by a slaver ship, This colonist was sold to an urbworld crime lord, where They were used as a henchman. they specialized in low-tech beat-downs and intimidation.

Model99.Title: model
Model99.Description: This colonist modelled clothes and jewellery for advertisers, and was also used as a physical blueprint for characters in virtual reality simulations.

MonkeyChild67.Title: Monkey child
MonkeyChild67.Description: When They were a baby, This colonist's parents traded their child to a troop of monkeys. Little is known of their life among the primates.

MuffaloResearcher67.Title: muffalo researcher
MuffaloResearcher67.Description:
This colonist specialized in studying and manipulating the genetic code of the muffalo.

their work left little time to develop an appreciation for the arts or other people's company.

MuffaloShaman95.Title: muffalo shaman
MuffaloShaman95.Description: Because of their quiet wisdom and great strength, This colonist became the spiritual guide for their tribe. they had a special connection with the great spirit of the muffalo.

MusicalKid14.Title: Musical kid
MusicalKid14.Description: This colonist was born with an almost magic voice. they learned to sing as a baby. their voice also had a special timbre to it which calmed down everyone who listened to it.

MusicalKid86.Title: musical kid
MusicalKid86.Description: As a child, This colonist had a talent for playing musical instruments and singing. They were given expert training and loved to perform in recitals and concerts, though the lavish praise they received made them a little self-obsessed.

MusicIdol50.Title: music idol
MusicIdol50.Description:
This colonist was the only child of a powerful company president. their beautiful appearance led to a career as a music idol.

When their mother died, This colonist could not bear their father's loneliness, and became his sexual companion.

Mute34.Title: mute
Mute34.Description: This colonist was greatly affected by a traumatic event early in their life. For many years they refused to speak to people, preferring instead to play with their household's numerous pets.

MutinousCaptain52.Title: mutinous captain
MutinousCaptain52.Description:
This colonist was taken to the stars by slavers after their tribe was decimated in a raid. Over the years they learned the language of their captors, eventually working for them as an interpreter and diplomat.

The captain only learned of This colonist's true cunning when revenge was taken by form of mutiny.

NathanCustomAdulthood.Title: digger
NathanCustomAdulthood.Description: This colonist carved living spaces and mined minerals from the sides of hills and mountains. they learned to feel at home picking through rock and shoring up cave walls.

NathanCustomChildhood.Title: cave child
NathanCustomChildhood.Description: This colonist grew up in a large and intricate cave complex that extended deep into a mountainside. they helped the adults maintain and improve the deep caves.

Naturalist14.Title: naturalist
Naturalist14.Description:
This colonist grew up on a backwater planet with minimal education. they had to hunt and grow food to survive.

their family's home was frequently raided for food by scavengers. This made This colonist very suspicious and slow to trust anyone they doesn't know.

NavyPathfinder53.Title: navy pathfinder
NavyPathfinder53.Description: This colonist was raised and trained by a group of military explorers dedicated to charting pathways through deep space and on remote planets.

NavyScientist52.Title: navy scientist
NavyScientist52.Description:
Interstellar warfare is won by technology, so glitterworld navies are always at the peak of modern research. Even better, they occasionally find archotechnological artifacts floating in space.

This colonist worked in a navy lab.

NavyTechOfficer0.Title: navy tech officer
NavyTechOfficer0.Description:
After repairing a fleet admiral's holoscreen with nothing but a pair of rusty pliers and scrap wire, This colonist was invited to the Federation Naval Academy.

they received an excellent technical education and extensive firearms training, but had no interest in studying more menial skills.

Nerd92.Title: nerd
Nerd92.Description:
This colonist was curious about everything. While other kids played tag in the suburbs of their industrial city, This colonist read every book they could find about technology, robots, and weapons - whatever looked coolest.

their strong French accent kept them from making real friends.

NetworkEngineer34.Title: network engineer
NetworkEngineer34.Description:
This colonist spent all their time working on computer networking systems.

they lived without a care in the world - other than uptime and dropped packets.

NeuroScientist19.Title: neuro scientist
NeuroScientist19.Description:
This colonist worked for a long time to improve mankind's understanding of the human brain.

After succeeding in mapping the whole brain, This colonist joined a team of scientists on a quest to map the brains of the most exotic altered humans.

NewAgeDuelist27.Title: new age duelist
NewAgeDuelist27.Description:
This colonist was fascinated with combat. their parents traveled often, so They were able to sample many different fighting styles, from 76th-wave jujutsu to the infamous 'urbworld-style' karate.

A polite child, most fighters accepted their requests for training - but moving around often without finishing a tutelage made them lazy.

Newborn79.Title: newborn
Newborn79.Description: This colonist is a baby. their life revolves around milk and naps.

NinjaAssassin31.Title: ninja assassin
NinjaAssassin31.Description:
This colonist performed stiletto-precise assassinations for an interplanetary conglomerate. They were assigned the most complex missions involving disguise, deception, subterfuge, and efficient violence.

A nasty incident with a potted plant and an assassination gone wrong left them with an aversion to plant life.

NobleWard61.Title: noble ward
NobleWard61.Description:
This colonist was adopted by a prominent noble family after being left on their doorstep by their mother.

they quickly learned secrets that passed between the nobles like cheap wine - of worlds beyond their own, languages, cultures and technologies both new and old.

Novelist7.Title: novelist
Novelist7.Description: This colonist lived on a glitterworld, penning wildly successful novels. they lived a carefree lifestyle, spending their days writing and their nights partying - and has never done a day's manual labour in their life.

Nurse61.Title: nurse
Nurse61.Description:
This colonist worked in a hospital, doing routine work such as changing bandages and taking temperatures.

It was a busy job, but they could always find time for a chat with a patient.

OfficerCadet25.Title: officer cadet
OfficerCadet25.Description: From a young age, This colonist trained to be a leader of men. they enrolled in the Vanu Defense College when They were a boy and became proficient with a range of weapons and survival techniques.

OffworldRecruit91.Title: offworld recruit
OffworldRecruit91.Description:
This colonist was born and raised in an offworld soldier growth facility. From a very young age, They were taught close-quarters combat tactics, aggression, and how to survive on distant planets.

One of the best, This colonist was eventually chosen to enter the orbital-deployment shock troop corps.

OldMoneyHeir46.Title: Old money heir
OldMoneyHeir46.Description:
This colonist grew up a sheltered and spoiled child in one of the many manors of their old-money industrialist family.

While attending an elite private school, This colonist received an extensive education in the arts and sciences, but never saw the horrors of the real world.

OptimisticChild30.Title: optimistic child
OptimisticChild30.Description: This colonist was blessed with loving parents and a pleasant midworld life. They were an  optimistic and sociable kid who loved making friends and listening to their stories. their imagination would run wild with ideas and questions.

OrbitalReservist22.Title: orbital reservist
OrbitalReservist22.Description:
When the government declared that it would strengthen its military defenses, This colonist was drafted and trained.

They were stationed on an orbital base, manning the defense systems and, in dire situations, descending in a dropship to the surface.

OrganFarm67.Title: organ farm
OrganFarm67.Description: This colonist was raised in an illegal underground organ farm. their body was used to grow organic implants for wounded mercenaries. Though their upbringing has left them haunted, it has also given them a unique understanding of human biology.

OrnamentMaker56.Title: ornament maker
OrnamentMaker56.Description: This colonist crafted watches, medals, machined jewelry and other complex curios for royal patrons.

Orphan11.Title: orphan
Orphan11.Description: Born in a brothel on a harsh world, This colonist never really had a childhood. they did odd jobs to survive, and became distant from others.

Orphan15.Title: orphan
Orphan15.Description: Born on a deep space station, This colonist was orphaned at a young age. In the orphanage, they stood up for the weaker kids and fought off the bullies.

Orphan25.Title: orphan
Orphan25.Description:
Left alone in the world without parents, This colonist did the best they could to adapt.

Having to take care both of themself and younger kids at the orphanage, they learned a lot about humans and how to interact with them.

OrphanedAcrobat84.Title: orphaned acrobat
OrphanedAcrobat84.Description:
Born a quiet urbworld orphan, This colonist was invited to join a traveling circus. their small size and observant nature helped This colonist become a noted acrobat.

Unfortunately, their violent tendencies brought their acrobatic career to an early end.

OrphanOfWar60.Title: orphan of war
OrphanOfWar60.Description:
This colonist lost their family and home early in life. their life became emotionally hollow, but their painful memories drove them to survive.

they took several jobs, but never achieved more than a basic education.

OskarCustomAdulthood.Title: mod designer
OskarCustomAdulthood.Description:
This colonist designed combat modifications for frontline soldiers.

One night, in a nightmare, This colonist was confronted by all the men and women killed by their work. they decided to travel to the rimworlds and use their skills for good.

OskarCustomChildhood.Title: art slave
OskarCustomChildhood.Description:
This colonist was born on the dark edge of a tidally-locked urbworld. After an argument, their father sold them to a local district lord as a slave artist.

Forced to create art or be punished, they withdrew and became unable to form relations with others.

Osteologist74.Title: osteologist
Osteologist74.Description:
After graduating university at the top of their class, This colonist quickly became a well-known and athletic college professor.

With their new found fame and fitness came a sudden reluctance to preform menial labor - such tasks are better left to graduate students.

OverwatchSniper42.Title: overwatch sniper
OverwatchSniper42.Description:
This colonist didn't know why they joined the military, but they stayed to protect their fellow soldiers.

Army life broke them down and built them back up. It taught them marksmanship, hand to hand combat and how to patch a bullet wound in a hurry.

Pampered87.Title: pampered
Pampered87.Description:
Born on a decadent glitterworld, This colonist was given every expensive toy.

This pampered lifestyle caused them to miss many basic life lessons. they developed a special aversion to cooking, and always ordered the staff to do the kitchen work.

PamperedLordling37.Title: pampered lordling
PamperedLordling37.Description:
This colonist's parents did not want another heir. Fearing a succession fight, they decided to neutralize them early.

They pampered This colonist from birth, preventing them from developing the grit or knowledge necessary to be a threat to their favored son. This colonist learned little more than how to manipulate the royal staff to get more food.

Paramedic45.Title: paramedic
Paramedic45.Description:
This colonist's job was to respond rapidly to medical emergencies. they is used to dealing with severe injuries with only limited medical supplies.

they treated so many gunshot wounds over the years that even seeing a gun made them uncomfortable.

ParamilitaryAgent11.Title: paramilitary agent
ParamilitaryAgent11.Description: After scraping by on assorted shady jobs, This colonist joined with a large paramilitary group to fight a war on their homeworld. their role was infiltration and intelligence gathering

ParticlePhysicist44.Title: particle physicist
ParticlePhysicist44.Description: This colonist performed cutting-edge physics research. they wanted to help build a better and more peaceful future.

PetKeeper7.Title: pet keeper
PetKeeper7.Description:
This colonist spent most of their childhood tending the animals they had bought or rescued.

they saw beauty in natural things more than fabricated objects, and chose the company of their animals over that of their peers.

Philosopher82.Title: philosopher
Philosopher82.Description:
This colonist was a student on a glitterworld. they had a hard time in school, since the other kids thought them rather strange.

they always maintained a distance from these events, being continuously surprised by the many interesting and awkward ways life can go.

Philosopher97.Title: philosopher
Philosopher97.Description:
This colonist's thirst for archaeo-technological knowledge drove them to spend years surveying abandoned data centers and studying ancient coding languages.

they claimed to be one of the few who could piece together the tragedy of the past - and offer a path to the future.

Pickpocket61.Title: pickpocket
Pickpocket61.Description: At a young age, This colonist witnessed their parents' murder. With no guidance, they had to fend for themself. Joining a small group of misfits, they did whatever was necessary to survive.

Pickpocket82.Title: pickpocket
Pickpocket82.Description: Orphaned and abandoned on the tumultuous streets of their polluted, teeming homeworld, This colonist survived by deft hand and fleet foot. A natural born thief and trickster, they rose to prominence early, running the notorious and violent urchin gang 'Doomben Rats'.

PilotFan16.Title: pilot fan
PilotFan16.Description:
This colonist's father was a starfighter pilot, and they always idolized the old man.

From a young age, they collected pilot memorabilia and studied pilot books, preparing to join the deep space navy and follow in their father's footsteps.

PiousSoldier67.Title: pious soldier
PiousSoldier67.Description: When not training or combat, This colonist was often at the chaplain's side. they dedicated their life to serving both their lord and their religion.

Pirate56.Title: pirate
Pirate56.Description:
As a pirate leader, This colonist was well-known for their cunning plans and chess-like traps. They were never afraid to sacrifice a few pawns to capture an important target.

their name has been linked more then once to strategies that overcame overwhelming odds.

PirateCaptain69.Title: pirate captain
PirateCaptain69.Description: This colonist worked their way up through the ranks of a pirate ship, eventually becoming captain. they leads their crew between worlds, making a name to remember.

PirateDoctor0.Title: pirate doctor
PirateDoctor0.Description:
This colonist had a passion for medicine, but never bothered to get a medical degree. Only underfunded pirates and terrorists were desperate enough to hire their services, and their surgical patients had about a 50% survival rate.

Despite this, their optimistic attitude drove them to keep trying to heal those in need. As long as they paid up front.

PirateKing69.Title: pirate king
PirateKing69.Description: With no real care for other people, This colonist fit in perfectly with the pirate crew that had once held them captive. Shortly after joining the crew, This colonist began to kill anyone or anything that got in their way—including their crewmates.

PirateSympathizer24.Title: pirate sympathizer
PirateSympathizer24.Description:
