From their youth, This colonist developed connections in the underworld. There they trained in melee combat and became a trusted underworld advisor.

After participating in a failed rebellion, they fled their homeworld to travel with a pirate band.

PirateTrooper73.Title: pirate trooper
PirateTrooper73.Description:
This colonist joined a renowned interstellar criminal organization, and was often part of shock-assault boarding parties during starship raids.

Though their combat experience made them a good fighter, the ruthlessness of the job left them cold-hearted and unenthusiastic about social interaction.

PitBrawler76.Title: pit brawler
PitBrawler76.Description: This colonist was nine years old when they got in their first fight. they won, but more important was the enjoyment of their audience. Pit fighting turned out to be a lucrative career for those who could survive it. And it was even mostly legal.

PitGladiator19.Title: pit gladiator
PitGladiator19.Description:
This colonist was enslaved as a child and forced to fight creatures and other people in an underground fighting arena.

they showed an affinity for the sport, and eventually bought their own freedom. However, their time in the pits never brought them much intellectual stimulation.

PizzaLover94.Title: pizza lover
PizzaLover94.Description:
This colonist loved boomrat pizza intensely. Rarely eating anything else, They were prone to bad health and low oxygen uptake.

they loved bashing in the skulls of random creatures to see what was inside.

PlagueChild44.Title: plague child
PlagueChild44.Description:
Born on a world wracked by plague, both of This colonist's parents were doctors. 

This colonist was raised in reverse-quarantine, under the Hippocratic oath. they experienced little social interaction. However, they gained a lot of medical experience assisting in treatments.

PlagueDoctor31.Title: plague doctor
PlagueDoctor31.Description:
This colonist provided medical care on multiple plague-wracked worlds, always working under the Hippocratic oath. they improved conditions for those under quarantine while administering complex medical treatments and developing medicines.

they never had time to enjoy a normal life outside of work.

PlagueProdigy12.Title: plague prodigy
PlagueProdigy12.Description:
This colonist's childhood was cut short when a mysterious plague hit their homeworld.

they watched their friends die, and their compassion for humanity died with them. In its place a new thirst for knowledge emerged.

PlagueSurvivor39.Title: plague survivor
PlagueSurvivor39.Description:
This colonist watched as a mysterious plague spread through their town, killing their family and friends.

they learned some medicine from watching the plague doctors, but was mentally scarred by the ordeal.

PlanetaryDiplomat7.Title: planetary diplomat
PlanetaryDiplomat7.Description: This colonist's passion and profession was interplanetary politics. They were a master of social manipulation and negotiation and devoted themself to working towards peace, compromise and mutual benefit.

PlanetaryMiner64.Title: planetary miner
PlanetaryMiner64.Description: This colonist was a mining engineer for a major planetary mining corporation. they work kept them underground for weeks at a time, and they grew to appreciate the darkness.

PlankCutter72.Title: plank cutter
PlankCutter72.Description: This colonist helped their tribe build huge wooden structures by cutting trees into sturdy planks. This colonist developed a fine understanding of how wood grows and splits.

PoisonGardener29.Title: poison gardener
PoisonGardener29.Description:
This colonist spent almost all their time tending to a poison garden and became withdrawn from society.

In that time they learnt a few safe culinary and medicinal uses for the otherwise deadly plants.

Policeman45.Title: policeman
Policeman45.Description:
This colonist kept the peace as a line officer in a municipal social enforcement unit.

They were trained in de-escalation, physical control, shooting, and other police skills.

PoliticalActivist20.Title: political activist
PoliticalActivist20.Description:
This colonist was involved with a radical political faction which worked against their homeworld's government.

The guerilla tactics training that This colonist received from their associates gave them the skills to fight, but also drove them to compromise their own beliefs.

PoliticalAssassin46.Title: political assassin
PoliticalAssassin46.Description:
This colonist realized that their true calling was in physical solutions to diplomatic problems. they sought training from the assassins guild on Ceti V.

They were a quick study at the arts of subterfuge and death. they soon earned the guild rank of Deathjack.

PoliticalCaptive7.Title: political captive
PoliticalCaptive7.Description: This colonist was kidnapped by a rival family and held for ransom. To pass the time in captivity, they read books and practiced martial arts. This colonist had few opportunities to develop their social skills.

Politician57.Title: politician
Politician57.Description:
This colonist was an activist in a powerful political faction. There they learned the art of persuasion and speech.

they had many enemies, so they took secret courses in shooting and hand-to-hand combat.

PoorKid18.Title: poor kid
PoorKid18.Description: Abandoned by their parents, This colonist learned how to survive by themself before They were ten years old.

PopIdol59.Title: pop idol
PopIdol59.Description: This colonist performed and did interviews constantly. they refined their skills in dancing and singing, and became a master of social presentation.

PopIdolPirate39.Title: pop idol pirate
PopIdolPirate39.Description:
This colonist and their fans set out as a space pirate crew. they raided corporations for money and staged performances to spread their name.

This colonist became afraid of fire when a rival burned their stage down. they relied on their fans to do the work they found unappealing.

PowerMadScholar30.Title: power-mad scholar
PowerMadScholar30.Description: "Knowledge is power." These words sparked something within This colonist, and came to form their core drive. When not entombed within libraries, they would take things apart to see first-hand how they worked, with little regard for the border between mechanical and organic.

PrisonerOfWar2.Title: prisoner of war
PrisonerOfWar2.Description:
This colonist was captured and put on death row for war crimes.

Fortunately for them, someone cut the power to their cell block. Riots ignited. Guards and trained wargs were deployed to quell the uprising. Organizing a few other inmates, This colonist escaped in a small spacecraft.

PrivateDetective66.Title: private detective
PrivateDetective66.Description: As a private eye, sharp wits and a silver tongue were This colonist's greatest tools. they often spent their nights working cases that ranged from uncovering affairs and learning trade secrets to solving murder cases and infiltrating criminal organizations. There wasn't a case they wouldn't accept for the right price.

PrivilegedChild86.Title: privileged child
PrivilegedChild86.Description:
Born to an upper-class family, This colonist grew up with all the best things - the best education, the best social contacts, and of course the best technology money could buy.

Unfortunately, living in such decadence left This colonist rather spoiled when it came to labor.

PrivilegedProdigy70.Title: privileged prodigy
PrivilegedProdigy70.Description: This colonist was recognized as gifted early in their glitterworld upbringing. Luckily, their family was in a position to cultivate that genius through advanced education. their training included science, leadership, and the arts.

ProdigalStudent67.Title: prodigal student
ProdigalStudent67.Description:
This colonist was a faithful student, and was dedicated to learning anything and everything they could about humanity and its creations.

While They were shunned as a nerd, they didn't mind. they hoped for a brighter future.

ProfessionalGamer76.Title: professional gamer
ProfessionalGamer76.Description:
This colonist was obsessed with video games since their hands were big enough to grip a joystick.

they achieved middling finishes in several local tournaments during the 16-bit era. Nobody noticed when they retired early in their teenage years.

ProjectSubject99.Title: project subject
ProjectSubject99.Description:
This colonist was picked by government agents for the mysterious "Frame Project".

Due to memory blockages, however, they remembers very little about this project or its true agenda - only that there were few survivors.

Propagandist86.Title: propagandist
Propagandist86.Description: This colonist was a skilled artist and military propagandist. they created works of art depicting their lords and armies favorably.

ProstheticSurgeon0.Title: prosthetic surgeon
ProstheticSurgeon0.Description: This colonist used their talent for prosthetics to 'advance' others by replacing limbs and organs with metal and electronics.

ProstituteIdol28.Title: prostitute idol
ProstituteIdol28.Description:
After their father was deposed, This colonist's beauty led them to be forced into pornography to survive.

Over years of difficult treatments, their body was remodeled to appear temporarily ageless. Sold to an orbital brothel, they became popular, with a steady stream of clients from all over the planet.

PsychiatricPatient94.Title: psychiatric patient
PsychiatricPatient94.Description:
This colonist spent most of their adult life in an insane asylum. their industrial homeworld had a poor understanding of mental illness, and They were treated more like an animal than a person.

Though they eventually recovered and was released, their experience dampened many of their basic life skills.

PsychologyStudent15.Title: psychology student
PsychologyStudent15.Description:
This colonist researched new religions and traditions and often dreamt of distant stars. 

their dreams prompted them to ask what lay beyond the lights in the sky.

Punk30.Title: punk
Punk30.Description: This colonist spent their childhood selling knockoff cigarettes to 15-year-olds. The cigarettes were often full of grass clippings.

PyroAssistant82.Title: pyro assistant
PyroAssistant82.Description:
On an industrial world, This colonist learned early that if they wanted to eat, they had to work. So work they did. Kids fit in places adults can't, and where They were from, the safety laws were quite flexible.

They were always a bit of a pyromaniac, and was banned from the kitchen after an unfortunate incident.

Pyromaniac18.Title: pyromaniac
Pyromaniac18.Description:
From an early age, This colonist had an unhealthy fascination with fire. they would set refuse heaps ablaze and become so entranced by the flames they would absent-mindedly burn themself.

One day while playing with matches, they carelessly burned down their home.

QuarryWorker29.Title: quarry worker
QuarryWorker29.Description: This colonist worked in a quarry helping to extract valuable stone from the hillside. they learned to sense opportunities and dangers in the stone by sight, touch, and intuition.

QuietNerd97.Title: quiet nerd
QuietNerd97.Description:
This colonist was raised by doting parents on a midworld. Instead of playing with other children, they read books voraciously.

They were not particularly rugged, and struggled with physical labor.

RaiderKing38.Title: raider king
RaiderKing38.Description: Starting as nothing more than a slave, This colonist rose quickly among the raider ranks until all knew their name and their ruthlessness.

Rancher43.Title: rancher
Rancher43.Description:
This colonist owned and operated a successful ranch where they raised animals for meat and wool.

they refused to do any dumb labour they could pay someone else to do for them.

Ranger6.Title: ranger
Ranger6.Description: This colonist lived alone, deep in a forest. they protected the wildlife against poachers, and learned to satisfy their own material needs without outside help.

Ranger96.Title: ranger
Ranger96.Description: This colonist tracked animals and people for a wide range of clients. they became adept at reading spoor, finding food in the wild, and stalking prey.

RangerChild57.Title: ranger child
RangerChild57.Description:
This colonist was raised in a forest. their father taught them to hunt and live off the land, so that they could live without the need of others when father died.

Accustomed to manual labor and with an intuitive mind, This colonist could survive weeks alone.

RebelChild8.Title: rebel child
RebelChild8.Description:
This colonist was born under authoritarian rule. Despite intense oppression from family and community, they never gave up fighting for their dignity and their freedom.

They were often put into hopeless situations where even family would try to terrorize them into propriety. they learned to trust no one.

RebelFighter39.Title: rebel fighter
RebelFighter39.Description:
When civil war broke out This colonist remained neutral, until their home was firebombed by a loyalist militia.

Later, their unit gave them the nickname "Rare" after they burnt down the luxury villa of a loyalist leader, with them still inside it.

RebelliousStudent74.Title: rebellious student
RebelliousStudent74.Description:
This colonist had a shot at an education, but they rebelled against the injustices they saw and was expelled from three schools. This left them with a sense of integrity, but a lack of social skills.

        This colonist sought self-actualization. they spent their days meditating and practicing katana and staff fighting techniques.

RebelSlave14.Title: rebel slave
RebelSlave14.Description:
This colonist was born into corporate slavery and raised to perform menial tasks for minimum pay. They were just another cog in the machine. 

This colonist found their freedom by joining a rebel organization whose goal was to break free from their corporate masters.
RebelSlave14.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +1; Plants +1; Intellectual -2; Shooting +2; Social +2; Crafting +2

RebelStudent14.Title: rebel student
RebelStudent14.Description:
This colonist grew up in a modest but privileged family who encouraged them to play chess and shoot skeet at a young age.

As a bored student, they found joy in challenging their teachers about the contradictions between their planet's official values and their government's policies.

RebelWriter82.Title: rebel writer
RebelWriter82.Description: Early on, This colonist developed a talent for writing. They were soon writing a popular online journal - anonymously, to hide their age - on topics ranging from bioethics to political theory and xenosociology.

ReclusiveChild81.Title: reclusive child
ReclusiveChild81.Description:
This colonist didn't learn to speak until They were nearly five years old. Even then they preferred to keep to themself.

To the chagrin of their caretakers, they made a habit of wandering off to live in the wilderness for weeks at a time.

ReclusiveProdigy96.Title: reclusive prodigy
ReclusiveProdigy96.Description:
Growing up on a flourishing glitterworld afforded This colonist the chance to fully devote themself to their studies.

Having taken a keen interest in genetic modification and neural augmentation from a young age, they had little time (or desire) for a regular childhood.

ReconSniper89.Title: recon sniper
ReconSniper89.Description: This colonist was a professional military sniper. They were trained to rapidly reach into unexpected firing positions, snipe key targets, and escape before enemies could pinpoint their location.

Recruiter14.Title: recruiter
Recruiter14.Description:
This colonist was part of a revered order of martial artists, infamous both for their skill in combat and for their practice of refusing to treat their wounded.

they traveled their homeworld, judging the young people they met to determine if they might be suitable for training.

ReEducatedYouth23.Title: re-educated youth
ReEducatedYouth23.Description:
This colonist lived on a midworld where the government cared about the youth. 

They were one of the many children who were taken from their parents and forced into the new education programs.

Regent9.Title: regent
Regent9.Description:
When This colonist's family's ally was killed, and their young son inherited his throne, This colonist was appointed as regent to rule in the child's stead.

they oversaw diverse matters of house and title, from finances to war to greedy relatives intent on usurping the throne. This colonist never abused their position.

ReligiousHierarch16.Title: religious hierarch
ReligiousHierarch16.Description:
Ordained as a priest in their local community, This colonist used intrigue and diplomacy to rise to the higher echelon of the clergy. they held numerous titles and lands.

One day, a merchant landed their spaceship near This colonist's home. they decided to accompany the merchant in search for new worlds and challenges.
ReligiousHierarch16.SkillGainsJoined: Construction -3; Mining -3; Shooting -2; Melee -2; Social +8; Cooking +4; Medicine +5

RenegadeEngineer43.Title: renegade engineer
RenegadeEngineer43.Description:
After a daring escape from the prison planet with a small crew of fellow inmates, This colonist set their gaze on their homeworld.

they traveled there, recruited more followers, hijacked a space cruiser, and launched into the void.

RenownedProfessor51.Title: renowned professor
RenownedProfessor51.Description:
This colonist's bottomless compassion and love of knowledge drove them to a life of teaching. they became one of the best-known names in academia throughout the urbworld bubble.

their holo-lectures were revered by all that watched, and the few students they accepted into their seminars spoke widely of their kindness and patience.

Reporter71.Title: reporter
Reporter71.Description:
This colonist spent many years as an investigative reporter. They were notorious for making chaotic reports from exotic locations.

Although seen as a lightweight by their critics, they managed to break several high-profile stories after lengthy investigations.

ReptileResearcher37.Title: reptile researcher
ReptileResearcher37.Description:
After leaving their parents' vineyard, This colonist traveled across much of known space, and learned many skills along the way.

they spent most of their time researching and interacting with reptile species. They were renowned for making several breakthroughs, and for discovering the "Thorny Devil".

Restorer70.Title: restorer
Restorer70.Description: This colonist traveled the world, always looking for old and forgotten things to repair for the good of others, working to see the true beauty in all things.

RichBoy9.Title: rich boy
RichBoy9.Description:
This colonist grew up on a midworld with loving parents, a cute pet and a lot of money - but no friends.

They were always told by their father that 'those peasants just want your money'. So, they spent most of their time alone, or fighting other kids.

RichKid61.Title: rich kid
RichKid61.Description: This colonist came from a wealthy and influential bloodline. their expensive education included lessons on dueling, leadership, and military strategy.

RimworldExile32.Title: Rimworld exile
RimworldExile32.Description:
After their planet was technologically uplifted by a benevolent glitterworld charity, This colonist saw an opportunity to make some money by defrauding the wealthy glitterworld visitors.

After They were caught, They were exiled to the rim, where they targeted rich trading companies to continue their life of crime.

RitualChild20.Title: ritual child
RitualChild20.Description:
Born with a special mark on their neck, This colonist's tribe chose to sacrifice them in a blood ritual. They left them in the forest to die. A pack of arctic wolves found and adopted them.

Over time, they learned to make tools to hunt with the pack.

Roboticist1.Title: roboticist
Roboticist1.Description:
Sailors often died on the dangerous waters of This colonist's ocean planet. they created robots to replace them.

Over time, they collected a small crew of robots to do their bidding. they became proficient at mechanics and engineering, but lost the taste for manual labor.

Roboticist41.Title: roboticist
Roboticist41.Description:
This colonist felt more comfortable with robots and artificial intelligences than with organic people, so they worked as a roboticist. they took a particular interest in mechanites and ancient technology.

This colonist relied on other people for their basic needs.

RocketEngineer53.Title: rocket engineer
RocketEngineer53.Description: This colonist won a grant to a top school and earned a degree in rocket engineering. After several years working for a space mining company they left to travel and see the universe.
RocketEngineer53.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +4; Intellectual +5; Mining +3; Social -1; Cooking -4; Medicine -2

RocketPioneer19.Title: rocket pioneer
RocketPioneer19.Description:
As a self-taught engineer, This colonist escaped their dying homeworld on a rocket they built themself.

they later spent years of their life on several worlds, helping less-developed planets develop rocket technology.

RoyalBastard64.Title: royal bastard
RoyalBastard64.Description:
This colonist was the child of a lord and a prostitute.

their father's line was secure and his holdings strong. Nobody ever came to This colonist to endorse a bid for the title. they earned their bread cleaning the brothel, but always felt they deserved much more.

RoyalCook18.Title: royal cook
RoyalCook18.Description:
This colonist made meals for their aristocratic patrons.

Only the finest food was acceptable, so This colonist tended a small garden on the mansion grounds to get the freshest herbs and vegetables. they fell in love with the food themself.

RoyalGuard51.Title: royal guard
RoyalGuard51.Description:
This colonist guarded the personal palace of a powerful lord.

While violence was rare, palace intrigue was constant. This colonist's work taught they to handle both words and guns.

RoyalMasseuse43.Title: royal masseuse
RoyalMasseuse43.Description:
This colonist was a massage artist for an extended royal house. they serviced many members of the royal family, and their guests.

This colonist occasionally offered something extra, if the lord or lady was in the mood. Advancing in this line of work meant having refined social skills.

RugbyPlayer71.Title: rugby player
RugbyPlayer71.Description:
After years of addiction to virtual reality games, This colonist was saved when the doctors unplugged him.

Unfortunately, they unplugged them during a match of Rugby Rampage 4. The mental backlash merged their real identity and their virtual identity, leaving them with the personality and skills of a rugby player.

RunawayDancer35.Title: runaway dancer
RunawayDancer35.Description:
Grown by and for science, This colonist gave it up. Instead, they wanted to dance for crowds across many worlds, from the glamor of the glitterworlds to the dangers of the rim.

Such work required wearing a smile on their face and a pistol under their costume.

SanitationCaptain29.Title: sanitation captain
SanitationCaptain29.Description:
After graduating officer training school, This colonist was assigned to main battle deck on the Thunder-Child. they served there for a year before their "gallant" actions saw them reassigned to the maintenance corps.

It was with the maintenance corps They were dubbed This colonist on account of their legs.

Scavenger22.Title: scavenger
Scavenger22.Description: This colonist spent their childhood escaping grunt work to go digging through wrecks and ruins for treasures. their natural curiosity got them into a lot of trouble, but it also yielded many interesting finds.

Scavenger62.Title: scavenger
Scavenger62.Description:
This colonist grew up in one of the few remaining cities on a world ravaged by nuclear war.

they learned to survive on their own in this post-apocalyptic wasteland by scavenging for technology and supplies.

SchoolyardOutcast11.Title: schoolyard outcast
SchoolyardOutcast11.Description:
This colonist had a modest but proper upbringing. Despite a good family background and plenty of support, they struggled to make friends and was often bullied. they learned to work or play alone, and avoided socializing to avoid conflict.

When conflict did arise, This colonist would retaliate violently.

ScienceProdigy65.Title: science prodigy
ScienceProdigy65.Description:
This colonist was top of their class in chemistry, physics, exobiology, astronomy and opera.

An unfortunate lab accident left them with a deathly fear of fire.

Scout44.Title: scout
Scout44.Description:
Born to the administrators of a rimworld colony, This colonist was enrolled in a youth program that taught military scouting skills.

they learned to survive in the wilderness, to obey, and not to ask questions.

Scout59.Title: scout
Scout59.Description: Since their tribe made contact with local outlanders, This colonist contracted their services out as a guide. Frequent contact with ancient technology made them comfortable with the lost machines.

Scout6.Title: scout
Scout6.Description:
This colonist loved being outdoors. their parents enrolled them in a program that taught military scouting skills. they thrived when They were left alone in the wilderness.

Unfortunately, This colonist did not learn the basic technological skills that are taken for granted by many others.

Scrounger25.Title: scrounger
Scrounger25.Description:
This colonist would dive into junk mounds in search for valuables and items of interest.

They were never bothered by the stink, or dangers that could leave them wounded for weeks.

Sculptor63.Title: sculptor
Sculptor63.Description: This colonist started off sculpting person-sized artworks, but they soon began to think bigger. With the help of mining robots, they learned how to carve huge monuments out of cliffsides. Soon the parks of the glitterworld where they lived were full of giant stone figures.

SelflessHunter61.Title: selfless hunter
SelflessHunter61.Description:
This colonist was a hunter of mysterious creatures that many didn't even believe existed. Sometimes the people were right - and sometimes they were wrong.

Along the way, they helped people in need.

SentimentalChild55.Title: sentimental child
SentimentalChild55.Description:
This colonist was a nice child. When anybody had a problem, they tried to fix it. But, being a child, they did not always succeed. This hurt their sensitive soul.

they dreamed of being a soldier who fights raiders and aliens.

SerialMurderer47.Title: serial murderer
SerialMurderer47.Description:
This colonist started to enjoy killing people, so they did more often and perfected their methods. they lurked in the darkest streets, stalking prey for hours.

they enjoyed making artworks of their victims, and was known for leaving their signature on the bodies of those they killed.

ServingBoy97.Title: serving boy
ServingBoy97.Description:
This colonist was the child of house servants, and was trained to carry on the family duty.

they carried things and polished silverware, but was never allowed into the lords' part of the house.

SewerKid57.Title: sewer kid
SewerKid57.Description:
This colonist grew up in the sludge-smeared sewers of a polluted industrial world.

they befriended the strange insects in the darkness and learned to love them.

ShadowMarine63.Title: shadow marine
ShadowMarine63.Description:
After perfecting their skills as a pathfinder, This colonist left their unit to put their skills to use on the planets they helped chart.

Familiar with orbital trade routes, They were able to get onto and off any planet without being detected.

ShamanOfShadows47.Title: shaman of shadows
ShamanOfShadows47.Description:
When the monsters of fire came from the sky, This colonist was called upon by their tribe to guide them into battle.

This colonist made use of medicines and rituals to inspire and lead the warriors of many tribes against the invaders. The pirates were forced to retreat without capturing a single slave.

ShelterChild50.Title: shelter child
ShelterChild50.Description: This colonist grew up in a shelter deep beneath a toxic world. they received a comprehensive education, but had no opportunity to do physical labour.

Sheriff52.Title: sheriff
Sheriff52.Description: This colonist was the law enforcer in an isolated industrial town. they dealt with petty crime, dispute resolution, and the occasional drunken saloon shootout.

ShipboundLordling12.Title: shipbound lordling
ShipboundLordling12.Description:
This colonist's family held their power base on a grand, ancient starship. Born and raised on the ship, This colonist learned all about the rigors of shipboard life, and the politics and methods of interstellar battle and orbital invasion.

they learned to feel most at home with strong walls close on all sides and the gentle hiss of atmosphere regulators.

ShipBoy89.Title: ship boy
ShipBoy89.Description:
This colonist was born to low-ranked servants on an ancient starship. The ship's machine persona was like a third parent to them, and the parts crafting crew they worked for was like a second family.

This colonist rarely saw plants or animals, and still finds them unnerving to touch.

ShipChild46.Title: ship child
ShipChild46.Description:
This colonist's family were space traders. One day, This colonist's cryptosleep pod failed in transit. they had to spend years awake on the ship as the other slept.

they filled their days creating beautiful contraptions from the ship's cargo - but they didn't learn a lot of basic planetary living skills.

Shipcracker37.Title: shipcracker
Shipcracker37.Description:
This colonist's role was to launch through the vacuum of space, land on the enemy ship's hull, punch holes to the interior, and conquer it in room-to-room combat. they became very good at wielding heavy cataphract weapons to cut both steel and flesh.

they also developed a taste for the drugs they used to cope with the overwhelming stress.

ShipTechnician0.Title: ship technician
ShipTechnician0.Description:
This colonist was an apprentice technician on trade ships plying their routes between the stations and planets of their home system. In this job, they learned to fix and improve many machines.

Sometimes, their ship was assigned to short exploratory jaunts into dangerous regions of space.

ShockTrooper15.Title: shock trooper
ShockTrooper15.Description:
This colonist was in a deep space shock troop unit deployed on multiple planets in various wars.

During a risky assault, their whole unit was wiped out. Nobody else knew what happened on the field that day, but This colonist will carry the burden forever.

ShootingComa59.Title: shooting coma
ShootingComa59.Description: This colonist fell into a coma at a young age and spent years dreaming about shooting. When they awoke, They were useless at most tasks - but they could aim pretty well.

ShopKid36.Title: shop kid
ShopKid36.Description: This colonist's mother was often ill, and it fell to them to run the store which was their only source of income. they learned a little about the exotic artifacts which they sold, and a lot about the art of the deal.

ShunnedGirl30.Title: shunned girl
ShunnedGirl30.Description: Freya was born into a small, poor family. She was bullied relentlessly, beaten and hated. As she grew up she developed an   interest in guns. She usually studied from books, but occasionally managed to get some practice time with the real thing. Freya later   discovered a talent for art and began to teach herself how to draw and paint.

SicklyChild55.Title: sickly child
SicklyChild55.Description: As a child, This colonist suffered from a rare disease. Quarantined in a hospital, they had minimal human contact and got little physical exercise. In the sterile hospital environment, however, they became very familiar with science and medicine.

SicklyLawyer49.Title: sickly lawyer
SicklyLawyer49.Description:
As a lawyer, This colonist could convict a deaf man for stealing music. their sharp mind and lack of empathy let them say anything to get the other person to talk. With the right amount of money, they knew, any case can be won.

their childhood cough never went away.

SicklyLiar3.Title: sickly liar
SicklyLiar3.Description:
It is not uncommon for a sickly child to be cast away. What is uncommon is for that child to survive and even thrive with such a weak body.

Using their quick wit and silver tongue, This colonist was able to get out of almost any situation - most of the time at the cost others around him.

Sightseer70.Title: sightseer
Sightseer70.Description:
This colonist traveled the stars. they could barely scrape together travel costs doing odd-jobs, but it was all worth it.

they loved camping in exotic places and learning the patterns of strange wildlife. they never could focus on intellectual endeavors, as their sightseeing distracted them far too much.
Sightseer70.SkillGainsJoined: Plants +2; Shooting +2; Melee +2; Medicine +2; Artistic +2; Animals +2

Slaughterer58.Title: slaughterer
Slaughterer58.Description: This colonist slaughtered animals for a living. Others looked down on this work as filthy, but the skills required to manage and cleanly slaughter large numbers of animals were never simple.

SlaveChemist84.Title: slave chemist
SlaveChemist84.Description: This colonist became a gifted pharmaceutical scientist, but was captured by slavers. They were sold to a warlord and forced to create drugs to test on other slaves. This left them with deep and troubling questions on the ethics of scientific research and medicine.

SlaveFarmer99.Title: slave farmer
SlaveFarmer99.Description: Abandoned as a little girl, This colonist was found by a farmer. Being infertile themself, the farmer kept them as a slave. The constant beatings left them scarred and unable to handle violence. After many years, they ran away.

SmallTownKid41.Title: small town kid
SmallTownKid41.Description:
This colonist grew up in an isolated midworld village, surrounded by opticows and countryside.

their parents taught them a wide range of useful domestic skills, but a peaceful and secure childhood left them with little understanding of the harder parts of life.
SmallTownKid41.SkillGainsJoined: Construction -3; Plants +3; Mining -3; Cooking +3; Medicine +3; Animals +3

Smuggler23.Title: smuggler
Smuggler23.Description:
As a contract pilot, This colonist had a knack for stealing goods and trafficking contraband without getting caught.

they eventually saved up enough to buy their own ship, and used it to travel from world to world dealing their goods in person.

SocialPariah3.Title: social pariah
SocialPariah3.Description: This colonist's family never fit in. They were oddballs who couldn't conform to their regimented society. Because of this, they were forced into cryptosleep and sent to different rimworlds, never to see each other again.

SoftwareDeveloper84.Title: software developer
SoftwareDeveloper84.Description: After they gained the ability to use automation to remove tedium, This colonist could no longer tolerate traditional education and employment.

SoldierExperiment50.Title: soldier experiment
SoldierExperiment50.Description:
This colonist grew up believing They were a normal, albeit slightly sheltered child.

In truth, They were part of an elaborate experiment. Researchers were conditioning them using social interactions and mechanite injections to try to produce an elite soldier.

SoldiersKid55.Title: soldier's kid
SoldiersKid55.Description: This colonist was raised on the ancient starship where their parents were stationed. they learned the basics of firearm operations and maintenance from the soldiers on board. This colonist became accustomed to a strict routine and frequent discipline.

SoleSurvivor21.Title: sole survivor
SoleSurvivor21.Description: This colonist's entire tribe was wiped out in a raid. Though They were adopted by another group, They were emotionally scarred, and preferred to stay near home, cooking and tending crops.

SoleSurvivor63.Title: sole survivor
SoleSurvivor63.Description:
This colonist's entire tribe was wiped out by a mysterious disease.

Found alone and adopted by another band, they never became close with the other tribe members. they preferred to stay away from their new home, wandering the woods and tending the animals.

SoleSurvivor85.Title: sole survivor
SoleSurvivor85.Description: This colonist lived in a remote colony. When mechanoid centipedes attacked their home and killed their people, They were the last survivor.

SonOfAHuntress75.Title: son of a huntress
SonOfAHuntress75.Description:
In the mountains of the planet Ticonderoga, This colonist was raised by their tribal mother. She taught them survival skills - trapping, tracking, shooting, skinning, cooking and healing.

their departed father had left behind an old bolt-action rifle, and This colonist practiced with it every chance they got.

SpaceBartender0.Title: space bartender
SpaceBartender0.Description:
This colonist became a bartender on a space station. they interacted with and befriended many strangers.

As time went on, This colonist used their knowledge of herbs to craft their own strange concoctions for their customers.

SpaceCadet77.Title: space cadet
SpaceCadet77.Description:
Growing up on a rural farm-world leaves little opportunity for excitement and adventure, so when the Royal Fleet began a recruiting program on their home planet, This colonist threw down their hoe and cattle prod to took up arms for the crown.

they served on the interplanetary super-destroyer HMS Thunder-Child.

SpaceExplorer53.Title: space explorer
SpaceExplorer53.Description:
This colonist spent years trapped, alone on an unknown planet. they quickly adapted to the local environment, and learned to communicate with their local enemies.

This long period alone left them without close friends. their heart is sensitive, but they learned to hide their emotions very well.

SpaceFanboy22.Title: space fanboy
SpaceFanboy22.Description: This colonist dreamed of space travel. they built their own pretend spaceship from an old police box and went to see the great unknown.

SpaceHumanitarian9.Title: space humanitarian
SpaceHumanitarian9.Description: After seeing the rampant poverty common on overcrowded urban worlds, This colonist decided to dedicate their life to helping the less fortunate. This crusade taught them how to care for the sick and the hungry.

SpaceHunter79.Title: space hunter
SpaceHunter79.Description: Now a man as well as proficient hunter and marksman, This colonist yearned for more. they took leave from their birth world, traveling the great expanse in search of exotic game.

SpaceMarine16.Title: space marine
SpaceMarine16.Description: This colonist was a warrior in an Imperial navy. their job was to punch into enemy starships, gun down the crew, and capture the ship intact. And They were good at it.

SpaceMarine19.Title: space marine
SpaceMarine19.Description: This colonist joined a squad of space marines known for their brutal efficiency at killing. their last name and their lack of emotion during combat inspired their nickname.

SpaceMarine5.Title: space marine
SpaceMarine5.Description:
This colonist joined Interplanetary Marines to travel the stars fight for their planet. they distinguished themself in several battles.

their experiences desensitized them to people around them, and their social skills degraded. But, they did learn how to fight.

SpaceMarine51.Title: space marine
SpaceMarine51.Description: This colonist was recruited into the security forces of an off-planet corporation. they defended their ships against pirates and engaged in private space warfare contracts.

SpaceMarine9.Title: space marine
SpaceMarine9.Description:
This colonist was a member of an elite imperial space warrior unit. Subjected to intense training, they developed remarkable combat skills.

their unit's quasi-religious ceremonies and beliefs helped them stay more-or-less sane through the horrors of the war.

SpaceMarine94.Title: space marine
SpaceMarine94.Description:
This colonist was a warrior in an Imperial navy.

their job was to punch into enemy starships, gun down the crew, and capture the ship intact. And They were good at it.

SpaceMarineMedic10.Title: space marine medic
SpaceMarineMedic10.Description:
This colonist joined a colony contact expeditionary force as a medic. The mission turned bad when the colonists turned out to be suffering from a zombifying disease. they ran and fought for days.

Cornered with wounded men, they sprayed enough ammunition to wear out four machine gun barrels, and learned the value of high-volume fire. But their nickname, Noob, stuck from that day forward.

SpaceMerchant97.Title: space merchant
SpaceMerchant97.Description: As part of a freelance interplanetary lifestyle, This colonist sought to dominate their romantic interests as much as their business adversaries. When they didn't have their own ship to fly, they worked charter ships for hire.

SpaceNavyDoctor72.Title: space navy doctor
SpaceNavyDoctor72.Description: This colonist served several tours as a doctor on one of the few warships defending their homeworld. they learned combat skills while fighting occasional pirate boarding parties, and became an expert at treating gruesome combat wounds.
SpaceNavyDoctor72.SkillGainsJoined: Construction -2; Plants -2; Mining -2; Shooting +3; Melee +1; Social +2; Medicine +5; Artistic -1

SpaceNavyTech37.Title: space navy tech
SpaceNavyTech37.Description:
This colonist was in a space navy for the most powerful planet in the local star group. they developed skills in maintenance, electronic systems, radar and imaging, and logistics management.

they served with pride and patriotic love for their planet.

SpaceNerd97.Title: space nerd
SpaceNerd97.Description: This colonist just wanted to be cool like their favorite superhero All-Might. they dreamed of going on space adventures and exploring new worlds. they also dreamed of chocolate... space chocolate.

SpacePirate55.Title: space pirate
SpacePirate55.Description: Piracy appears everywhere that governments are weak and society spread thin. This colonist was part of this age-old part of human existence, extorting and smashing peaceful trade ships for profit.

SpaceRaider71.Title: space raider
SpaceRaider71.Description: This colonist was the leader of a spaceborne pirate crew. Skipping between the rimworlds, they became the feared enemy of many settlements.

SpaceResearcher25.Title: space researcher
SpaceResearcher25.Description:
This colonist inherited their parents' ship and carried on their research.

their childhood experiences with diverse cultures allowed them to preserve their caring nature despite spending most of their life isolated in space.

SpacerOrphan77.Title: spacer orphan
SpacerOrphan77.Description:
Born among stars to a spacefaring family, the This colonist was the only survivor when their family's ship was destroyed.

They were forced to find a way to survive, and seek the joy of knowing another family.

SpaceshipChef41.Title: spaceship chef
SpaceshipChef41.Description: This colonist got a spot on a ship by becoming the ship's cook. they enjoyed cooking and helping the doctor clean wounds, but they never got used to cleaning the dishes.

SpaceshipSalesman34.Title: spaceship salesman
SpaceshipSalesman34.Description: This colonist tried their hand at various jobs, including building space rabbit cages and working at a mutant wheat research project. Finally, they found their true calling as a spacecraft salesman. Specializing in recreational spacecraft, their smooth talk and charming nature served them well.
SpaceshipSalesman34.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +2; Plants +1; Intellectual +2; Shooting +2; Social +8; Cooking -1; Medicine -1; Artistic -2; Crafting -1

SpaceSmuggler6.Title: space smuggler
SpaceSmuggler6.Description:
This colonist's parents used them to help smuggle contraband between a cluster of rimworlds.

Aided by their small size, This colonist became very adept at carrying out their parents' missions, learning weaponry, negotiations, and most of all smuggling.
SpaceSmuggler6.SkillGainsJoined: Plants -2; Intellectual -2; Shooting +3; Melee +3; Social +3; Medicine +2; Artistic -2

SpaceStationCook63.Title: space station cook
SpaceStationCook63.Description: The space station This colonist came from was far from any populated planets, and was in itself understaffed. For this reason, This colonist was forced to learn how to cook in order to keep the crew alive. While they appreciated this learning opportunity, they didn't appreciate the criticism which came with it, and has had self-esteem issues ever since.

SpaceTactician28.Title: space tactician
SpaceTactician28.Description: This colonist joined the space navy in an unstable system, fraught with large-scale interplanetary wars. they turned out to have a sharp mind for battle, and became adept at commanding combat units to great effect.

SpaceTechnician29.Title: space technician
SpaceTechnician29.Description: This colonist finally managed to flee their criminal life by getting a maintenance job on a nearby space station. they performed multiple repairing and building operations. they also used to participate in basic research activities and often defused co-workers' arguments. they never liked doing art.

SpaceTrafficker68.Title: space trafficker
SpaceTrafficker68.Description:
This colonist discovered They were heir of their distant uncle's weapons-trading business.

To protect the future of the company they went through extensive military training, in case of any "unforeseen circumstances".

SpaceyachtPilot89.Title: spaceyacht pilot
SpaceyachtPilot89.Description:
This colonist ferried wealthy businessmen and politicians to and from their home world.

        Witnessing the depths of hedonism these people descended to changed them in ways not even they understood.

SpecialForces13.Title: special forces
SpecialForces13.Description:
Give me a reason to kill - a good reason.

This colonist was a soldier and a skilled one - so skilled that they entered the special forces to battle militants and xenohuman raiders. they never imagined themself as lone hero, but they played their part in the group well.

SpeederRacer71.Title: speeder racer
SpeederRacer71.Description:
This colonist was the son of a fern farmer in the towering forests of Khalderia.

they found their first love in speeder racing, zipping in and out of the massive canopies and gorgeous vistas of their homeworld. The seedy underworld of racing also forced them to learn to defend themself with a quick word or a quicker shot.

Spiceminer81.Title: spiceminer
Spiceminer81.Description:
This colonist made their mark on the universe as a spice miner assigned to the lucrative mining colony of Rural Pen'The.

Little did they know, This colonist was about to embark on a career path that would change their life.

SpoiledBrat59.Title: spoiled brat
SpoiledBrat59.Description:
Born in a rich family, This colonist was given everything, and never developed basic work ethic or the foundations of a non-dependent personality.

They were expected to become one of the best doctors in the world.

SpoiledChild33.Title: spoiled child
SpoiledChild33.Description: This colonist grew up the child of an industrious colony manager. In this position, most manual and dangerous tasks were forbidden by their parents, but on the rim everyone has to dirty their hands.
SpoiledChild33.SkillGainsJoined: Construction -2; Plants +2; Mining -2; Social +2; Cooking +2; Artistic +2

SpoiledChild80.Title: spoiled child
SpoiledChild80.Description:
This colonist was the child of an industrious space engineer. their parents forbade most manual and dangerous tasks, so they learned art and music instead.

they loved animals, but their parents never let them have a pet - though they played with other people's pets a lot.

Spy58.Title: spy
Spy58.Description: This colonist was trained by their government in infiltration and espionage. they learned to keep a cool head and to talk their way out of tight situations. When talking didn't work, They were capable of more violent direct action.

Spymaster41.Title: spymaster
Spymaster41.Description: As soon as They were old enough, This colonist was given the post of spymaster for their house. their cold, calculating nature made them a natural at the arts of blade, poison, and betrayal.

Stableboy49.Title: stableboy
Stableboy49.Description:
This colonist was a stableboy on a medieval planet, mucking dung almost every day to earn their keep.

By the time They were exiting childhood, This colonist had saved up enough money to pay a space trader to take them offworld.

StalwartFarmer21.Title: stalwart farmer
StalwartFarmer21.Description: With the farm under constant threat from brigands, This colonist learned to defend themself with their father's hunting rifle. they also mastered how to construct fences to keep livestock in and the local wildlife out. This colonist tried to paint a picture of their home and learned they can only draw scribbles and ducks.
StalwartFarmer21.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +3; Plants +3; Intellectual -2; Mining +2; Shooting +5; Melee +2

StalwartFarmer90.Title: stalwart farmer
StalwartFarmer90.Description:
With the farm under constant threat from brigands, This colonist learned to defend themself with their father's rifle. they also mastered how to construct walls to keep livestock in and predators out.

they once tried to paint a picture of their home, but discovered that they could only draw scribbles and ducks.

StarfighterPilot79.Title: starfighter pilot
StarfighterPilot79.Description:
After years of training and drilling, This colonist finally became a starfighter pilot.

Hundreds of combat missions later, they grew bored and started seeking newer thrills. they joined a band of space pirates, which eagerly welcomed them because of their piloting skill.
StarfighterPilot79.SkillGainsJoined: Intellectual +4; Mining -3; Shooting +7; Melee +3; Artistic -3; Animals -3

StarforceCadet79.Title: starforce cadet
StarforceCadet79.Description:
Raised on Amen-Ti, glitterworld capital of the Star Empire, [PAWN_nameFull] had an easy childhood.

As a youth, This colonist decided that joining the Starforce would be their way of giving back to the Empire.

StarKnight5.Title: star knight
StarKnight5.Description:
Abducted from their medieval homeworld, This colonist later escaped their captors via an impressive display of swordsmanship.

For a moment, as they drifted in the escape pod, their childhood dream of becoming a knight among the stars felt so real. Then they crash-landed.

StarshipDoctor37.Title: starship doctor
StarshipDoctor37.Description: This colonist was a doctor on a starship. They were a brilliant surgeon and dabbled in research of their own. However, They were quite reclusive and never had the best bedside manner.

StarshipJanitor33.Title: starship janitor
StarshipJanitor33.Description: While other passengers pass the years between star systems in cryptosleep sarcophagi, This colonist had to wake up at periodic intervals to perform inspections, check the navigation systems, and to oil the mechanoids.

StarSquire9.Title: star squire
StarSquire9.Description:
Born on a medieval world, This colonist's first memory is of gazing up into the night's sky. 

Ever since, they dreamed of squiring for a knight amidst the star-filled heavens. their focus on that vision left them somewhat single-minded.

StateEngineer60.Title: state engineer
StateEngineer60.Description:
This colonist enrolled in the state weapons research program.

While brilliant in their work, They were so enthusiastic in testing their creations that they accidentally wounded some colleagues and was marked as unfit for service.

StationSecurity38.Title: station security
StationSecurity38.Description:
This colonist was commissioned as a special constable on a network of space stations. There they prevented illegal human trafficking.

Once, fire broke out on the station, and they saved many from the flames. Since then, they has avoided fires.

StationWhelp94.Title: station whelp
StationWhelp94.Description: This colonist spent their childhood as a penniless orphan living on a space station. they managed to scrape by doing filthy jobs and stealing. they became so violent due to poor treatment by their “betters” that They were banished from the station, just to be picked up by space pirates.

SteamworldTinker38.Title: steamworld tinker
SteamworldTinker38.Description:
In the slums of a steamworld, This colonist developed a fascination with machines and contraptions. they found they preferred their company to that of other people. 

their remarkable dexterity earned them a steady stream of pocket change, and they spent every penny on spare parts and tools to play with.

StellarPirate10.Title: stellar pirate
StellarPirate10.Description:
This colonist was captain of a pirate ship. they and their crew made their living capturing traders who wandered off-course.

They were known for their balanced approach to problems, building, fighting, or negotiating as needed.

StewardsAssisant28.Title: Steward's assistant
StewardsAssisant28.Description:
A steward on medieval merchant ships, This colonist was well-traveled on their homeworld by their early teens.

The constant orders from their captain, however, fostered a defiant streak, as well as a general disaste for anything they considered to be busywork.

StewKeeper95.Title: stew keeper
StewKeeper95.Description: This colonist prepared meals from the plants and animals brought in by gatherers, farmers, and hunters of their tribe. they had to make sure it was calorie-efficient, long-lasting, and healthy. they often processed and sometime gathered plants themself.

StilettoAssassin34.Title: stiletto assassin
StilettoAssassin34.Description:
Because of their skills, This colonist developed a sense of superiority. In time, they lost their sense of empathy. they often got into fights, and discovered how easy it is to kill a person.

After realizing their talents, they became one of the most efficient assassins in the system.

Storyteller63.Title: storyteller
Storyteller63.Description:
This colonist traveled their world recounting the legends that they had studied.

Obsessed with the legends of their people, This colonist seeks someone who can help them grow scales on their skin, so they too can be as the ancients were.

StoryWriter67.Title: story writer
StoryWriter67.Description: As a child, This colonist was addicted to reading. they would spend all day in their local library with their nose in a book. When budget cuts forced the library to close, This colonist was distraught. they decided to fill the gap by writing their own stories instead.

Straggler71.Title: straggler
Straggler71.Description:
Despite being blessed with parental love, This colonist hardly knew their parents.

They were frequently left to their own devices which meant more time devoted to exploring their interests... and getting into trouble.

Streamer52.Title: Streamer
Streamer52.Description:
This colonist worked as a videogame streamer, and was known for their monkey-related impressions and jokes.

A pandemic forced them to go into cryptosleep for several years. During their sleep, They were launched on an interstellar diplomatic mission. Nothing was heard of them ever again.

StreetChild4.Title: street child
StreetChild4.Description: This colonist's drug-addicted mother died, leaving them an orphan at a young age. To stay alive, they resorted to theft, and when necessary, prostitution. When This colonist was caught stealing from a church, the priestess saw a wounded but smart child, and took them in to give them a second chance at life.

StreetKid19.Title: street kid
StreetKid19.Description:
Growing up on the streets and fields of a rimworld, This colonist's their only friend was a dog named Rest. The pair scraped by, finding just enough food to survive.

When They were 13 years old, a criminal group took them under their wing.

StreetPeddler66.Title: street peddler
StreetPeddler66.Description:
Growing up on an industrial midworld where robberies and muggings weren't uncommon, This colonist helped support their family by making small trinkets and novelties to sell to passers-by.

they learned early on that it wasn't always what they knew, but who they knew that would get them far in life.

StreetRat81.Title: street rat
StreetRat81.Description: This colonist belonged to a gang of street thieves. their days were spent picking pockets, settling disputes over territory, or high on whatever drugs they could get their hands on.

StreetUrchin45.Title: street urchin
StreetUrchin45.Description:
Born to a poor family, This colonist was a sickly child who never quite developed the strength of their siblings.

their parents, unable to afford to provide for them and certain they couldn't pay their own way, threw them to the streets. they learned hard and fast how to survive by any means necessary.

StreetUrchin53.Title: street urchin
StreetUrchin53.Description:
Born to a poor family on an urbworld, This colonist was abandoned on the streets at a young age.

they learned to steal and kill to survive the ruthless streets, gaining skills in melee and ranged combat. There was little time for talk in their life.

StreetUrchin74.Title: street urchin
StreetUrchin74.Description:
After running away from home, This colonist had to live on the streets.

they grew up fast, and learned early that they had to figure out how to fool people into connecting with them.

Student65.Title: student
Student65.Description:
This colonist studied chemistry and quantum mechanics for entertainment.

They were very good at convincing others to do their physical work, and made it a goal in life to avoid manual labor.

StudentEngineer34.Title: student engineer
StudentEngineer34.Description:
A genius child, This colonist was put in a special training program covering aerospace warfare and engineering.

One day, they tried to befriend a squirrel by giving it a bracelet. The squirrel bit them, earning them the nickname “Squirrel {PAWN_gender ? Boy : Girl}”.

This colonist came to believe that work involving manual labor is beneath them.
StudentEngineer34.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +2; Intellectual +4; Mining -2; Cooking -2; Artistic -2; Crafting +4

StudentSocialite89.Title: student socialite
StudentSocialite89.Description:
This colonist learned politics in an elite training school for socially gifted students on Kalthas IV.

While They were naturally adept at reading and manipulating people, they found no joy in it. they left the academy several years before graduation.

SuperSoldier95.Title: super soldier
SuperSoldier95.Description:
Product of a super-soldier program run by a now-deposed government, This colonist was lost. they survived the final suicide attack on the enemy mothership. What now.

For the first time in their life, they had no orders, no objectives. they rose from wreckage and strove towards uncertainty, towards freedom.

SuperSoldier99.Title: super soldier
SuperSoldier99.Description:
This colonist's government ran an experimental super-soldier development program. They kidnapped thousands of infants, conditioned their minds with drugs and machines, and trained them to fight.

Most infants died, but This colonist did not. they killed their first man at age six, and was fighting in field operations not long after.

SystemLord77.Title: system lord
SystemLord77.Description: For This colonist, ruling a country, or even a planet, was not good enough. they sought to expand their influence across the system - by legal or extralegal means.

SystemsEngineer1.Title: systems engineer
SystemsEngineer1.Description:
Like their father, This colonist was a systems engineer. They were qualified in both colony and ship systems.

When not working, they would make mechanical figurines, read old books, or occasionally travel to uncharted worlds. Being introverted, they did these things mostly alone.

Tamer79.Title: tamer
Tamer79.Description: This colonist's role in their tribe was to connect with the natural world around - especially the world of animals. In addition to fulfilling a spiritual role, they also tamed wild beasts and cared for them as they served the tribe.

Taster16.Title: taster
Taster16.Description: As the food taster for a medieval king, This colonist sampled any dish served at the royal table. they lived a decadent lifestyle at court, growing fat and doing very little real work.

Taxonomist0.Title: taxonomist
Taxonomist0.Description: This colonist traveled between star systems, studying and classifying the plant and animal life they found in the hopes of creating a complete catalogue.

Teacher20.Title: teacher
Teacher20.Description: This colonist was educated in the liberal arts and taught at a public school. They were widely knowledgeable and well-liked by their students.

TechEnthusiast28.Title: tech enthusiast
TechEnthusiast28.Description: This colonist had all the latest gadgets as a child. they spent all their time playing games with AIs instead of with other children. they always felt awkward around new people.

TechHead8.Title: tech-head
TechHead8.Description:
Standing on the ship hull with their father in an child-size EVA suit, This colonist loved space from a young age.

They were put in a Civil Academics Program. While pretending to be like their father, they spent their time taking care of plants in their messy room. their nickname was given for their love of circles.

TechnicalKid1.Title: technical kid
TechnicalKid1.Description: This colonist loved nothing more then to forget the world around them and focus on the task at hand.

Technician9.Title: technician
Technician9.Description: As an IT technician, This colonist didn't have much time to write code any more. they got called to work all the time to fix failures in the cryptosleep chamber and AI persuasion systems.

TechnologyDoctor35.Title: soldier-farmer
TechnologyDoctor35.Description: This colonist was a farmer on their midworld, and spent their free time practicing with guns. they knew how important the skills of farming and shooting would be in hard times, and trained to serve in a local militia.

TechScholar75.Title: farm kid
TechScholar75.Description: This colonist hung around a group of local luddite farmers on their midworld. They helped them practice shooting every single day, and passed on some basic farming skills. They also taught This colonist how to focus on working hard with your hands instead of getting distracted by highfalutin' ideas and clever machines.

TestSubject15.Title: test subject
TestSubject15.Description: On the most corrupt urbworlds, scientists without a moral compass commit unspeakable atrocities in the name of research. This colonist was kept alone in a sealed facility from birth and subjected to a variety of behavioural experiments in an attempt to turn them into a perfect super-soldier.

TestSubject39.Title: test subject
TestSubject39.Description: This colonist enrolled in a scientific study that promised it could make them smarter. Unfortunately, the side effects were very different than they expected. they went insane and killed a number of people before escaping.

TestSubject82.Title: test subject
TestSubject82.Description:
Test subject #11,529,914 of experiment #56,048 spent their childhood in white rooms performing mental and physical tests.

their only companion was a voice that called itself Mother. Mother rewarded success with praise - and failure with harsh punishment.

TestSubject90.Title: test subject
TestSubject90.Description: Kidnapped as a teenager, This colonist was an unwilling test subject in experimental gene therapies. Labs and scientists scare them.

TestSubject92.Title: test subject
TestSubject92.Description:
This colonist's tests went from geometry to quantum physics, and they could run the grand gauntlet without a scratch.

One day, Mother said that their final test lay beyond the red door, and that even if they couldn't hear her voice, Mother would always be there.

TheaterTechnician80.Title: theater technician
TheaterTechnician80.Description:
This colonist spent countless hours behind the scenes of a famous theater. they built scenery, programmed lights, and monitored the machines that moved the sets.

Off duty, they would talk with the cast members. Navigating the social drama of the actors helped them learn how to communicate well and manipulate others.

Tinkerer11.Title: tinkerer
Tinkerer11.Description:
This colonist spent their spare time creating things from their imagination out of scrap metal and discarded machinery.

they created simple robots and small tools, for both for fun and for utility.

Tinkerer79.Title: tinkerer
Tinkerer79.Description: This colonist grew up on a scrap-heap of a planet - the garbage dump of other planets in the system. they learned to make new machines from the dead parts of old ones. With some friends, they eventually escaped on a salvaged and repaired ship.

Tinkerer86.Title: tinkerer
Tinkerer86.Description:
"How does this work?

Why does this move?

Maybe if I change this... oops, I hope it works better... or maybe I broke it..."

ToasterRepairman22.Title: toaster repairman
ToasterRepairman22.Description:
Good with their hands and passionate about technology, This colonist aspired to invent gadgets and machines that would change their home world forever.

A few failed and occasionally disastrous creations later, they gave up on their dream and took a job more befitting their skill set.

ToolMechanic77.Title: tool mechanic
ToolMechanic77.Description:
This colonist was a famous tool mechanic on a dusty rimworld.

After their firm closed due to scandal, they joined a tribe to survive, crafting fine knives and hammers, traveling, and dealing their wares between settlements.

Torturer37.Title: torturer
Torturer37.Description: Working for a tyrannical dictator, This colonist earned a reputation as an expert in 'persuasion.' Any prisoner who went down into the dungeons left with no secrets - and with This colonist's smile scarred permanently into their nightmares.

TournamentFighter28.Title: tournament fighter
TournamentFighter28.Description:
Motivated by the violence in their environment, This colonist studied martial arts, eventually signing up for an unarmed fighting tournament.

Unlike their opponents, This colonist looked to the ancient warriors for guidance. they trained from dusk till dawn, perfecting their skills.

ToxicChild96.Title: toxic child
ToxicChild96.Description:
Growing up on a an industrial planet, This colonist started working in a chemical plant at age of six. Years of exposure to industrial toxins left them mentally scarred.

they eventually blew up the facility and escaped the planet in a stolen cargo ship.

TradersChild62.Title: traders' child
TradersChild62.Description:
This colonist grew up in a family of nomadic traders, making a living from selling and buying goods on many worlds.

This colonist learned the customs and methods of trade of many cultures by participating in their parents' business.

TragicLoner87.Title: tragic loner
TragicLoner87.Description:
This colonist was involved in a traumatic accident that resulted in them killing their own family.

Cast out from society, They were left with only their animal companions and several engineering textbooks to keep them company.

TraineeAlchemist64.Title: trainee alchemist
TraineeAlchemist64.Description: This colonist grew up on a medieval world. they learned the basics of alchemy and medicine in one the few monastic schools on their planet.

TransferStudent10.Title: transfer student
TransferStudent10.Description:
A midworld child, This colonist's wealthy parents sent them to a nearby glitterworld to receive a better education.

This colonist was a talented student. However, due to their family's wealth, they never had to do dumb labor.

TraumatizedYouth87.Title: traumatized youth
TraumatizedYouth87.Description:
This colonist lived on a pleasant midworld.

their body purist mother fell sick with heart disease. In desperation, This colonist's father abducted innocent people and harvested their hearts. This colonist's father was arrested, but the child remained scarred from the experience.

TravelingBard93.Title: Traveling bard
TravelingBard93.Description:
This colonist joined the famous Star Pilots On Channel K (aka S.P.O.C.K) and toured the star system, but eventually the band split up and their fame faded away.

they ended up as a travelling bard playing on their portable synthesizer as they traveled from spaceport to spaceport.

TreasureHunter82.Title: treasure hunter
TreasureHunter82.Description:
This colonist explored outlying rimworlds in hopes of finding rare treasures.

After succeeding in finding one legendary sculpture, They were betrayed by their men. they survived their treasonous attack, but the sculpture was taken.

they created the Anvil Mercenary Company to help them seek revenge.

TreehouseBuilder86.Title: treehouse builder
TreehouseBuilder86.Description: This colonist built houses among, and sometimes suspended in, the trees for their people to use while traveling or foraging. This colonist learned how to best find and use wild plants, and how to fight off wild animals.

TribalThunderer45.Title: tribal thunderer
TribalThunderer45.Description: Years ago, This colonist's tribe stumbled upon an abandoned gun vault. Believing the weapons to be sacred gifts, the shaman would select a child born under superstitious circumstances and assign them the honour of bearing one to defend the village. This colonist is such a child.

TribeChild19.Title: tribe child
TribeChild19.Description: This colonist grew up in our tribe.

TribeChild40.Title: tribe child
TribeChild40.Description:
This colonist grew up in a tribe, running around the village, moving with the muffalo herds, learning essential skills from their parents.

they never learned to read and never saw a machine that wasn't an ancient ruin.

TribeMember57.Title: tribe member
TribeMember57.Description: This colonist became an adult in our tribe. their story is still being written.

TurtleHerder41.Title: turtle herder
TurtleHerder41.Description:
Born to settler folk, This colonist's family had a beloved herd of turtles, who protected them by absorbing shots from raiders.

At a young age, They were entrusted with the turtles. they bred them, successfully - too successfully. The massive turtle herds consumed every food source and destroyed the local ecosystem.

TynanCustomAdulthood.Title: game developer
TynanCustomAdulthood.Description:
This colonist was an independent game developer.

After an early success, their career quickly degenerated into a circus of misguided ideas, deals gone wrong, and desperate, failed PR stunts.

TynanCustomChildhood.Title: punk
TynanCustomChildhood.Description: This colonist spent his childhood selling knockoff cigarettes to 15-year-olds. The cigarettes were often full of grass clippings.

Undertaker93.Title: undertaker
Undertaker93.Description: This colonist roamed, offering grief assistance to those who've had a recent loss. While they never shied away from physical confrontation, they prefers to confront tough situations with a calm word.

UnethicalDoctor29.Title: unethical doctor
UnethicalDoctor29.Description:
This colonist became a doctor to save lives and research medicine. they soon realized the only way to make progress on their research was to perform experiments on human patients.

they often used patients for their experiments - whether they were willing or not.

UnstableButcher31.Title: unstable butcher
UnstableButcher31.Description: This colonist began hearing voices. The animals were talking to them, insulting him. they came to hate them, and eventually killed their furry former friends. they started selling the meat just to get human interaction.
UnstableButcher31.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +4; Intellectual -4; Mining +3; Melee +6; Social +2; Medicine -3

UnwantedSurvivor67.Title: unwanted survivor
UnwantedSurvivor67.Description:
This colonist's noble family did not want them, but could not afford to be seen directly assassinating them either. They attempted to get them killed by assigning them dangerous training without proper protection at too young an age.

Against all odds, This colonist survived the jousting contests, horsewar matches, riverrun competitions and warzones. In the end, it only made them stronger.

UpperUrbworlder12.Title: upper urbworlder
UpperUrbworlder12.Description: This colonist had a privileged childhood on a major urbworld. Living in an apartment far above the dense poverty of the city, they spent most of their time reading or drawing the cityscape they saw through their window.

UprightDiplomat49.Title: upright diplomat
UprightDiplomat49.Description:
As a diplomat, This colonist was assigned to deal with diplomatic tasks in the blood-soaked outer rim sectors.

they hoped to end the endless wars, until their consularship, the St. Anthem, was attacked by a raider fleet.

UrbanLordling82.Title: urban lordling
UrbanLordling82.Description:
This colonist was born to a royal house with a grand manor in a great city. they spent their youth in lessons on politics.

Whenever they could, they would escape with their friends to explore the half-built substructure of the metropolis.

UrbworldArmyBrat84.Title: urbworld army brat
UrbworldArmyBrat84.Description:
This colonist grew up on an urbworld military base. They were too young to fight, but they learned to make themself useful in other ways.

they became familiar with guns and military equipment, but never really got in touch with the natural world.

UrbworldChild56.Title: urbworld child
UrbworldChild56.Description:
This colonist had an isolated upbringing on an urbworld. their hatred of heights kept them indoors often, and made them an introverted child.

When they did go out onto the catwalks of the city, they enjoyed playing war games, becoming proficient with various simulation weapons.

UrbworldCriminal6.Title: urbworld criminal
UrbworldCriminal6.Description:
Born into bad circumstance on an overpopulated urbworld, This colonist turned to small-time crime as a way to avoid starvation and hypothermia.

Robbery and murder were daily activities for them. This colonist learned that surviving was winning.

UrbworldDrone32.Title: urbworld drone
UrbworldDrone32.Description: This colonist worked as a mindless construction drone on a massive urbworld. Though they is now freed from the brutal social experiments to which They were subjected, they remains incapable of creative thought and leadership.

UrbworldEnforcer11.Title: urbworld enforcer
UrbworldEnforcer11.Description:
This colonist was an enforcer of law on an ancient urbworld.

they dealt with the worst of humanity, from protecting greedy urbworld nobility in their spire palaces to rooting out cannibal cults in the deepest reaches of the underground hive.

UrbworldEntrepreneur14.Title: urbworld entrepreneur
UrbworldEntrepreneur14.Description:
In the urbworlds, most suffer. But someone has to run the corporations.

This colonist learned the skills of the trade - greasing palms and technical analysis. they is a sociointellectual machine.

UrbworldHooligan12.Title: urbworld hooligan
UrbworldHooligan12.Description: This colonist grew up in a dangerous urbworld. they quickly learned how to get their daily meal - by crime. Such means left little to no space for cooking and growing activities.

UrbworldPimp93.Title: urbworld pimp
UrbworldPimp93.Description:
At first, This colonist made a small profit from selling drugs. Then, they switched to selling women and made a fortune.

they developed great skills with their fists. they also learned to fix up the injuries they inflicted on the girls.

UrbworldPolitican92.Title: urbworld politican
UrbworldPolitican92.Description:
It's no secret that the Companies own much of the urbworlds, but someone has to take the bribes. This colonist was one such figurehead.

they learned how to manipulate the hopes and dreams of the people while living comfortably in a penthouse.

UrbworldRebel56.Title: urbworld rebel
UrbworldRebel56.Description: Most of the people on This colonist's world gave up their individuality to join together in an online hivemind. This colonist joined a rebel faction that rejected technology entirely.

UrbworldSergeant50.Title: urbworld sergeant
UrbworldSergeant50.Description:
This colonist's passion for all things militaristic kept with them all the way to adulthood.

After enrolling as a local policeman, They were soon promoted to sergeant.

UrbworldSexSlave25.Title: urbworld sex slave
UrbworldSexSlave25.Description: This colonist was sold into sexual slavery. Having been designed to be inhumanly attractive and too weak to rebel against their masters, They were passed between dozens of owners and knew nothing of freedom.

UrbworldUrchin6.Title: urbworld urchin
UrbworldUrchin6.Description:
This colonist was born in the darkest slums of their urban homeworld. Neglected by their mother, they learned to survive on their own, battling for every scrap of food they saw.

Eventually, as their talents exceeded their peers, they ascended from the depths to the surface streets and left their mother behind.

UrbworldUrchin61.Title: urbworld urchin
UrbworldUrchin61.Description: The urbworlds - ancient and deep industrial cityscapes bursting with humanity and poison. This colonist grew up in the dark, unwanted reaches of such a place. they had to fight for every scrap of food.

UrbworldUrchin90.Title: urbworld urchin
UrbworldUrchin90.Description: Abandoned among the filthy concrete spires, This colonist never knew their parents. they never received formal education, and often resorted to doing menial labor in exchange for food. Sometimes they lied, cheated, and stole to survive.

Vagabond73.Title: vagabond
Vagabond73.Description: This colonist awoke on a dangerous planet with no resources and few survival skills. they bounced between camps, doing whatever work needed to be done, just to see the sun rise once more.

VatgrownAssassin20.Title: vatgrown assassin
VatgrownAssassin20.Description: This colonist was not made as a man, but a cold hearted assassin. They were bio-engineered by scientists, and trained as a killer. They were bred to have no emotion, no feelings, and no care for who lives, and who dies.

VatgrownChild11.Title: vatgrown child
VatgrownChild11.Description: This colonist spent most of their childhood in a growth vat.

VatgrownMedic53.Title: vatgrown medic
VatgrownMedic53.Description: Raised to be a combat medic, This colonist was trained in firearms as well as medicine. their favorite phrase when coming upon a wounded soldier was, "Life or death?" Most chose life.

VatgrownScientist91.Title: vatgrown scientist
VatgrownScientist91.Description:
This colonist was grown to be a perfect scientist, with a mind perfectly tuned for physics and chemistry.

their creators used them as a teaching aid on mind design, hoping they would eventually grow to be a great mind and continue their research.

VatgrownSlavegirl8.Title: vatgrown slavegirl
VatgrownSlavegirl8.Description: This colonist was vat-grown as a slave in an illegal urbworld laboratory. As a young child, They were taught only to cook, clean and serve their masters. For most of their childhood, they knew nothing else.

VatgrownSoldier8.Title: vatgrown soldier
