VatgrownSoldier8.Description: This colonist wasn't made as a person, but as an instrument of destruction. Grown in a bioweapons facility and taught combat during their accelerated growth, This colonist still has a proclivity for combat of all kinds and an aversion to human contact.

VengefulChild43.Title: vengeful child
VengefulChild43.Description: As a child, This colonist returned to their village to find that it had been wiped out by bandits. they swore revenge on the attackers and began a violent rampage across the wilderness.

VengefulExplorer54.Title: vengeful explorer
VengefulExplorer54.Description:
A violent drifter without a home, This colonist and their father fought many battles across hundreds of years. they became a grizzled fighter and crack shot.

After their father's death in battle, This colonist began exploring the stars alone, seeking their father's killer, on the hunt for revenge.

VengefulHunter32.Title: vengeful hunter
VengefulHunter32.Description: Following the death of a close friend by animal attack, This colonist hunted the beast responsible. they tracked it to a nearby village, only to find one of the villagers wearing its pelt.

VengefulNomad67.Title: vengeful nomad
VengefulNomad67.Description:
After refusing the wild demands of a tyrannical king, This colonist's nomad band was marked as an outlaw group and systematically hunted.

This colonist's family was eventually captured. Those who weren't killed were taken as slaves. Sold to the owner of a manufactory, This colonist swore that one day they would have their revenge.

VersatileWorker13.Title: versatile worker
VersatileWorker13.Description:
Spending their later teenage years in a colony of settlers, they offered what little skills they had to anyone who would take him.

Being a quick learner, they honed many of their skills and, apart from their crippling inability to understand fire, is now a fully functioning adult.

Veterinarian99.Title: veterinarian
Veterinarian99.Description: This colonist treated sick and injured animals for a living. Seeing their suffering affected their stance on the practice of eating meat, and for many years they lived as a vegetarian.

VideoGamer16.Title: video gamer
VideoGamer16.Description:
This colonist grew up on a midworld, mostly locked in their room, playing video games. They were warm-hearted, with a deep fondness for animals.

As they grew up, they turned to drugs to enhance their reality. During these trying times they found passion and refuge in the gym.

VideoGamer55.Title: video gamer
VideoGamer55.Description: This colonist was raised in a glitterworld. Everything they wanted came to him. In school They were a social butterfly. At home, they spent their time looking up the newest gadgets and playing their favourite video games.

VideoProducer83.Title: video producer
VideoProducer83.Description:
Too awkward to socialize, This colonist found comfort in the production of videos. Oddly, people enjoyed their videos, calling them "perfect sitcom dramas".

This colonist took advantage of this and broadcast more, ever hopeful that they would be contacted by the Wizards.

VidtubeStar98.Title: vidtube star
VidtubeStar98.Description:
This colonist's hobby was making videos for the popular video sharing service Vidtube. they made everything from video game reviews to pasta cooking guides.

they gained over a million followers.

Villain89.Title: villain
Villain89.Description: After rising to the top of their criminal band, This colonist was taught the arts of villainy, from handling firearms to developing new weapons technologies. they excelled at bending others to their will.

VinhoKing98.Title: vinho king
VinhoKing98.Description:
After prohibition came to Aracena VI, This colonist expanded their underground liquor business until it dominated the market on two continents. They called them the Vinho King.

Though they mostly controlled their competition by masterful political maneuvering, They were not above the occasional beat-down or stiletto assassination.

VoidRaider74.Title: void raider
VoidRaider74.Description: Craving adventure and glory, This colonist set out across the void with a raider band, swearing their loyalty to their band and brothers, and spreading their glory through the stars with their blade and pistol in hand.

VoidspaceRaider94.Title: voidspace raider
VoidspaceRaider94.Description:
After years of seeking the assassin that broke up their family, This colonist was offered a place with a group of space-faring raiders. they accepted, hoping to find the killer they sought.

Due to their seemingly-unending ability to narrowly escape danger, they earned the nickname 'Blackjack' in recognition of their luck.

VoyagerChild94.Title: voyager child
VoyagerChild94.Description:
This colonist was raised on an R&D starship, and spent most of their childhood travelling through the void.

Approaching a mysterious planetoid, the ship was severely damaged. their next memory is of the ship heading out of orbit, fully repaired. they soon developed an unnatural gift for technological research.

VRAddict29.Title: VR addict
VRAddict29.Description: This colonist was a VR head - someone who is permanently jacked into the virtual gaming universe by their spinal plug. they moved through their daily tasks barely aware of the physical reality around him. This left them nearly unable to socialize.

VRDesigner87.Title: VR designer
VRDesigner87.Description: This colonist designed virtual reality simulations for glitterworld citizens. they put great effort into the details of their virtual worlds, learning all they could about plant life to make their landscapes as realistic as possible.

WanderingCrafter42.Title: wandering crafter
WanderingCrafter42.Description: This colonist continued to follow their parents' nomadic ways, supporting themself with their crafting skills. But wandering is a hard life, and they often thought of finding somewhere to settle down and put their skills to good use.

WanderingHealer52.Title: wandering healer
WanderingHealer52.Description:
This colonist studied to be a doctor, but was dissatisfied with their practice on an otherwise peaceful midworld.

Instead, they chose to pull up roots and travel to the rimworlds in order to care for people who needed them most.

WarBastard60.Title: war bastard
WarBastard60.Description:
This colonist was born nine months after their mother's town was conquered by enemy soldiers. The child of violence with no acknowledged father, This colonist grew up at the bottom of the social pyramid.

their mother instilled her bitterness towards men and war into This colonist. their pet rabbit offered more warmth than any human in their life.

WarChief97.Title: war chief
WarChief97.Description: This colonist was a tribal gang leader on a rimworld. For them, the battlefield is a game, and there is nothing more fun than the fires of war.

WarChild24.Title: war child
WarChild24.Description: This colonist's parents were drafted into a civil war. Growing up surrounded by fighting and death, they became well-accustomed to tragedy. their expressive side, however, never developed.

Warlordess56.Title: warlordess
Warlordess56.Description: This colonist was the tough leader of a pirate band. they would accept any challenge, no matter how violent or dangerous. Others called them a killing machine.
Warlordess56.SkillGainsJoined: Mining -2; Melee -2; Social +6; Cooking +6; Medicine +5; Artistic +3

Warmaster54.Title: warmaster
Warmaster54.Description:
This colonist was warmaster to a mid-level royal house. they oversaw military aspects of the family's strategy.

On the rare occasion a battle occurred, This colonist directed the military commanders.

Warmonger35.Title: warmonger
Warmonger35.Description: This colonist revelled in bloodshed. Soldiers who served with them were terrified of their ferocity. They rarely socialized with This colonist, and they did not mind the isolation.

WarRefugee51.Title: war refugee
WarRefugee51.Description:
War broke out in This colonist's home when They were a baby. their parents fled with them, seeking safety wherever they could find it. This colonist's earliest memories are of being taught how to defend themself.

The violence and destruction they witnessed left them scarred for life.

WarRefugee96.Title: war refugee
WarRefugee96.Description:
A war broke on out This colonist's home planet.

Gathering what little food and belongings they could, This colonist and their father stole a ship and escaped into space.

Warrior73.Title: warrior
Warrior73.Description: This colonist was a war hero during their planet's third world war. they helped prevent the launch of nuclear weapons during a particularly tense standoff.

Warrior94.Title: warrior
Warrior94.Description: This colonist was a fearsome warrior, proficient with many weapons. they participated in many battles.

WarshipCaptain67.Title: warship captain
WarshipCaptain67.Description:
Years of being commanding officer of an advanced corvette taught This colonist the art of leadership, the techniques of higher engineering, and how to stay calm while enemies try to kill you.

Unfortunately, This colonist only very rarely had contact with nature.
WarshipCaptain67.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +3; Plants -3; Intellectual +5; Shooting +3; Melee +2; Social +5; Animals -3

WastelandWanderer81.Title: wasteland wanderer
WastelandWanderer81.Description:
Born into a wealthy family on a desert world, This colonist was cast out after a hired attack squad destroyed their ancestral home.

The boy managed to hide in a cooling duct beneath their family's villa. Vowing revenge against the killers and whomever had hired them, This colonist struck out into the wasteland, alone.

WealthyStudent59.Title: wealthy student
WealthyStudent59.Description:
This colonist was born on a wealthy glitterworld. they studied at the Caspian school of Engineering, and excelled in mathematics and computer programming.

This colonist grew up in clean, sterile environments. they never saw a farm or livestock.
WealthyStudent59.SkillGainsJoined: Construction +2; Plants -2; Intellectual +4; Mining -2; Cooking -2; Crafting +3

Weaver63.Title: weaver
Weaver63.Description: This colonist was an expert at working wool, plant fibers and natural dyes into beautiful clothing for their kin. their handicrafts were traded frequently with other settlements.

WhiteHatHacker82.Title: white-hat hacker
WhiteHatHacker82.Description: From their computer, This colonist helped rid the online world of bad people.

WildChild5.Title: wild child
WildChild5.Description:
This colonist was abandoned on a toxic world overgrown with hostile plant life. they became accustomed early to the cold burn of loneliness.

they learned to fight, but ate their food raw and uncooked.

WildlifeRanger99.Title: wildlife ranger
WildlifeRanger99.Description:
Dismayed at the poachers driving several animal species to near-extinction, This colonist became a wildlife ranger. they cared for and protect the animals - by force if necessary.

they grew to hate people slaughtering animals for luxury and profit.

WillCustomAdulthood.Title: labyrinth maker
WillCustomAdulthood.Description: This colonist designed elaborate entertainment mazes for the glitterworld elite. Even now, they thinks of little else.

WillCustomChildhood.Title: maze child
WillCustomChildhood.Description: This colonist grew up in a research camp on a deadworld. their parents were astrobiologists studying mysterious labyrinthine formations beneath the planet's crust. they spent most of his time wandering those tunnels, wondering what otherworldly entity could have created them.

Winerunner8.Title: winerunner
Winerunner8.Description:
Abandoned by their parents, This colonist was raised by the monks of the Novo Mosteiro dos Jerónimos monastery on Aracena VI.

The monks taught them discipline and hard work. In return, they would go into the city and 'acquire' exotic wines for the monks' nightly tastings.

WolfPackMember26.Title: wolf pack member
WolfPackMember26.Description:
This colonist was discarded by their family. Raised by wolves, they ran, hunted, and defended their pack.

they learned to fight efficiently by tooth and claw. they also learned brutally effective primal hunting strategies.

WorkCampSlave37.Title: work camp slave
WorkCampSlave37.Description:
This colonist grew up as a slave to a particularly nasty noble family on a medieval world. 

While they received no formal education, the harsh labor regimen made their body strong.

WorldSlider42.Title: world slider
WorldSlider42.Description: This colonist was raised by a world-hopping band of criminals. they learned not to leave evidence of their presence in case the group had to leave in a hurry. they also learned about medicine and hand-to-hand combat from their fellow criminals.

WreckageExplorer93.Title: wreckage explorer
WreckageExplorer93.Description: This colonist was tasked with watching their family's herds, but often shirked their duties to go exploring the crashed warships scattered around the planet.

YoungMaster23.Title: young master
YoungMaster23.Description:
Born to two medics, This colonist longed for power. their keen intellect and charisma helped them gain the respect of their peers.

Deciding that the best way to gain power was to climb the ranks of the imperial military, they joined at the youngest possible age.

YoungPirate71.Title: young pirate
YoungPirate71.Description:
This colonist was born to pirates, in a dirty metal room that smelled of motor oil.

They were never exactly taught anything, but they still learned the ways of survival, barter, and combat.

YoungPsychologist58.Title: young psychologist
YoungPsychologist58.Description:
This colonist was born and raised on a poor midworld, in the front passenger seat of their mother's cab.

Watching pedestrians and listening to the taxi passengers all day long, they soon became very good at figuring out someone's real purpose.

YouthDelinquent30.Title: youth delinquent
YouthDelinquent30.Description:
This colonist was the only child of celebrity sommeliers. their parents expected them to take up the family profession, but after their third admission to a youth detention center, this career path became unlikely.

While in detention, This colonist became skilled at making shanks and developed an interest in ornithology.

YouthSoldier99.Title: youth soldier
YouthSoldier99.Description:
Born to a long line of soldiers, This colonist joined a military training program.

they excelled in physical training, and even passed most of the intellectual exams. While They were never particularly bright or nimble, This colonist learned the value of hard work and suffering.
